        (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) + Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))⁻¹)
      (B := B) (u := fun n t ↦ f n (b₁ t))
      (v := fun t ↦ F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (K := (N : ℝ))
      hW₁ (hfloor₁_meas N) hB_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) hf₁_bound (hdom₁ N) hf₁_lim
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using h
  have hraw (n : ℕ) : CircleIntegrable
      ((Complex.re ∘ herglotzRieszKernel 0 w) * fun z ↦ Real.log ‖f n z‖) 0 1 := by
    have hmero : MeromorphicOn (f n) (sphere 0 |(1 : ℝ)|) := by
      intro z hz
      exact (hfanalytic n z (sphere_subset_closedBall (by simpa using hz))).meromorphicAt
    have hlog : CircleIntegrable (fun z ↦ Real.log ‖f n z‖) 0 1 :=
      hmero.circleIntegrable_log_norm
    simpa only [Pi.mul_apply] using
      hlog.mul_of_continuousOn (continuousOn_re_herglotzRieszKernel (by simpa using hw))
  have hfloor_circle (n N : ℕ) : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℂ ↦
      Real.log (max ‖f n z‖ (Real.exp (-(N : ℝ))))) (sphere 0 1) := by
    intro z hz
    change ContinuousWithinAt ((fun x : ℂ ↦
      Real.log (max ‖x‖ (Real.exp (-(N : ℝ)))) ) ∘ f n) (sphere 0 1) z
    exact ((continuousAt_log_max_norm_exp_neg (N : ℝ) (f n z)).comp
      (hfanalytic n z (sphere_subset_closedBall hz)).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  have hfloor_int (n N : ℕ) : CircleIntegrable
      ((Complex.re ∘ herglotzRieszKernel 0 w) * fun z ↦
        Real.log (max ‖f n z‖ (Real.exp (-(N : ℝ))))) 0 1 := by
    simpa only [Pi.mul_apply] using
      ((continuousOn_re_herglotzRieszKernel hw).mul (hfloor_circle n N)).circleIntegrable
        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
  have hfinite (N : ℕ) : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log ‖f n w‖ ≤
        (Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) *
          ((∫ t : ℝ,
            Real.log (max ‖f n (b₀ t)‖ (Real.exp (-(N : ℝ)))) /
              (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) - Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))) +
           ∫ t : ℝ,
            Real.log (max ‖f n (b₁ t)‖ (Real.exp (-(N : ℝ)))) /
              (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) + Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))) := by
    filter_upwards [hfcenter_ne] with n hn
    calc
      Real.log ‖f n w‖ ≤
          Real.circleAverage
            ((Complex.re ∘ herglotzRieszKernel 0 w) * fun z ↦ Real.log ‖f n z‖) 0 1 :=
        analytic_weighted_circleAverage_log_norm_le (f := f n) (w := w) (by norm_num)
          (hfanalytic n) hw hn
      _ ≤ Real.circleAverage
          ((Complex.re ∘ herglotzRieszKernel 0 w) * fun z ↦
            Real.log (max ‖f n z‖ (Real.exp (-(N : ℝ))))) 0 1 :=
        analytic_weighted_circleAverage_log_norm_le_floor (f := f n) (w := w)
          (K := fun _ : ℂ ↦ (N : ℝ)) (by norm_num) (hfanalytic n) hw hn (hraw n)
          (hfloor_int n N)
      _ = (Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) *
          ((∫ t : ℝ,
            Real.log (max ‖f n (b₀ t)‖ (Real.exp (-(N : ℝ)))) /
              (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) - Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))) +
           ∫ t : ℝ,
            Real.log (max ‖f n (b₁ t)‖ (Real.exp (-(N : ℝ)))) /
              (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) + Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))) := by
        simpa [w, b₀, b₁] using
          (circleAverage_poisson_transport hθ (hfloor_circle n N))
  have hlogcenter : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ Real.log ‖f n w‖) atTop
      (𝓝 (Real.log ‖F (θ : ℂ)‖)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      (Real.continuousAt_log (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hFθ)).tendsto.comp hfcenter.norm
  have hfloor_bound (N : ℕ) : Real.log ‖F (θ : ℂ)‖ ≤
      (Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) *
        ((∫ t : ℝ,
          Real.log (max ‖F ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ (Real.exp (-(N : ℝ)))) /
            (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) - Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))) +
         ∫ t : ℝ,
          Real.log (max ‖F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ (Real.exp (-(N : ℝ)))) /
            (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) + Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))) := by
    apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hlogcenter
      (((hI₀_lim N).add (hI₁_lim N)).const_mul (Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2))
    exact hfinite N
  have hsin_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2 := by
    have harg0 : 0 < Real.pi * θ := mul_pos Real.pi_pos hθ.1
    have harg1 : Real.pi * θ < Real.pi := by
      nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hθ.2 Real.pi_pos]
    exact div_nonneg (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi harg0 harg1).le (by norm_num)
  have hMgrowth₀ : ∃ b A : ℝ, b < Real.pi ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,
      |Real.log (M₀ t)| ≤ A * Real.exp (b * |t|) := by
    rcases hMgrowth with ⟨b, A, hb, hbound⟩
    exact ⟨b, A, hb, fun t ↦ (hbound t).1⟩
  have hMgrowth₁ : ∃ b A : ℝ, b < Real.pi ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,
      |Real.log (M₁ t)| ≤ A * Real.exp (b * |t|) := by
    rcases hMgrowth with ⟨b, A, hb, hbound⟩
    exact ⟨b, A, hb, fun t ↦ (hbound t).2⟩
  have hboundary (N : ℕ) : Real.log ‖F (θ : ℂ)‖ ≤
      (Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) *
        ((∫ t : ℝ,
          max (Real.log (M₀ t)) (-(N : ℝ)) /
            (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) - Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))) +
         ∫ t : ℝ,
          max (Real.log (M₁ t)) (-(N : ℝ)) /
            (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) + Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))) := by
    have hleft := integral_left_log_max_norm_exp_neg_le (F := F) (M := M₀) N hθ hF hM.1
      (fun t ↦ (hMpos t).1) hMgrowth₀ hbound₀
    have hright := integral_right_log_max_norm_exp_neg_le (F := F) (M := M₁) N hθ hF hM.2
      (fun t ↦ (hMpos t).2) hMgrowth₁ hbound₁
    calc
      Real.log ‖F (θ : ℂ)‖ ≤ _ := hfloor_bound N
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hleft hright) hsin_nonneg
  exact Real.le_exp_of_log_le
    (log_le_hirschman_integral_of_floors hθ hM hMgrowth hboundary)

name: Auto.constant_kernel_factor
statement:
private theorem constant_kernel_factor {θ M₀ M₁ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hM₀ : 0 < M₀) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁) :
    Real.exp
        ((Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) *
          ∫ t : ℝ,
            Real.log M₀ / (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) - Real.cos (Real.pi * θ)) +
              Real.log M₁ / (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) + Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))) =
      Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ
proof:
:= by
  have hk₀ := integrable_kernel_left hθ
  have hk₁ := integrable_kernel_right hθ
  have h₀ : Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      Real.log M₀ / (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) - Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))) := by
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hk₀.const_mul (Real.log M₀)
  have h₁ : Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      Real.log M₁ / (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) + Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))) := by
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hk₁.const_mul (Real.log M₁)
  rw [integral_add h₀ h₁]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, integral_const_mul]
  let I₀ : ℝ := ∫ t : ℝ,
    (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) - Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))⁻¹
  let I₁ : ℝ := ∫ t : ℝ,
    (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) + Real.cos (Real.pi * θ))⁻¹
  change Real.exp
      ((Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) * (2 : ℝ)⁻¹) *
        (Real.log M₀ * I₀ + Real.log M₁ * I₁)) =
    Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ
  have hleft := kernel_left_normalized hθ
  have hright := kernel_right_normalized hθ
  change (Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) * I₀ = 1 - θ at hleft
  change (Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) * I₁ = θ at hright
  have hcombine :
      (Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) * (2 : ℝ)⁻¹) *
          (Real.log M₀ * I₀ + Real.log M₁ * I₁) =
        Real.log M₀ * ((Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) * I₀) +
          Real.log M₁ * ((Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) * I₁) := by ring
  rw [hcombine, hleft, hright, Real.exp_add,
    ← Real.rpow_def_of_pos hM₀, ← Real.rpow_def_of_pos hM₁]
  rfl

name: Auto.normalized_pairing_bound_of_deformations
statement:
private theorem normalized_pairing_bound_of_deformations
    {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    {p₀ p₁ q₀ q₁ : ENNReal} {θ : ℝ} {M₀ M₁ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (T : ℂ → SimpleFunc X ℂ → Y → ℂ)
    (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hq₁ : 1 ≤ q₁) (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hT_add : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g μ → T z (f + g) = T z f + T z g)
    (hT_smul : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → T z (c • f) = c • T z f)
    (hT_measurable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Measurable (T z f))
    (hpair_integrable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1)
      (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν → Integrable (fun y ↦ T z f y * g y) ν)
    (hanalytic : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν →
      DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∫ y, T z f y * g y ∂ν) (verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hfamily_growth : ∃ a : ℝ, a < Real.pi ∧
      ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
        Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν →
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
          ‖∫ y, T z f y * g y ∂ν‖ ≤
            Real.exp (C * Real.exp (a * |(z : ℂ).im|)))
    (hM_measurable : Measurable M₀ ∧ Measurable M₁)
    (hM_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < M₀ t ∧ 0 < M₁ t)
    (hM_growth : ∃ b A : ℝ, b < Real.pi ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,
      |Real.log (M₀ t)| ≤ A * Real.exp (b * |t|) ∧
        |Real.log (M₁ t)| ≤ A * Real.exp (b * |t|))
    (hbound₀ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →
      eLpNorm (T ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) f) q₀ ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (M₀ t) * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p₀ μ)
    (hbound₁ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →
      eLpNorm (T (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) f) q₁ ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (M₁ t) * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p₁ μ)
    (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ)
    (hf : Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ) (hg : Integrable (g : Y → ℂ) ν)
    (φ ψ : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (hφzero : ∀ z, φ z 0 = 0) (hψzero : ∀ z, ψ z 0 = 0)
    {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hφbound : ∀ c ∈ f.range.erase 0, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1, ‖φ z c‖ ≤ A)
    (hψbound : ∀ c ∈ g.range.erase 0, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1, ‖ψ z c‖ ≤ B)
    (hφanalytic : ∀ c ∈ f.range.erase 0,
      DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ φ z c) (verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hψanalytic : ∀ c ∈ g.range.erase 0,
      DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ψ z c) (verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hφtheta : f.map (φ (θ : ℂ)) = f) (hψtheta : g.map (ψ (θ : ℂ)) = g)
    (hφleft : ∀ t : ℝ,
      eLpNorm (f.map (φ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) : X → ℂ) p₀ μ ≤ 1)
    (hφright : ∀ t : ℝ,
      eLpNorm (f.map (φ (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) : X → ℂ) p₁ μ ≤ 1)
    (hψleft : ∀ t : ℝ,
      eLpNorm (g.map (ψ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) : Y → ℂ) q₀.conjExponent ν ≤ 1)
    (hψright : ∀ t : ℝ,
      eLpNorm (g.map (ψ (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) : Y → ℂ) q₁.conjExponent ν ≤ 1) :
    ‖∫ y, T (θ : ℂ) f y * g y ∂ν‖ ≤
      Real.exp
        ((Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) *
          ∫ t : ℝ,
            Real.log (M₀ t) / (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) - Real.cos (Real.pi * θ)) +
              Real.log (M₁ t) / (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) + Real.cos (Real.pi * θ)))
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℂ → ℂ := fun z ↦
    ∫ y, T z (f.map (φ z)) y * (g.map (ψ z)) y ∂ν
  have hF : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (verticalStrip 0 1) := by
    simpa only [F] using
      (diffContOnCl_pairing_of_simple_deformations T hT_add hT_smul hpair_integrable
        hanalytic f g hf hg φ ψ hφzero hψzero hφanalytic hψanalytic)
  have hF_growth : ∃ a : ℝ, a < Real.pi ∧ ∃ C : ℝ,
      ∀ z : ℂ, z ∈ verticalClosedStrip 0 1 →
        ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (C * Real.exp (a * |z.im|)) := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, C, hC⟩ :=
      family_growth_of_simple_deformations T hT_add hT_smul hpair_integrable hfamily_growth
        f g hf hg φ ψ hφzero hψzero hA hB hφbound hψbound
    refine ⟨a, ha, C, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    simpa only [F] using hC ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hFbound₀ : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖F ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ M₀ t := by
    intro t
    dsimp only [F]
    exact left_boundary_pairing_bound_normalized T hq₀ hT_measurable hbound₀
      (fun s ↦ (hM_pos s).1.le) t
      (f.map (φ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))) (g.map (ψ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
      (integrable_map_of_integrable f hf _ (hφzero _))
      (integrable_map_of_integrable g hg _ (hψzero _))
      (hφleft t) (hψleft t)
  have hFbound₁ : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ M₁ t := by
    intro t
    dsimp only [F]
    exact right_boundary_pairing_bound_normalized T hq₁ hT_measurable hbound₁
      (fun s ↦ (hM_pos s).2.le) t
      (f.map (φ (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
      (g.map (ψ (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
      (integrable_map_of_integrable f hf _ (hφzero _))
      (integrable_map_of_integrable g hg _ (hψzero _))
      (hφright t) (hψright t)
  simpa only [F, hφtheta, hψtheta] using
    (hirschman_three_lines hθ hF hF_growth hM_measurable hM_pos hM_growth hFbound₀ hFbound₁)

name: Auto.stein_interpolation
statement:
theorem stein_interpolation
    {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    {p₀ p₁ p q₀ q₁ q : ENNReal} {θ : ℝ} {M₀ M₁ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (T : ℂ → SimpleFunc X ℂ → Y → ℂ)
    (hp₀ : 1 ≤ p₀) (hp₁ : 1 ≤ p₁) (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hq₁ : 1 ≤ q₁)

      Integrable f μ → Integrable g μ → T z (f + g) = T z f + T z g)
    (hT_smul : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → T z (c • f) = c • T z f)
    (hT_measurable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Measurable (T z f))
    (hpair_integrable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1)
      (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν → Integrable (fun y ↦ T z f y * g y) ν)
    (hanalytic : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν →
      DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∫ y, T z f y * g y ∂ν) (verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hfamily_growth : ∃ a : ℝ, a < Real.pi ∧
      ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
        Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν →
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
          ‖∫ y, T z f y * g y ∂ν‖ ≤ exp (C * exp (a * |(z : ℂ).im|)))
    (hM_measurable : Measurable M₀ ∧ Measurable M₁)
    (hM_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < M₀ t ∧ 0 < M₁ t)
    (hM_growth : ∃ b A : ℝ, b < Real.pi ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,

    (hbound₀ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →

    (hbound₁ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →
      eLpNorm (T (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) f) q₁ ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (M₁ t) * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p₁ μ) :
    ∀ f : SimpleFunc X ℂ, Integrable f μ →
      MemLp (T (θ : ℂ) f) q ν ∧
      eLpNorm (T (θ : ℂ) f) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal
          (exp
            ((sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) *
              ∫ t : ℝ,
                log (M₀ t) / (cosh (Real.pi * t) - cos (Real.pi * θ)) +
                  log (M₁ t) / (cosh (Real.pi * t) + cos (Real.pi * θ)))) *
          eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p μ

theorem stein_interpolation_constant_bounds
    {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    {p₀ p₁ p q₀ q₁ q : ENNReal} {θ M₀ M₁ : ℝ}
    (T : ℂ → SimpleFunc X ℂ → Y → ℂ)
    (hp₀ : 1 ≤ p₀) (hp₁ : 1 ≤ p₁) (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hq₁ : 1 ≤ q₁)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp : p⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * p₀⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal θ * p₁⁻¹)
    (hq : q⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * q₀⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal θ * q₁⁻¹)
    (hT_add : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g μ → T z (f + g) = T z f + T z g)
    (hT_smul : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → T z (c • f) = c • T z f)
    (hT_measurable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Measurable (T z f))
    (hpair_integrable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1)
      (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν → Integrable (fun y ↦ T z f y * g y) ν)
    (hanalytic : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν →
      DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∫ y, T z f y * g y ∂ν) (verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hfamily_growth : ∃ a : ℝ, a < Real.pi ∧
      ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
        Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν →
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
          ‖∫ y, T z f y * g y ∂ν‖ ≤ exp (C * exp (a * |(z : ℂ).im|)))
    (hM₀ : 0 < M₀) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)
    (hbound₀ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →
      eLpNorm (T ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) f) q₀ ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p₀ μ)
    (hbound₁ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →
      eLpNorm (T (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) f) q₁ ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p₁ μ) :
    ∀ f : SimpleFunc X ℂ, Integrable f μ →
      MemLp (T (θ : ℂ) f) q ν ∧
      eLpNorm (T (θ : ℂ) f) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
          eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p μ
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨hmem, hnorm⟩ := stein_interpolation T hp₀ hp₁ hq₀ hq₁ hθ hp hq hT_add hT_smul
    hT_measurable hpair_integrable hanalytic hfamily_growth
    ⟨measurable_const, measurable_const⟩ (fun t ↦ ⟨hM₀, hM₁⟩)
    ⟨0, max |Real.log M₀| |Real.log M₁|, Real.pi_pos,
      fun t ↦ by simp⟩
    (fun t g hg ↦ by simpa using hbound₀ t g hg)
    (fun t g hg ↦ by simpa using hbound₁ t g hg) f hf
  refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
  simpa [constant_kernel_factor hθ hM₀ hM₁] using hnorm

name: Auto.riesz_thorin
statement:
theorem riesz_thorin
    {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    {p₀ p₁ p q₀ q₁ q : ENNReal} {θ M₀ M₁ : ℝ}
    (T : SimpleFunc X ℂ → Y → ℂ)
    (hp₀ : 1 ≤ p₀) (hp₁ : 1 ≤ p₁) (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hq₁ : 1 ≤ q₁)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp : p⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * p₀⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal θ * p₁⁻¹)
    (hq : q⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * q₀⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal θ * q₁⁻¹)
    (hT_add : ∀ (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g μ → T (f + g) = T f + T g)
    (hT_smul : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → T (c • f) = c • T f)
    (hT_measurable : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Measurable (T f))
    (hM₀ : 0 < M₀) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)
    (hbound₀ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →
      eLpNorm (T f) q₀ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p₀ μ)
    (hbound₁ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →
      eLpNorm (T f) q₁ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p₁ μ) :
    ∀ f : SimpleFunc X ℂ, Integrable f μ →
      MemLp (T f) q ν ∧
      eLpNorm (T f) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
          eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p μ
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  refine stein_interpolation_constant_bounds (T := fun _ f ↦ T f)
    hp₀ hp₁ hq₀ hq₁ hθ hp hq ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hM₀ hM₁ ?_ ?_ f hf
  · intro z f g hf hg
    exact hT_add f g hf hg
  · intro z c f hf
    exact hT_smul c f hf
  · intro z f hf
    exact hT_measurable f hf
  · intro z f g hf hg
    exact pairing_integrable_of_endpoint_bound hq₀ T hT_measurable hbound₀ f g hf hg
  · intro f g hf hg
    exact diffContOnCl_const
  · refine ⟨0, Real.pi_pos, ?_⟩
    intro f g hf hg
    let N : ℝ := ‖∫ y, T f y * g y ∂ν‖
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    intro z
    change N ≤ Real.exp (N * Real.exp (0 * |(z : ℂ).im|))
    calc
      N ≤ N + 1 := le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one
      _ ≤ Real.exp N := add_one_le_exp _
      _ = Real.exp (N * Real.exp (0 * |(z : ℂ).im|)) := by simp
  · intro t f hf
    exact hbound₀ f hf
  · intro t f hf
    exact hbound₁ f hf

name: Auto.aux_multilinear_input_deformation_properties
statement:
theorem aux_multilinear_input_deformation_properties
    {m : ℕ} {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}
    {p₀ p₁ p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal} {θ : ℝ}
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp₀ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₀ i) (hp₁ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₁ i) (hp : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p i)
    (hp_top : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hint : ∀ i, (p i)⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * (p₀ i)⁻¹ +
      ENNReal.ofReal θ * (p₁ i)⁻¹)
    (g : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ)
    (hgnorm : ∀ i, eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (p i.succ) μ ≤ 1) :
    (∀ i, aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g (θ : ℂ) i = g i) ∧
    (∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) i,
      Integrable (aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i : X → ℂ) μ) ∧
    (∀ (t : ℝ) i, eLpNorm
      (aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ)
        (p₀ i.succ) μ ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ (t : ℝ) i, eLpNorm
      (aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ)
        (p₁ i.succ) μ ≤ 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i
    dsimp only [aux_multilinear_input_deformation]
    apply simpleFunc_input_deformation_at_theta
    apply input_coeff_at_theta_of_interp_general hθ (hp i.succ) (hp₀ i.succ)
      (hp₁ i.succ) (hp_top i.succ) (hint i.succ)
  constructor
  · intro z i
    apply integrable_map_of_integrable (g i) (hg i)
    simp
  constructor
  · intro t i
    dsimp only [aux_multilinear_input_deformation]
    apply eLpNorm_input_deformation_left_coeff_ennreal_le_one
      (p := p i.succ) (p₀ := p₀ i.succ)
    · exact hp i.succ
    · exact hp₀ i.succ
    · exact hp_top i.succ
    · rfl
    · exact hgnorm i
  · intro t i
    dsimp only [aux_multilinear_input_deformation]
    apply eLpNorm_input_deformation_right_coeff_ennreal_le_one
      (p := p i.succ) (p₁ := p₁ i.succ)
    · exact hp i.succ
    · exact hp₁ i.succ
    · exact hp_top i.succ
    · rfl
    · exact hgnorm i

name: Auto.aux_multilinear_input_deformations
statement:
theorem aux_multilinear_input_deformations
    {m : ℕ} {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}
    {p₀ p₁ p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal} {θ : ℝ}
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp₀ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₀ i) (hp₁ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₁ i) (hp : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p i)
    (hp_top : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hint : ∀ i, (p i)⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * (p₀ i)⁻¹ +
      ENNReal.ofReal θ * (p₁ i)⁻¹)
    (g : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ)
    (hgnorm : ∀ i, eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (p i.succ) μ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ D : ℂ → Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, D (θ : ℂ) i = g i) ∧
      (∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) i, Integrable (D z i : X → ℂ) μ) ∧
      (∀ (t : ℝ) i,
        eLpNorm (D ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i.succ) μ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ (t : ℝ) i,
        eLpNorm (D (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i.succ) μ ≤ 1)
proof:
:= by
  let a₀ : Fin m → ℝ := fun i ↦ (p i.succ).toReal * ((p₀ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal
  let a₁ : Fin m → ℝ := fun i ↦ (p i.succ).toReal * ((p₁ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal
  let D : ℂ → Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ := fun z i ↦ (g i).map (fun c ↦
    if c = 0 then 0 else
      c / (‖c‖ : ℂ) * Complex.exp
        ((((a₁ i - a₀ i : ℝ) : ℂ) * z + (a₀ i : ℂ)) *
          ((Real.log ‖c‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)))
  refine ⟨D, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    dsimp only [D]
    apply simpleFunc_input_deformation_at_theta
    apply input_coeff_at_theta_of_interp_general hθ (hp i.succ) (hp₀ i.succ)
      (hp₁ i.succ) (hp_top i.succ) (hint i.succ)
  · intro z i
    apply integrable_map_of_integrable (g i) (hg i)
    simp
  · intro t i
    dsimp only [D, a₀, a₁]
    apply eLpNorm_input_deformation_left_coeff_ennreal_le_one
      (p := p i.succ) (p₀ := p₀ i.succ)
    · exact hp i.succ
    · exact hp₀ i.succ
    · exact hp_top i.succ
    · rfl
    · exact hgnorm i
  · intro t i
    dsimp only [D, a₀, a₁]
    apply eLpNorm_input_deformation_right_coeff_ennreal_le_one
      (p := p i.succ) (p₁ := p₁ i.succ)
    · exact hp i.succ
    · exact hp₁ i.succ
    · exact hp_top i.succ
    · rfl
    · exact hgnorm i

name: Auto.aux_multilinear_interpolation_of_deformations
statement:
theorem aux_multilinear_interpolation_of_deformations
    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    (B : SimpleFunc X ℂ → (Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ) → Y → ℂ)
    {p₀ p₁ p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal} {q : ENNReal} {θ M₀ M₁ : ℝ}
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp₀ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₀ i) (hp₁ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₁ i) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hint : (p 0)⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * (p₀ 0)⁻¹ +
      ENNReal.ofReal θ * (p₁ 0)⁻¹)
    (hM₀ : 0 < M₀) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)
    (hB_add : ∀ (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g : X → ℂ) μ →
        B (f + g) u = B f u + B g u)
    (hB_smul : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → B (c • f) u = c • B f u)
    (hB_measurable : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        Measurable (B f u))
    (hB_pair_integrable : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
      (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ), Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ →
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Integrable (g : Y → ℂ) ν →
        Integrable (fun y ↦ B f u y * g y) ν)
    (hB_bound₀ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
      eLpNorm (B f u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₀ 0) μ *
        ∏ i, eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i.succ) μ)
    (hB_bound₁ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
      eLpNorm (B f u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₁ 0) μ *
        ∏ i, eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i.succ) μ)
    (g₀ : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg₀ : Integrable (g₀ : X → ℂ) μ)
    (D : ℂ → Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hD_theta : ∀ i, D (θ : ℂ) i = g i)
    (hD_integrable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) i,
      Integrable (D z i : X → ℂ) μ)
    (hD_left : ∀ (t : ℝ) i,
      eLpNorm (D ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i.succ) μ ≤ 1)
    (hD_right : ∀ (t : ℝ) i,
      eLpNorm (D (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i.succ) μ ≤ 1)
    (hB_analytic : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g' : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g' : Y → ℂ) ν →
      DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∫ y, B f (D z) y * g' y ∂ν) (verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hB_growth : ∃ a : ℝ, a < Real.pi ∧
      ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g' : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
        Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g' : Y → ℂ) ν →
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
          ‖∫ y, B f (D z) y * g' y ∂ν‖ ≤
            Real.exp (C * Real.exp (a * |(z : ℂ).im|))) :
    MemLp (B g₀ g) q ν ∧
      eLpNorm (B g₀ g) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
          eLpNorm (g₀ : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ
proof:
:= by
  let T : ℂ → SimpleFunc X ℂ → Y → ℂ := fun z f ↦ B f (D z)
  have hweight : ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) + ENNReal.ofReal θ = 1 := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by linarith [hθ.2]) hθ.1.le]
    norm_num
  have hqint : q⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * q⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal θ * q⁻¹ := by
    rw [← add_mul, hweight, one_mul]
  have hT_add : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (f k : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (k : X → ℂ) μ →
        T z (f + k) = T z f + T z k := by
    intro z f k hf hk
    exact hB_add f k (D z) hf hk
  have hT_smul : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → T z (c • f) = c • T z f := by
    intro z c f hf
    exact hB_smul c f (D z) hf
  have hT_measurable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Measurable (T z f) := by
    intro z f hf
    exact hB_measurable f (D z) hf (hD_integrable z)
  have hT_pair_integrable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1)
      (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g' : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g' : Y → ℂ) ν →
        Integrable (fun y ↦ T z f y * g' y) ν := by
    intro z f g' hf hg'
    exact hB_pair_integrable f (D z) g' hf (hD_integrable z) hg'
  have hT_analytic : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g' : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g' : Y → ℂ) ν →
      DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∫ y, T z f y * g' y ∂ν) (verticalStrip 0 1) := by
    intro f g' hf hg'
    exact hB_analytic f g' hf hg'
  have hT_growth : ∃ a : ℝ, a < Real.pi ∧
      ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g' : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
        Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g' : Y → ℂ) ν →
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
          ‖∫ y, T z f y * g' y ∂ν‖ ≤
            Real.exp (C * Real.exp (a * |(z : ℂ).im|)) := hB_growth
  have hT_bound₀ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ →
      eLpNorm (T ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) f) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₀ 0) μ := by
    intro t f hf
    have hprod : ∏ i, eLpNorm (D ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i.succ) μ ≤ 1 := by
      exact Finset.prod_le_one (fun _ _ ↦ bot_le) (fun i _ ↦ hD_left t i)
    calc
      eLpNorm (T ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) f) q ν ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₀ 0) μ *
            ∏ i, eLpNorm (D ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i.succ) μ :=
        hB_bound₀ f (D ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) hf
          (hD_integrable ⟨_, by simp [verticalClosedStrip]⟩)
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₀ 0) μ * 1 := by gcongr
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₀ 0) μ := by rw [mul_one]
  have hT_bound₁ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ →
      eLpNorm (T (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) f) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₁ 0) μ := by
    intro t f hf
    have hprod : ∏ i, eLpNorm (D (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i.succ) μ ≤ 1 := by
      exact Finset.prod_le_one (fun _ _ ↦ bot_le) (fun i _ ↦ hD_right t i)
    calc
      eLpNorm (T (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) f) q ν ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₁ 0) μ *
            ∏ i, eLpNorm (D (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i.succ) μ :=
        hB_bound₁ f (D (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) hf
          (hD_integrable ⟨_, by simp [verticalClosedStrip]⟩)
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₁ 0) μ * 1 := by gcongr
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₁ 0) μ := by rw [mul_one]
  obtain ⟨hmem, hnorm⟩ := stein_interpolation_constant_bounds T
    (hp₀ 0) (hp₁ 0) hq hq hθ hint hqint hT_add hT_smul hT_measurable
      hT_pair_integrable hT_analytic hT_growth hM₀ hM₁ hT_bound₀ hT_bound₁ g₀ hg₀
  have hT_theta : T (θ : ℂ) g₀ = B g₀ g := by
    dsimp only [T]
    rw [show D (θ : ℂ) = g by funext i; exact hD_theta i]
  rw [hT_theta] at hmem hnorm
  exact ⟨hmem, hnorm⟩

name: Auto.aux_multilinear_interpolation_two_endpoint_normalized
statement:
theorem aux_multilinear_interpolation_two_endpoint_normalized
    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    (B : SimpleFunc X ℂ → (Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ) → Y → ℂ)
    {p₀ p₁ p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal} {q : ENNReal} {θ M₀ M₁ : ℝ}
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp₀ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₀ i) (hp₁ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₁ i) (hp : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p i)
    (hp_top : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hint : ∀ i, (p i)⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * (p₀ i)⁻¹ +
      ENNReal.ofReal θ * (p₁ i)⁻¹)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hM₀ : 0 < M₀) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)
    (hB_add : ∀ (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g : X → ℂ) μ →
        B (f + g) u = B f u + B g u)
    (hB_smul : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → B (c • f) u = c • B f u)
    (hB_measurable : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        Measurable (B f u))
    (hB_pair_integrable : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
      (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ), Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ →
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Integrable (g : Y → ℂ) ν →

    (hB_bound₀ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
      eLpNorm (B f u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₀ 0) μ *
        ∏ i, eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i.succ) μ)
    (hB_bound₁ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
      eLpNorm (B f u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₁ 0) μ *
        ∏ i, eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i.succ) μ)
    (g₀ : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg₀ : Integrable (g₀ : X → ℂ) μ) (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ)
    (hgnorm : ∀ i, eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (p i.succ) μ ≤ 1)
    (hB_analytic : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g' : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g' : Y → ℂ) ν →
      DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∫ y,
        B f (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i) y * g' y ∂ν)
        (verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hB_growth : ∃ a : ℝ, a < Real.pi ∧
      ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g' : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
        Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g' : Y → ℂ) ν →
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
          ‖∫ y, B f (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i) y * g' y ∂ν‖ ≤
            Real.exp (C * Real.exp (a * |(z : ℂ).im|))) :
    MemLp (B g₀ g) q ν ∧
      eLpNorm (B g₀ g) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
          eLpNorm (g₀ : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hD_theta, hD_integrable, hD_left, hD_right⟩ :=
    aux_multilinear_input_deformation_properties hθ hp₀ hp₁ hp hp_top hint g hg hgnorm
  exact aux_multilinear_interpolation_of_deformations B hθ hp₀ hp₁ hq (hint 0)
    hM₀ hM₁ hB_add hB_smul hB_measurable hB_pair_integrable hB_bound₀ hB_bound₁
    g₀ g hg₀ (aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g)
    hD_theta hD_integrable hD_left hD_right hB_analytic hB_growth

name: Auto.aux_multilinear_pairing_analytic
statement:
private theorem aux_multilinear_pairing_analytic
    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y}
    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Y → ℂ))
    {p₀ p₁ p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal}
    (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (h : SimpleFunc Y ℂ)
    (hf : Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ) (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ)
    (hh : Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν)
    (hpair : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν → Integrable (fun y ↦ B u y * h y) ν) :
    DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∫ y,
      B (Fin.cons f (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i)) y * h y ∂ν)
      (verticalStrip 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Fin m → Finset ℂ := fun i ↦ (g i).range.erase 0
  let e : (i : Fin m) → ℂ → SimpleFunc X ℂ := fun i c ↦
    (SimpleFunc.const X (1 : ℂ)).restrict ((g i) ⁻¹' {c})
  let φ : Fin m → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i z c ↦ if c = 0 then 0 else
    c / (‖c‖ : ℂ) * Complex.exp
      (((((p i.succ).toReal * ((p₁ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal -
            (p i.succ).toReal * ((p₀ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal : ℝ) : ℂ) * z +
          ((p i.succ).toReal * ((p₀ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((Real.log ‖c‖ : ℝ) : ℂ))
  let Bf := B.curryLeft f
  have he : ∀ i c, c ∈ S i → Integrable (e i c : X → ℂ) μ := by
    intro i c hc
    exact integrable_basis_of_integrable (g i) (hg i) (by simpa only [S] using hc)
  have hDsum (z : ℂ) (i : Fin m) :
      aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i =
        ∑ c ∈ S i, φ i z c • e i c := by
    simpa only [S, e, φ, aux_multilinear_input_deformation] using
      (map_eq_sum_smul_restrict (g i) (φ i z) (by simp [φ]))
  have hBsum (z : ℂ) :
      Bf (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i) =
        ∑ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset S, Bf (fun i ↦ φ i z (r i) • e i (r i)) := by
    rw [show (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i) =
      (fun i ↦ ∑ c ∈ S i, φ i z c • e i c) by funext i; exact hDsum z i]
    exact Bf.map_sum_finset (fun i c ↦ φ i z c • e i c) S
  let H : (∀ i, ℂ) → ℂ := fun r ↦
    ∫ y, Bf (fun i ↦ e i (r i)) y * h y ∂ν
  have hH_integrable : ∀ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset S,
      Integrable (fun y ↦ Bf (fun i ↦ e i (r i)) y * h y) ν := by
    intro r hr
    apply hpair (Fin.cons f (fun i ↦ e i (r i)))
      (fun i ↦ Fin.cases hf (fun j ↦ he j (r j) ((Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hr) j)) i) hh
  have hF : (fun z ↦ ∫ y,
      B (Fin.cons f (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i)) y * h y ∂ν) =
      fun z ↦ ∑ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset S, (∏ i, φ i z (r i)) * H r := by
    funext z
    change (∫ y, Bf (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i) y * h y ∂ν) = _
    rw [hBsum z]
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [integral_finsetSum]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r hr
      rw [Bf.map_smul_univ]
      change (∫ y, ((∏ i, φ i z (r i)) • Bf (fun i ↦ e i (r i))) y * h y ∂ν) = _
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    · intro r hr
      rw [Bf.map_smul_univ]
      simpa only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using
        (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using
          (hH_integrable r hr).const_mul (∏ i, φ i z (r i)))
  rw [hF]
  apply diffContOnCl_finset_sum (Fintype.piFinset S)
    (fun r z ↦ (∏ i, φ i z (r i)) * H r) (verticalStrip 0 1)
  intro r hr
  have hprod : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∏ i, φ i z (r i)) (verticalStrip 0 1) := by
    classical
    induction (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)) using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simpa using (diffContOnCl_const (𝕜 := ℂ) (s := verticalStrip 0 1) (c := (1 : ℂ)))
    | insert i s his ih =>
      simpa only [Finset.prod_insert his, smul_eq_mul] using
        (diffContOnCl_input_deformation_coeff (a₀ :=
        (p i.succ).toReal * ((p₀ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal) (a₁ :=
        (p i.succ).toReal * ((p₁ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal) (r i) (verticalStrip 0 1)).smul ih
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hprod.smul
    (diffContOnCl_const (𝕜 := ℂ) (s := verticalStrip 0 1) (c := H r))

name: Auto.aux_multilinear_pairing_growth
statement:
private theorem aux_multilinear_pairing_growth
    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y}
    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Y → ℂ))
    {p₀ p₁ p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal}
    (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (h : SimpleFunc Y ℂ)
    (hf : Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ) (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ)
    (hh : Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν)
    (hpair : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν → Integrable (fun y ↦ B u y * h y) ν) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
      ‖∫ y, B (Fin.cons f (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i)) y * h y ∂ν‖ ≤
        Real.exp (C * Real.exp (0 * |(z : ℂ).im|))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Fin m → Finset ℂ := fun i ↦ (g i).range.erase 0
  let e : (i : Fin m) → ℂ → SimpleFunc X ℂ := fun i c ↦
    (SimpleFunc.const X (1 : ℂ)).restrict ((g i) ⁻¹' {c})
  let φ : Fin m → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun i z c ↦ if c = 0 then 0 else
    c / (‖c‖ : ℂ) * Complex.exp
      (((((p i.succ).toReal * ((p₁ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal -
            (p i.succ).toReal * ((p₀ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal : ℝ) : ℂ) * z +
          ((p i.succ).toReal * ((p₀ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((Real.log ‖c‖ : ℝ) : ℂ))
  let Bf := B.curryLeft f
  have he : ∀ i c, c ∈ S i → Integrable (e i c : X → ℂ) μ := by
    intro i c hc
    exact integrable_basis_of_integrable (g i) (hg i) (by simpa only [S] using hc)
  have hDsum (z : ℂ) (i : Fin m) :
      aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i =
        ∑ c ∈ S i, φ i z c • e i c := by
    simpa only [S, e, φ, aux_multilinear_input_deformation] using
      (map_eq_sum_smul_restrict (g i) (φ i z) (by simp [φ]))
  have hBsum (z : ℂ) :
      Bf (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i) =
        ∑ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset S, Bf (fun i ↦ φ i z (r i) • e i (r i)) := by
    rw [show (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i) =
      (fun i ↦ ∑ c ∈ S i, φ i z c • e i c) by funext i; exact hDsum z i]
    exact Bf.map_sum_finset (fun i c ↦ φ i z c • e i c) S
  let H : (∀ i, ℂ) → ℂ := fun r ↦
    ∫ y, Bf (fun i ↦ e i (r i)) y * h y ∂ν
  have hH_integrable : ∀ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset S,
      Integrable (fun y ↦ Bf (fun i ↦ e i (r i)) y * h y) ν := by
    intro r hr
    apply hpair (Fin.cons f (fun i ↦ e i (r i)))
      (fun i ↦ Fin.cases hf (fun j ↦ he j (r j) ((Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hr) j)) i) hh
  have hF : (fun z ↦ ∫ y,
      B (Fin.cons f (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i)) y * h y ∂ν) =
      fun z ↦ ∑ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset S, (∏ i, φ i z (r i)) * H r := by
    funext z
    change (∫ y, Bf (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i) y * h y ∂ν) = _
    rw [hBsum z]
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [integral_finsetSum]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r hr
      rw [Bf.map_smul_univ]
      change (∫ y, ((∏ i, φ i z (r i)) • Bf (fun i ↦ e i (r i))) y * h y ∂ν) = _
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    · intro r hr
      rw [Bf.map_smul_univ]
      simpa only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using
        (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using
          (hH_integrable r hr).const_mul (∏ i, φ i z (r i)))
  let w : Fin m → ℝ := fun i ↦ ∑ c ∈ S i,
    max 1 (‖c‖ ^ max ((p i.succ).toReal * ((p₀ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal)
      ((p i.succ).toReal * ((p₁ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal))
  have hw_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i := by
    intro i
    dsimp [w]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun c hc ↦
      le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_left _ _)
  have hφ_bound : ∀ i c, c ∈ S i → ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
      ‖φ i z c‖ ≤ w i := by
    intro i c hc z
    calc
      ‖φ i z c‖ ≤
          max 1 (‖c‖ ^ max ((p i.succ).toReal * ((p₀ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal)
            ((p i.succ).toReal * ((p₁ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal)) := by
        simpa only [φ] using
          (norm_input_deformation_coeff_uniform
            (mul_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
            (mul_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg) c (z : ℂ) z.2)
      _ ≤ w i := by
        dsimp [w]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (s := S i)
          (fun d hd ↦ show (0 : ℝ) ≤ max 1
            (‖d‖ ^ max ((p i.succ).toReal * ((p₀ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal)
              ((p i.succ).toReal * ((p₁ i.succ)⁻¹).toReal)) from
            le_trans (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) (le_max_left _ _)) hc
  have hprod_bound : ∀ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset S, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
      ‖∏ i, φ i z (r i)‖ ≤ ∏ i, w i := by
    intro r hr z
    rw [norm_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod
    · intro i hi
      exact norm_nonneg _
    · intro i hi
      exact hφ_bound i (r i) ((Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hr) i) z
  let C : ℝ := ∑ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset S, (∏ i, w i) * ‖H r‖
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  intro z
  have hnorm :
      ‖∫ y, B (Fin.cons f
        (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i)) y * h y ∂ν‖ ≤ C := by
    rw [congrFun hF (z : ℂ)]
    calc
      ‖∑ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset S, (∏ i, φ i z (r i)) * H r‖ ≤
          ∑ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset S, ‖(∏ i, φ i z (r i)) * H r‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset S, (∏ i, w i) * ‖H r‖ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro r hr
        rw [norm_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hprod_bound r hr z) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = C := rfl
  calc
    ‖∫ y, B (Fin.cons f
      (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g z i)) y * h y ∂ν‖ ≤ C := hnorm
    _ ≤ C + 1 := le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one
    _ ≤ Real.exp C := add_one_le_exp C
    _ = Real.exp (C * Real.exp (0 * |(z : ℂ).im|)) := by simp

name: Auto.multilinear_interpolation_two_endpoint_normalized
statement:
theorem multilinear_interpolation_two_endpoint_normalized
    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Y → ℂ))
    {p₀ p₁ p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal} {q : ENNReal} {θ M₀ M₁ : ℝ}
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp₀ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₀ i) (hp₁ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₁ i) (hp : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p i)
    (hp_top : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hint : ∀ i, (p i)⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * (p₀ i)⁻¹ +
      ENNReal.ofReal θ * (p₁ i)⁻¹)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hM₀ : 0 < M₀) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)
    (hB_measurable : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Measurable (B u))
    (hB_pair_integrable : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
      (h : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν →
        Integrable (fun y ↦ B u y * h y) ν)
    (hB_bound₀ : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        eLpNorm (B u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i) μ)
    (hB_bound₁ : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        eLpNorm (B u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i) μ)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ)
    (hgnorm : ∀ i : Fin m, eLpNorm (g i.succ : X → ℂ) (p i.succ) μ ≤ 1) :
    MemLp (B g) q ν ∧
      eLpNorm (B g) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
          eLpNorm (g 0 : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ
proof:
:= by
  let Bcur : SimpleFunc X ℂ → (Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ) → Y → ℂ :=
    fun f u ↦ B.curryLeft f u
  have hB_add : ∀ (f k : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (k : X → ℂ) μ →
        Bcur (f + k) u = Bcur f u + Bcur k u := by
    intro f k u hf hk
    change B.curryLeft (f + k) u = B.curryLeft f u + B.curryLeft k u
    rw [map_add]
    rfl
  have hB_smul : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Bcur (c • f) u = c • Bcur f u := by
    intro c f u hf
    change B.curryLeft (c • f) u = c • B.curryLeft f u
    rw [map_smul]
    rfl
  have hBmeas : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        Measurable (Bcur f u) := by
    intro f u hf hu
    simpa only [Bcur, MultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply] using
      hB_measurable (Fin.cons f u) (fun i ↦ Fin.cases hf (fun j ↦ hu j) i)
  have hBpair : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
      (h : SimpleFunc Y ℂ), Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ →
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν →
        Integrable (fun y ↦ Bcur f u y * h y) ν := by
    intro f u h hf hu hh
    simpa only [Bcur, MultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply] using
      hB_pair_integrable (Fin.cons f u) h (fun i ↦ Fin.cases hf (fun j ↦ hu j) i) hh
  have hBbound₀ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
      eLpNorm (Bcur f u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₀ 0) μ *
        ∏ i, eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i.succ) μ := by
    intro f u hf hu
    simpa only [Bcur, MultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero,
      Fin.cons_succ, mul_assoc] using
      hB_bound₀ (Fin.cons f u) (fun i ↦ Fin.cases hf (fun j ↦ hu j) i)
  have hBbound₁ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
      eLpNorm (Bcur f u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₁ 0) μ *
        ∏ i, eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i.succ) μ := by
    intro f u hf hu
    simpa only [Bcur, MultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero,
      Fin.cons_succ, mul_assoc] using
      hB_bound₁ (Fin.cons f u) (fun i ↦ Fin.cases hf (fun j ↦ hu j) i)
  have hBanalytic : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (h : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν →
    DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∫ y,
        Bcur f
          (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p (fun i ↦ g i.succ) z i) y * h y ∂ν)
        (verticalStrip 0 1) := by
    intro f h hf hh
    simpa only [Bcur, MultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply] using
      aux_multilinear_pairing_analytic B f (fun i ↦ g i.succ) h hf (fun i ↦ hg i.succ) hh
        (fun u hu hh' ↦ hB_pair_integrable u h hu hh')
  have hBgrowth : ∃ a : ℝ, a < Real.pi ∧
      ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (h : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
        Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν →
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
          ‖∫ y, Bcur f
            (fun i ↦ aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p (fun i ↦ g i.succ) z i) y * h y ∂ν‖ ≤
              Real.exp (C * Real.exp (a * |(z : ℂ).im|)) := by
    refine ⟨0, Real.pi_pos, ?_⟩
    intro f h hf hh
    simpa only [Bcur, MultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply] using
      aux_multilinear_pairing_growth B f (fun i ↦ g i.succ) h hf (fun i ↦ hg i.succ) hh
        (fun u hu hh' ↦ hB_pair_integrable u h hu hh')
  have hcons : Fin.cons (g 0) (fun i ↦ g i.succ) = g := Fin.cons_self_tail g
  simpa only [Fin.cons_zero, Bcur, MultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply, hcons] using
    aux_multilinear_interpolation_two_endpoint_normalized Bcur hθ hp₀ hp₁ hp hp_top hint hq
      hM₀ hM₁ hB_add hB_smul hBmeas hBpair hBbound₀ hBbound₁ (g 0) (fun i ↦ g i.succ)
      (hg 0) (fun i ↦ hg i.succ) hgnorm hBanalytic hBgrowth

name: Auto.convexHull_subset_of_binary
statement:
theorem convexHull_subset_of_binary
    {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] [Module ℝ E] {S G : Set E}
    (hS : S ⊆ G)
    (hbinary : ∀ x ∈ G, ∀ y ∈ G, ∀ a b : ℝ,
      0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 → a • x + b • y ∈ G) :
    convexHull ℝ S ⊆ G
proof:
:=
  convexHull_min hS ((convex_iff_add_mem).2 hbinary)

name: Auto.aux_eLpNorm_normalize_simpleFunc
statement:
private theorem aux_eLpNorm_normalize_simpleFunc
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}
    (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (p : ENNReal)
    (hzero : eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p μ ≠ 0)
    (htop : eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p μ ≠ ∞) :
    eLpNorm (((eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p μ).toReal⁻¹ : ℂ) • f : X → ℂ) p μ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let N : ENNReal := eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p μ
  have hNpos : 0 < N.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hzero htop
  rw [eLpNorm_const_smul]
  change ‖(N.toReal⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ₑ * N = 1
  have hnorm : ‖(N.toReal⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ₑ = ENNReal.ofReal (N.toReal⁻¹) := by
    rw [← ofReal_norm]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hNpos.le)]
  rw [hnorm, ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hNpos, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal htop]
  exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hzero htop

name: Auto.aux_multilinear_rescale_tail
statement:
private theorem aux_multilinear_rescale_tail
    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Y → ℂ))
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (c : Fin m → ℂ) :
    B (Fin.cons (g 0) (fun i ↦ c i • g i.succ)) =
      (∏ i, c i) • B g
proof:
:= by
  change B.curryLeft (g 0) (fun i ↦ c i • g i.succ) = (∏ i, c i) • B g
  rw [(B.curryLeft (g 0)).map_smul_univ]
  congr 1
  change B (Fin.cons (g 0) (fun i ↦ g i.succ)) = B g
  exact congrArg B (Fin.cons_self_tail g)

name: Auto.aux_enorm_prod_inv_toReal
statement:
private theorem aux_enorm_prod_inv_toReal
    {m : ℕ} (N : Fin m → ENNReal)
    (hzero : ∀ i, N i ≠ 0) (htop : ∀ i, N i ≠ ∞) :
    ‖∏ i, ((N i).toReal⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ₑ = (∏ i, N i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∀ i, 0 < (N i).toReal := fun i ↦ ENNReal.toReal_pos (hzero i) (htop i)
  have hscalar : ∀ i, ‖((N i).toReal⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ₑ = (N i)⁻¹ := by
    intro i
    rw [← ofReal_norm, ← Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (hpos i).le), ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (hpos i),
      ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (htop i)]
  calc
    ‖∏ i, ((N i).toReal⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ₑ = ENNReal.ofReal ‖∏ i, ((N i).toReal⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ :=
      (ofReal_norm _).symm
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, ‖((N i).toReal⁻¹ : ℂ)‖) := by rw [norm_prod]
    _ = ∏ i, ENNReal.ofReal ‖((N i).toReal⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg]
      intro i hi
      exact norm_nonneg _
    _ = ∏ i, (N i)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      simpa only [ofReal_norm] using hscalar i
    _ = (∏ i, N i)⁻¹ := by
      rw [ENNReal.prod_inv_distrib]
      intro i hi j hj hij
      exact Or.inl (hzero i)

name: Auto.multilinear_interpolation_two_endpoint
statement:
theorem multilinear_interpolation_two_endpoint
    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Y → ℂ))
    {p₀ p₁ p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal} {q : ENNReal} {θ M₀ M₁ : ℝ}
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp₀ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₀ i) (hp₁ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₁ i) (hp : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p i)
    (hp_top : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hint : ∀ i, (p i)⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * (p₀ i)⁻¹ +
      ENNReal.ofReal θ * (p₁ i)⁻¹)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hM₀ : 0 < M₀) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)
    (hB_measurable : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Measurable (B u))
    (hB_pair_integrable : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
      (h : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν →
        Integrable (fun y ↦ B u y * h y) ν)
    (hB_bound₀ : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        eLpNorm (B u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i) μ)
    (hB_bound₁ : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        eLpNorm (B u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i) μ)
    (hzero : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1)),
      eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p i) μ = 0 → eLpNorm (B u) q ν = 0)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) :
    eLpNorm (B g) q ν ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
        eLpNorm (g 0 : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ *
          ∏ i : Fin m, eLpNorm (g i.succ : X → ℂ) (p i.succ) μ
proof:
:= by
  let N : Fin m → ENNReal := fun i ↦ eLpNorm (g i.succ : X → ℂ) (p i.succ) μ
  by_cases hNzero : ∃ i, N i = 0
  · rcases hNzero with ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hBgzero : eLpNorm (B g) q ν = 0 := hzero g i.succ hi
    have hprodzero : ∏ i, N i = 0 := Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) hi
    rw [hBgzero, hprodzero]
    simp
  have hNnezero : ∀ i, N i ≠ 0 := fun i hi ↦ hNzero ⟨i, hi⟩
  by_cases hNtop : ∃ i, N i = ∞
  · rcases hNtop with ⟨i, hi⟩
    by_cases hgzero : eLpNorm (g 0 : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ = 0
    · have hBgzero : eLpNorm (B g) q ν = 0 := hzero g 0 hgzero
      rw [hBgzero]
      simp
    have hprodt : ∏ i, N i = ∞ :=
      WithTop.prod_eq_top (Finset.mem_univ i) hi (fun j hj ↦ hNnezero j)
    have hKpos : 0 < Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ :=
      mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hM₀ _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hM₁ _)
    have hKne : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) ≠ 0 :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.mpr hKpos
    calc
      eLpNorm (B g) q ν ≤ ∞ := le_top
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
          eLpNorm (g 0 : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ * ∏ i, N i := by
        rw [hprodt, ENNReal.mul_top (mul_ne_zero hKne hgzero)]
  have hNfinite : ∀ i, N i ≠ ∞ := fun i hi ↦ hNtop ⟨i, hi⟩
  let c : Fin m → ℂ := fun i ↦ ((N i).toReal⁻¹ : ℂ)
  let g' : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ :=
    Fin.cons (g 0) (fun i ↦ c i • g i.succ)
  have hg' : ∀ i, Integrable (g' i : X → ℂ) μ := by
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases (hg 0) ?_ i
    intro j
    change Integrable (fun x ↦ c j * (g j.succ) x) μ
    exact (hg j.succ).const_mul (c j)
  have hgnorm' : ∀ i : Fin m, eLpNorm (g' i.succ : X → ℂ) (p i.succ) μ ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    simpa only [g', c, N, Fin.cons_succ, SimpleFunc.coe_smul] using
      (aux_eLpNorm_normalize_simpleFunc (g i.succ) (p i.succ) (hNnezero i) (hNfinite i)).le
  obtain ⟨hmem, hbound⟩ := multilinear_interpolation_two_endpoint_normalized B hθ hp₀ hp₁ hp
    hp_top hint hq hM₀ hM₁ hB_measurable hB_pair_integrable hB_bound₀ hB_bound₁ g' hg' hgnorm'
  have hBg' : B g' = (∏ i, c i) • B g := by
    exact aux_multilinear_rescale_tail B g c
  have hscaled : (∏ i, N i)⁻¹ * eLpNorm (B g) q ν ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
        eLpNorm (g 0 : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ := by
    calc
      (∏ i, N i)⁻¹ * eLpNorm (B g) q ν = eLpNorm (B g') q ν := by
        rw [hBg', eLpNorm_const_smul]
        change (∏ i, N i)⁻¹ * eLpNorm (B g) q ν =
          ‖∏ i, ((N i).toReal⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ₑ * eLpNorm (B g) q ν
        rw [aux_enorm_prod_inv_toReal N hNnezero hNfinite]
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
          eLpNorm (g' 0 : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ := hbound
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
          eLpNorm (g 0 : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ := by simp only [g', Fin.cons_zero]
  have hprodnezero : (∏ i, N i) ≠ 0 :=
    Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i hi ↦ hNnezero i
  have hprodfinite : (∏ i, N i) ≠ ∞ :=
    ENNReal.prod_ne_top fun i hi ↦ hNfinite i
  calc
    eLpNorm (B g) q ν ≤ (∏ i, N i) *
        (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
          eLpNorm (g 0 : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ) :=
      (ENNReal.inv_mul_le_iff hprodnezero hprodfinite).mp hscaled
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
        eLpNorm (g 0 : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ * ∏ i, N i := by ac_rfl
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
        eLpNorm (g 0 : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ *
          ∏ i : Fin m, eLpNorm (g i.succ : X → ℂ) (p i.succ) μ := by rfl

name: Auto.aux_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal_inv
statement:
private theorem aux_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal_inv
    {m : ℕ} (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (hui : 0 < u i) :
    (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i)⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (u i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [multilinearExponentOfReciprocal, ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hui]
  simp

name: Auto.aux_one_le_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal
statement:
private theorem aux_one_le_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal
    {m : ℕ} (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 1))
    (hui : 0 < u i) (hui_one : u i ≤ 1) :
    1 ≤ multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i
proof:
:= by
  rw [multilinearExponentOfReciprocal, ← ENNReal.ofReal_one]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ((one_le_inv₀ hui).mpr hui_one)

name: Auto.aux_reciprocal_box_binary
statement:
private theorem aux_reciprocal_box_binary
    {m : ℕ} (u v : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1) (hv : ∀ i, 0 < v i ∧ v i ≤ 1)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    ∀ i, 0 < (a • u + b • v) i ∧ (a • u + b • v) i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  change 0 < a * u i + b * v i ∧ a * u i + b * v i ≤ 1
  constructor
  · by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
      rw [ha0, hb1]
      simpa using (hv i).1
    · have hapos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hapos (hu i).1)
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hb (hv i).1.le))
  · calc
      a * u i + b * v i ≤ a * 1 + b * 1 :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hu i).2 ha)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv i).2 hb)
      _ = 1 := by linarith

name: Auto.aux_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal_interpolation
statement:
private theorem aux_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal_interpolation
    {m : ℕ} (u v : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1) (hv : ∀ i, 0 < v i ∧ v i ≤ 1)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal (a • u + b • v) i)⁻¹ =
      ENNReal.ofReal a * (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i)⁻¹ +
        ENNReal.ofReal b * (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal v i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hw := aux_reciprocal_box_binary u v a b hu hv ha hb hab i
  rw [aux_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal_inv _ i hw.1,
    aux_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal_inv _ i (hu i).1,
    aux_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal_inv _ i (hv i).1]
  change ENNReal.ofReal (a * u i + b * v i) =
    ENNReal.ofReal a * ENNReal.ofReal (u i) + ENNReal.ofReal b * ENNReal.ofReal (v i)
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (mul_nonneg ha (hu i).1.le) (mul_nonneg hb (hv i).1.le),
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul ha, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hb]

name: Auto.multilinear_interpolation_convexHull
statement:
theorem multilinear_interpolation_convexHull
    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Y → ℂ))
    (q : ENNReal) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hB_measurable : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Measurable (B u))
    (hB_pair_integrable : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
      (h : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν →
        Integrable (fun y ↦ B u y * h y) ν)
    (S : Set (Fin (m + 1) → ℝ))
    (hSbox : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1)
    (hendpoint : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        eLpNorm (B g) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ)
    (hzero : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1)),
        eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ = 0 →
          eLpNorm (B g) q ν = 0)
    (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ convexHull ℝ S)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) :
    eLpNorm (B g) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A * ∏ i,
      eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ
proof:
:= by
  let G : Set (Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) := {w | (∀ i, 0 < w i ∧ w i ≤ 1) ∧
    ∀ h : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (h i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        eLpNorm (B h) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A *
          eLpNorm (h 0 : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal w 0) μ *
            ∏ i : Fin m, eLpNorm (h i.succ : X → ℂ)
              (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal w i.succ) μ}
  have hSsub : S ⊆ G := by
    intro w hw
    refine ⟨hSbox w hw, ?_⟩
    intro h hh
    simpa only [Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_assoc] using hendpoint w hw h hh
  have hbinary : ∀ x ∈ G, ∀ y ∈ G, ∀ a b : ℝ,
      0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 → a • x + b • y ∈ G := by
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    have hxbox : ∀ i, 0 < x i ∧ x i ≤ 1 := hx.1
    have hybox : ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i ≤ 1 := hy.1
    have hwbox : ∀ i, 0 < (a • x + b • y) i ∧ (a • x + b • y) i ≤ 1 :=
      aux_reciprocal_box_binary x y a b hxbox hybox ha hb hab
    refine ⟨hwbox, ?_⟩
    intro h hh
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
      have hxy : a • x + b • y = y := by
        ext i
        simp [ha0, hb1]
      simpa only [hxy] using hy.2 h hh
    by_cases hb0 : b = 0
    · have ha1 : a = 1 := by linarith
      have hxy : a • x + b • y = x := by
        ext i
        simp [hb0, ha1]
      simpa only [hxy] using hx.2 h hh
    have hapos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
    have hbpos : 0 < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb (Ne.symm hb0)
    have hθ : b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 := ⟨hbpos, by linarith⟩
    have haeq : a = 1 - b := by linarith
    have hp₀ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ multilinearExponentOfReciprocal x i := by
      intro i
      exact aux_one_le_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal x i (hxbox i).1 (hxbox i).2
    have hp₁ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ multilinearExponentOfReciprocal y i := by
      intro i
      exact aux_one_le_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal y i (hybox i).1 (hybox i).2
    have hp : ∀ i, 1 ≤ multilinearExponentOfReciprocal (a • x + b • y) i := by
      intro i
      exact aux_one_le_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal (a • x + b • y) i
        (hwbox i).1 (hwbox i).2
    have hptop : ∀ i, multilinearExponentOfReciprocal (a • x + b • y) i ≠ ∞ := by
      intro i
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    have hinterp : ∀ i,
        (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal (a • x + b • y) i)⁻¹ =
          ENNReal.ofReal (1 - b) * (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal x i)⁻¹ +
            ENNReal.ofReal b * (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal y i)⁻¹ := by
      intro i
      simpa only [haeq] using
        aux_multilinearExponentOfReciprocal_interpolation x y a b hxbox hybox ha hb hab i
    have hBx : ∀ r : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
        (∀ i, Integrable (r i : X → ℂ) μ) →
          eLpNorm (B r) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A * ∏ i,
            eLpNorm (r i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal x i) μ := by
      intro r hr
      simpa only [Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_assoc] using hx.2 r hr
    have hBy : ∀ r : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
        (∀ i, Integrable (r i : X → ℂ) μ) →
          eLpNorm (B r) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A * ∏ i,
            eLpNorm (r i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal y i) μ := by
      intro r hr
      simpa only [Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_assoc] using hy.2 r hr
    have hzero' : ∀ (r : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1)),
        eLpNorm (r i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal (a • x + b • y) i) μ = 0 →
          eLpNorm (B r) q ν = 0 :=
      hzero (a • x + b • y) hwbox
    have hAinterp : Real.rpow A (1 - b) * Real.rpow A b = A := by
      calc
        Real.rpow A (1 - b) * Real.rpow A b = Real.rpow A ((1 - b) + b) :=
          (Real.rpow_add hA _ _).symm
        _ = A := by
          rw [show (1 - b) + b = 1 by ring]
          simp
    simpa only [hAinterp] using
      multilinear_interpolation_two_endpoint B hθ hp₀ hp₁ hp hptop hinterp hq hA hA
        hB_measurable hB_pair_integrable hBx hBy hzero' h hh
  have huG : u ∈ G := convexHull_subset_of_binary hSsub hbinary hu

name: Auto.aux_extendLpCMLMToSimpleFuncIntegrable_eq_zero_of_eLpNorm_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem aux_extendLpCMLMToSimpleFuncIntegrable_eq_zero_of_eLpNorm_eq_zero
    {m : ℕ} {X F : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal) (μ : Measure X) [∀ i, Fact (1 ≤ p i)]
    (hp_top : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (B : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℂ (fun i ↦ Lp ℂ (p i) μ) F)
    (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1))
    (hzero : eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ = 0) :
    aux_extendLpCMLMToSimpleFuncIntegrable p μ hp_top B g = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hqne : multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i ≠ 0 := by
    unfold multilinearExponentOfReciprocal
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (inv_pos.mpr (hu i).1)).ne'
  have hzero_ae : (g i : X → ℂ) =ᵐ[μ] 0 :=
    (eLpNorm_eq_zero_iff (g i).aestronglyMeasurable hqne).mp hzero
  have hgi_int : Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ :=
    (integrable_congr hzero_ae).mpr (integrable_zero X ℂ μ)
  have hgi_mem : MemLp (g i : X → ℂ) (p i) μ :=
    (SimpleFunc.memLp_iff_integrable
      (aux_simpleFuncExponent_ne_zero (p := p i)) (hp_top i)).mpr hgi_int
  have hinputzero :
      aux_integrableSimpleFuncToLp (p i) μ (hp_top i)
        (aux_integrableSimpleFuncRetract μ (g i)) = 0 := by
    rw [aux_integrableSimpleFuncRetract_apply_of_integrable μ (g i) hgi_int]
    rw [aux_integrableSimpleFuncToLp_apply (p i) μ (hp_top i) (g i) hgi_int]
    apply Lp.eq_zero_iff_ae_eq_zero.mpr
    exact (MemLp.coeFn_toLp hgi_mem).trans hzero_ae
  unfold aux_extendLpCMLMToSimpleFuncIntegrable
  exact B.toMultilinearMap.map_coord_zero i hinputzero

name: Auto.aux_extendLpCMLMToSimpleFuncIntegrable_enorm_eq_zero_of_eLpNorm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem aux_extendLpCMLMToSimpleFuncIntegrable_enorm_eq_zero_of_eLpNorm_eq_zero
    {m : ℕ} {X F : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal) (μ : Measure X) [∀ i, Fact (1 ≤ p i)]

    (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1))
    (hzero : eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ = 0) :
    ‖aux_extendLpCMLMToSimpleFuncIntegrable p μ hp_top B g‖ₑ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [aux_extendLpCMLMToSimpleFuncIntegrable_eq_zero_of_eLpNorm_eq_zero
    p μ hp_top B u hu g i hzero]

name: Auto.aux_denseRange_integrableSimpleFuncToLp
statement:
theorem aux_denseRange_integrableSimpleFuncToLp {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (p : ENNReal) (μ : Measure X) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (hp_top : p ≠ ∞) :
    DenseRange (aux_integrableSimpleFuncToLp p μ hp_top)
proof:
:= by
  change Dense (Set.range (aux_integrableSimpleFuncToLp p μ hp_top))
  apply Dense.mono ?_ (Lp.simpleFunc.denseRange (E := ℂ) (μ := μ) hp_top)
  rintro f ⟨g, rfl⟩
  have hg_int : Integrable (Lp.simpleFunc.toSimpleFunc g : X → ℂ) μ :=
    (SimpleFunc.memLp_iff_integrable
      (aux_simpleFuncExponent_ne_zero (p := p)) hp_top).mp
      (Lp.simpleFunc.memLp g)
  refine ⟨⟨Lp.simpleFunc.toSimpleFunc g, memLp_one_iff_integrable.mpr hg_int⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [aux_integrableSimpleFuncToLp_apply p μ hp_top (Lp.simpleFunc.toSimpleFunc g) hg_int]
  change (Lp.simpleFunc.memLp g).toLp (Lp.simpleFunc.toSimpleFunc g) = (g : Lp ℂ p μ)
  rw [← Lp.simpleFunc.toLp_eq_toLp]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (Lp.simpleFunc.toLp_toSimpleFunc g)

name: Auto.aux_ContinuousMultilinearMap_norm_le_of_denseRange
statement:
theorem aux_ContinuousMultilinearMap_norm_le_of_denseRange
    {𝕜 ι F : Type*} {E₀ E : ι → Type*}
    [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [Fintype ι]
    [∀ i, SeminormedAddCommGroup (E₀ i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace 𝕜 (E₀ i)]
    [∀ i, SeminormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace 𝕜 (E i)]
    [SeminormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
    (B : ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 E F)
    (e : ∀ i, E₀ i →L[𝕜] E i) (he : ∀ i, DenseRange (e i))
    (C : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ x : ∀ i, E₀ i,
      ‖B (fun i ↦ e i (x i))‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, ‖e i (x i)‖) :
    ∀ x : ∀ i, E i, ‖B x‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, ‖x i‖
proof:
:= by
  let P : (∀ i, E i) → Prop := fun x ↦ ‖B x‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, ‖x i‖
  have hleft : Continuous fun x : ∀ i, E i ↦ ‖B x‖ := B.cont.norm
  have hprod : Continuous fun x : ∀ i, E i ↦ ∏ i, ‖x i‖ := by
    apply continuous_finsetProd Finset.univ
    intro i _
    exact continuous_norm.comp (continuous_apply i)
  have hright : Continuous fun x : ∀ i, E i ↦ C * ∏ i, ‖x i‖ :=
    continuous_const.mul hprod
  have hclosed : IsClosed {x : ∀ i, E i | P x} := by
    exact isClosed_le hleft hright
  intro x
  refine (DenseRange.piMap he).induction_on x hclosed ?_
  intro y
  exact hbound y

name: Auto.aux_enorm_sq_le_of_norm_sq_le
statement:
theorem aux_enorm_sq_le_of_norm_sq_le
    {ι F : Type*} [Fintype ι] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    {E : ι → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)]
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (y : F) (x : ∀ i, E i)
    (h : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ K * ∏ i, ‖x i‖ ^ 2) :
    ‖y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal K * ∏ i, ‖x i‖ₑ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖y‖ₑ ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal (‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _) 2, ofReal_norm]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * ∏ i, ‖x i‖ ^ 2) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal K * ∏ i, ‖x i‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul hK,
        ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ sq_nonneg (‖x i‖))]
      apply congrArg (fun z : ℝ≥0∞ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal K * z)
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _) 2, ofReal_norm]

name: Auto.aux_norm_sq_le_of_enorm_sq_le
statement:
theorem aux_norm_sq_le_of_enorm_sq_le
    {ι F : Type*} [Fintype ι] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    {E : ι → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)]
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (y : F) (x : ∀ i, E i)
    (h : ‖y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal K * ∏ i, ‖x i‖ₑ ^ 2) :
    ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ K * ∏ i, ‖x i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : ‖y‖ₑ ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal (‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _) 2, ofReal_norm]
  have hright : ENNReal.ofReal K * ∏ i, ‖x i‖ₑ ^ 2 =
      ENNReal.ofReal (K * ∏ i, ‖x i‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul hK,
      ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ sq_nonneg (‖x i‖))]
    apply congrArg (fun z : ℝ≥0∞ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal K * z)
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _) 2, ofReal_norm]
  rw [hleft, hright] at h
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff
    (mul_nonneg hK (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ sq_nonneg (‖x i‖)))).mp h

name: Auto.aux_schwartz_sq_bound
statement:
theorem aux_schwartz_sq_bound
    {ι X F : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [MeasurableSpace X]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X]
    [SecondCountableTopologyEither X ℂ]
    {μ : Measure X} [μ.HasTemperateGrowth] [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (p : ι → ℝ≥0∞) [∀ i, Fact (1 ≤ p i)]
    (hpfin : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (B : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℂ (fun i ↦ Lp ℂ (p i) μ) F)
    (K : ℝ)
    (hcore : ∀ f : ι → SchwartzMap X ℂ,
      ‖B.toMultilinearMap (fun i ↦ (f i).toLp (p i) μ)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        K * ∏ i, ‖(f i).toLp (p i) μ‖ ^ 2) :
    ∀ g : (i : ι) → Lp ℂ (p i) μ,
      ‖B.toMultilinearMap g‖ ^ 2 ≤ K * ∏ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let BR : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun i ↦ Lp ℂ (p i) μ) F :=
    B.restrictScalars ℝ
  have hdense (i : ι) : DenseRange (SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℂ (p i) μ) :=
    SchwartzMap.denseRange_toLpCLM (E := X) (F := ℂ) (μ := μ)
      (p := p i) (hpfin i)
  let P : ((i : ι) → Lp ℂ (p i) μ) → Prop :=
    fun g ↦ ‖BR g‖ ^ 2 ≤ K * ∏ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2
  have hleft : Continuous fun g : (i : ι) → Lp ℂ (p i) μ ↦ ‖BR g‖ ^ 2 :=
    BR.cont.norm.pow 2
  have hprod : Continuous fun g : (i : ι) → Lp ℂ (p i) μ ↦ ∏ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2 := by
    apply continuous_finsetProd Finset.univ
    intro i _
    exact (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_apply i)).pow 2
  have hclosed : IsClosed {g : (i : ι) → Lp ℂ (p i) μ | P g} := by
    exact isClosed_le hleft (continuous_const.mul hprod)
  intro g
  change P g
  refine (DenseRange.piMap hdense).induction_on g hclosed ?_
  intro f
  change ‖B.toMultilinearMap (fun i ↦ (f i).toLp (p i) μ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
  exact hcore f

name: Auto.multilinear_interpolation_convexHull_Lp
statement:
theorem multilinear_interpolation_convexHull_Lp
    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Lp ℂ 2 ν))
    (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (S : Set (Fin (m + 1) → ℝ))
    (hSbox : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1)
    (hendpoint : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        ‖B g‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ)
    (hzero : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1)),
        eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ = 0 →
          ‖B g‖ₑ = 0)
    (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ convexHull ℝ S)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) :
    ‖B g‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A * ∏ i,
      eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ
proof:
:= by
  let B' := aux_multilinearLpRepresentative (Y := Y) (ν := ν) B
  have hB_measurable : ∀ r : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (r i : X → ℂ) μ) → Measurable (B' r) := by
    intro r hr
    exact (aux_multilinearLpRepresentative_stronglyMeasurable (Y := Y) (ν := ν) B r).measurable
  have hB_pair_integrable : ∀ (r : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
      (h : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      (∀ i, Integrable (r i : X → ℂ) μ) → Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν →
        Integrable (fun y ↦ B' r y * h y) ν := by
    intro r h hr hh
    have hBr : MemLp (B' r) 2 ν :=
      aux_multilinearLpRepresentative_memLp (Y := Y) (ν := ν) B r
    have hh2 : MemLp (h : Y → ℂ) 2 ν := by
      rw [SimpleFunc.memLp_iff_integrable (p := (2 : ENNReal)) (by norm_num)
        ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top]
      exact hh
    apply (hBr.integrable_mul hh2).congr
    filter_upwards with y
    exact Pi.mul_apply (B' r) (h : Y → ℂ) y
  have hendpoint' : ∀ w ∈ S, ∀ r : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (r i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        eLpNorm (B' r) 2 ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (r i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal w i) μ := by
    intro w hw r hr
    change eLpNorm (aux_multilinearLpRepresentative (Y := Y) (ν := ν) B r) 2 ν ≤ _
    rw [aux_eLpNorm_multilinearLpRepresentative]
    rw [← Lp.enorm_def]
    exact hendpoint w hw r hr
  have hzero' : ∀ (w : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 < w i ∧ w i ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (r : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1)),
        eLpNorm (r i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal w i) μ = 0 →
          eLpNorm (B' r) 2 ν = 0 := by
    intro w hw r i hri
    change eLpNorm (aux_multilinearLpRepresentative (Y := Y) (ν := ν) B r) 2 ν = 0
    rw [aux_eLpNorm_multilinearLpRepresentative]
    rw [← Lp.enorm_def]
    exact hzero w hw r i hri
  have h := multilinear_interpolation_convexHull B' 2 (by norm_num) A hA
    hB_measurable hB_pair_integrable S hSbox hendpoint' hzero' u hu g hg
  rw [Lp.enorm_def]
  rw [← aux_eLpNorm_multilinearLpRepresentative (Y := Y) (ν := ν) B g]
  exact h

name: Auto.multilinear_interpolation_convexHull_Lp_sq
statement:
theorem multilinear_interpolation_convexHull_Lp_sq
    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Lp ℂ 2 ν))
    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (S : Set (Fin (m + 1) → ℝ))
    (hSbox : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1)
    (hendpoint : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        ‖B g‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ ^ 2)
    (hzero : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1)),
        eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ = 0 →
          ‖B g‖ₑ = 0)
    (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ convexHull ℝ S)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) :
    ‖B g‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D * ∏ i,
      eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrtD : 0 < Real.sqrt D := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hD
  have hcoef : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt D) ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal D := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) 2]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hD.le]
  have hprod_sq (w : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (r : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) :
      (∏ i, eLpNorm (r i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal w i) μ) ^ 2 =
        ∏ i, eLpNorm (r i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal w i) μ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only using
      (Finset.prod_pow (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (m + 1))) 2
        (fun i ↦ eLpNorm (r i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal w i) μ)).symm
  have hroot_endpoint : ∀ w ∈ S, ∀ r : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (r i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        ‖B r‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt D) * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (r i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal w i) μ := by
    intro w hw r hr
    apply (ENNReal.pow_le_pow_left_iff (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp
    calc
      ‖B r‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (r i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal w i) μ ^ 2 :=
        hendpoint w hw r hr
      _ = (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt D) * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (r i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal w i) μ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, hcoef, hprod_sq]
  have hroot := multilinear_interpolation_convexHull_Lp B (Real.sqrt D) hsqrtD S hSbox
    hroot_endpoint hzero u hu g hg
  calc
    ‖B g‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt D) * ∏ i,
        eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ) ^ 2 :=
      ENNReal.pow_le_pow_left hroot
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal D * ∏ i,
        eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, hcoef, hprod_sq]

name: Auto.aux_eLpNorm_two_sq_eq_lintegral
statement:
theorem aux_eLpNorm_two_sq_eq_lintegral {X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [ENorm E]
