name: Auto.aux_finite_forward_jump_energy_lower
statement:
theorem aux_finite_forward_jump_energy_lower {n J : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : ε < 1) (hεδ : ε ≤ δ)
    (hwidth : ε + δ < 1) (N : Fin (J + 1) → ℕ)
    (hN : StrictMono N) (hNpos : ∀ q, 0 < N q)
    (F : Fin n → (Fin n → ℕ) → ℝ) (A : Finset (Fin n → ℕ)) :
    (ENNReal.ofReal (δ - ε) ^ (2 : ℝ) * ENNReal.ofReal ε ^ n) *
        ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ A,
          ‖aux_discreteAverage (N j.succ) F k -
            aux_discreteAverage (N j.castSucc) F k‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤
      ctEndpointEnergy J (fun q ↦ (N q : ℝ)) ctUnitIntervalKernel
        (fun i ↦ aux_liftRaw (aux_cuboidEmbed ε δ i
          (aux_natToInt (aux_truncate
            (aux_localInputSupport A (N (Fin.last J))) (F i)))))
proof:
:= by
  let L : ℕ := N (Fin.last J)
  let B : Finset (Fin n → ℕ) := aux_localInputSupport A L
  let F' : Fin n → (Fin n → ℕ) → ℝ := fun i ↦ aux_truncate B (F i)
  let a : Fin n → aux_ZVector n → ℝ := fun i ↦ aux_natToInt (F' i)
  have hscale : ∀ q : Fin (J + 1), N q ≤ L := by
    intro q
    exact hN.monotone (Fin.le_last q)
  have hsupport : ∀ i z, z ∉ B.map aux_CuboidNorm.natToIntEmbedding → a i z = 0 := by
    intro i z hz
    exact aux_CuboidNorm.natToInt_support_map B (F' i) (by
      intro k hk
      simp [F', aux_truncate, hk]) z hz
  have havg : ∀ (q : Fin (J + 1)) (k : Fin n → ℕ), k ∈ A →
      aux_integerDiscreteAverage (N q) a (aux_CuboidNorm.natToIntEmbedding k) =
        aux_discreteAverage (N q) F k := by
    intro q k hk
    calc
      aux_integerDiscreteAverage (N q) a (aux_CuboidNorm.natToIntEmbedding k) =
          aux_discreteAverage (N q) F' k := by
        exact aux_integerDiscreteAverage_natToInt (N q) F' k
      _ = aux_discreteAverage (N q) F k := by
        exact aux_discreteAverage_truncate_eq_of_mem (hscale q) F hk
  have hlower := aux_CuboidNorm.finite_jump_energy_lower_on_of_overlap_formula
    hn hε hεδ hwidth N hNpos a (A.map aux_CuboidNorm.natToIntEmbedding)
  have hsum :
      ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ z ∈ A.map aux_CuboidNorm.natToIntEmbedding,
          ‖aux_integerDiscreteAverage (N j.succ) a z -
            aux_integerDiscreteAverage (N j.castSucc) a z‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) =
        ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ A,
          ‖aux_discreteAverage (N j.succ) F k -
            aux_discreteAverage (N j.castSucc) F k‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [Finset.sum_map]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [havg j.succ k hk, havg j.castSucc k hk]
  rw [hsum, aux_CuboidNorm.raw_cuboid_jumpEnergy_eq_endpointEnergy] at hlower
  simpa only [L, B, F', a] using hlower

name: Auto.aux_cuboid_factor_mul_dyadic
statement:
theorem aux_cuboid_factor_mul_dyadic (n : ℕ) :
    (ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ (2 : ℝ) *
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ n) *
      ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (3 * n + 6)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos]
  have h8 : (8 : ℝ≥0∞) = (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 3 := by norm_num
  rw [h8, ENNReal.inv_pow]
  rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  have hexp : 3 * 2 + 3 * n = 3 * n + 6 := by omega
  rw [hexp, ← ENNReal.inv_pow]
  exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: Auto.aux_ofReal_dyadic_power
statement:
theorem aux_ofReal_dyadic_power (n : ℕ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6)) =
      ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (3 * n + 6))
proof:
:= by
  norm_num

name: Auto.aux_finite_continuous_to_discrete_constant_bridge
statement:
theorem aux_finite_continuous_to_discrete_constant_bridge {n : ℕ}
    (C g : ℝ) (D E : ℝ≥0∞) (L F : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hlower :
      (ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ (2 : ℝ) *
        ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ n) * D ≤ E)
    (hupper : E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C * ENNReal.ofReal g *
      ∏ i, L i ^ (2 : ℕ))
    (hL : ∀ i, L i ≤ F i) :
    D ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6)) * C) *
      ENNReal.ofReal g * ∏ i, F i ^ (2 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  let K : ℝ≥0∞ := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (3 * n + 6)
  have hK :
      (ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ (2 : ℝ) *
        ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ n) * K = 1 := by
    exact aux_cuboid_factor_mul_dyadic n
  have hDE : D ≤ K * E := by
    calc
      D =
          ((ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ (2 : ℝ) *
            ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ n) * K) * D := by
              rw [hK, one_mul]
      _ = K *
          ((ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ (2 : ℝ) *
            ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ n) * D) := by
              ac_rfl
      _ ≤ K * E := mul_le_mul_right hlower K
  have hprod : ∏ i, L i ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ ∏ i, F i ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod'
    intro i hi
    exact pow_le_pow_left' (hL i) 2
  calc
    D ≤ K * E := hDE
    _ ≤ K * (ENNReal.ofReal C * ENNReal.ofReal g *
        ∏ i, L i ^ (2 : ℕ)) := mul_le_mul_right hupper K
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6)) * C) *
        ENNReal.ofReal g * ∏ i, L i ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
          have hp : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6) := by positivity
          have hcast : ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6)) *
              ENNReal.ofReal C =
              ENNReal.ofReal (((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6) * C)) :=
            (ENNReal.ofReal_mul hp).symm
          dsimp [K]
          rw [← aux_ofReal_dyadic_power n]
          rw [show ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6)) *
              (ENNReal.ofReal C * ENNReal.ofReal g *
                ∏ i, L i ^ (2 : ℕ)) =
              (ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6)) * ENNReal.ofReal C) *
                ENNReal.ofReal g * ∏ i, L i ^ (2 : ℕ) by ac_rfl,
            hcast]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6)) * C) *
        ENNReal.ofReal g * ∏ i, F i ^ (2 : ℕ) :=
      mul_le_mul_right hprod _

name: Auto.aux_finite_forward_jump_bound_of_realVariable
statement:
theorem aux_finite_forward_jump_bound_of_realVariable {n J : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (p : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞) (C : ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreal : realVariableJumpBound p C g) (hJ : 0 < J)
    (N : Fin (J + 1) → ℕ) (hN : StrictMono N)
    (hNpos : ∀ q, 0 < N q) (F : Fin n → (Fin n → ℕ) → ℝ)
    (A : Finset (Fin n → ℕ))
    (hp0 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (hptop : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞) :
    ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ A,
      ‖aux_discreteAverage (N j.succ) F k -
        aux_discreteAverage (N j.castSucc) F k‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6)) * C) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (g J) *
          ∏ i, eLpNorm (F i) (p i) Measure.count ^ (2 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  let ε : ℝ := (1 : ℝ) / 8
  let δ : ℝ := (1 : ℝ) / 4
  let L : ℕ := N (Fin.last J)
  let B : Finset (Fin n → ℕ) := aux_localInputSupport A L
  let F' : Fin n → (Fin n → ℕ) → ℝ := fun i ↦ aux_truncate B (F i)
  let a : Fin n → aux_ZVector n → ℝ := fun i ↦ aux_natToInt (F' i)
  let f : Fin n → ctRealVector n → ℝ :=
    fun i ↦ aux_liftRaw (aux_cuboidEmbed ε δ i (a i))
  let D : ℝ≥0∞ := ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ A,
    ‖aux_discreteAverage (N j.succ) F k -
      aux_discreteAverage (N j.castSucc) F k‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ)
  let E : ℝ≥0∞ := ctEndpointEnergy J (fun q ↦ (N q : ℝ))
    ctUnitIntervalKernel f
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := by dsimp [ε]; norm_num
  have hε : ε < 1 := by dsimp [ε]; norm_num
  have hεδ : ε ≤ δ := by dsimp [ε, δ]; norm_num
  have hwidth : ε + δ < 1 := by dsimp [ε, δ]; norm_num
  have ht : StrictMono (fun q : Fin (J + 1) ↦ (N q : ℝ)) := by
    intro q r hqr
    change (N q : ℝ) < (N r : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast hN hqr
  have hsupportF' : ∀ i k, k ∉ B → F' i k = 0 := by
    intro i k hk
    simp [F', aux_truncate, hk]
  have hsupport : ∀ i z, z ∉ B.map aux_CuboidNorm.natToIntEmbedding →
      a i z = 0 := by
    intro i z hz
    exact aux_CuboidNorm.natToInt_support_map B (F' i) (hsupportF' i) z hz
  have htlower :
      (ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ (2 : ℝ) *
        ENNReal.ofReal ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ n) * D ≤ E := by
    have hlow := aux_finite_forward_jump_energy_lower hn hε hεδ hwidth
      N hN hNpos F A
    rw [show δ - ε = (1 : ℝ) / 8 by dsimp [ε, δ]; norm_num] at hlow
    simpa only [D, E, ε, δ, L, B, F', a, f] using hlow
  have hmem : ∀ i, MemLp (f i) (p i) volume := by
    intro i
    dsimp [f]
    apply aux_CuboidNorm.memLp_liftedCuboidEmbed hε0 hε hwidth i
      (B.map aux_CuboidNorm.natToIntEmbedding) (a i) (hsupport i)
      (p i) (hp0 i) (hptop i)
  have hreal' := hreal J hJ (fun q ↦ (N q : ℝ)) ht
    (fun q ↦ by exact_mod_cast hNpos q) f hmem
  have hvolume : ∀ i : Fin n,
      ∏ j, ENNReal.ofReal (if j = i then δ else ε) ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    apply Finset.prod_le_one'
    intro j hj
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_le_one]
    by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [hji, ε, δ] <;> norm_num
  have hnorm : ∀ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) volume ≤
      eLpNorm (F i) (p i) Measure.count := by
    intro i
    calc
      eLpNorm (f i) (p i) volume ≤ eLpNorm (a i) (p i) Measure.count := by
        dsimp [f]
        exact aux_CuboidNorm.eLpNorm_liftedCuboidEmbed_le_count hε0 hε
          hwidth i (B.map aux_CuboidNorm.natToIntEmbedding) (a i)
          (hsupport i) (p i) (hp0 i) (hptop i) (hvolume i)
      _ = eLpNorm (F' i) (p i) Measure.count := by
        exact aux_CuboidNorm.eLpNorm_natToInt_eq_count B (F' i)
          (hsupportF' i) (p i) (hp0 i) (hptop i)
      _ ≤ eLpNorm (F i) (p i) Measure.count :=
        aux_eLpNorm_truncate_le B (F i) (p i)
  apply aux_finite_continuous_to_discrete_constant_bridge C (g J) D E
    (fun i ↦ eLpNorm (f i) (p i) volume)
    (fun i ↦ eLpNorm (F i) (p i) Measure.count) htlower
  · exact hreal'
  · exact hnorm

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.mem_box
statement:
theorem mem_box {n L : ℕ} (k : Fin n → ℕ) :
    k ∈ box n L ↔ ∀ i, k i < L
proof:
:= by
  simp [box]

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.card_box
statement: theorem card_box (n L : ℕ) : (box n L).card = L ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [box]

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.box_subset_double
statement:
theorem box_subset_double (n M : ℕ) :
    box n M ⊆ box n (M + M)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [mem_box] at hk ⊢
  intro i
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hk i) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.card_box_double
statement:
theorem card_box_double (n M : ℕ) :
    (box n (M + M)).card = 2 ^ n * (box n M).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_box, card_box]
  rw [show M + M = 2 * M by omega, Nat.mul_pow]

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.cancel_box_ratio
statement:
theorem cancel_box_ratio {n M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    {E A P : ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : ((box n M).card : ℝ≥0∞) * E ≤
      A * ((box n (M + M)).card : ℝ≥0∞) * P) :
    E ≤ A * ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * P
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : ((box n (M + M)).card : ℝ≥0∞) =
      ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ((box n M).card : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    rw [card_box_double]
    norm_cast
  have hb0 : ((box n M).card : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [card_box]
    apply ENNReal.coe_ne_zero.mpr
    norm_cast
    exact pow_ne_zero _ (Nat.ne_of_gt hM)
  have hbtop : ((box n M).card : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞ := ENNReal.coe_ne_top
  apply (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_right hb0 hbtop).mp
  calc
    ((box n M).card : ℝ≥0∞) * E ≤
        A * ((box n (M + M)).card : ℝ≥0∞) * P := h
    _ = ((box n M).card : ℝ≥0∞) *
        (A * ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * P) := by
      rw [hcard]
      ac_rfl

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.aemeasurable_enorm_rpow
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_enorm_rpow {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    {μ : Measure X} (f : X → ℝ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (p : ℝ) :
    AEMeasurable (fun x ↦ ‖f x‖ₑ ^ p) μ
proof:
:= by
  exact ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const.aemeasurable.comp_aemeasurable hf.enorm

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.lintegral_enorm_rpow_comp_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem lintegral_enorm_rpow_comp_measurePreserving
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}
    (T : X → X) (hT : MeasurePreserving T μ μ)
    (f : X → ℝ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (p : ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ x, ‖f (T x)‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ = ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  change ∫⁻ x, ((fun y ↦ ‖f y‖ₑ ^ p) ∘ T) x ∂μ = _
  rw [lintegral_comp'
    (by simpa only [hT.map_eq] using aemeasurable_enorm_rpow f hf p)
    hT.aemeasurable, hT.map_eq]

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.aemeasurable_orbitPowerSum
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_orbitPowerSum
    {X κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}
    (B : Finset κ) (T : κ → X → X)
    (hT : ∀ k ∈ B, MeasurePreserving (T k) μ μ)
    (f : X → ℝ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (p : ℝ) :
    AEMeasurable (orbitPowerSum B T f p) μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold orbitPowerSum
  simpa only [Finset.sum_fn, Function.comp_apply] using Finset.aemeasurable_sum B
    (fun k hk ↦ aemeasurable_enorm_rpow (f ∘ T k)
      (hf.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving (hT k hk).quasiMeasurePreserving) p)

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.lintegral_orbitPowerSum
statement:
theorem lintegral_orbitPowerSum
    {X κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}
    (B : Finset κ) (T : κ → X → X)
    (hT : ∀ k ∈ B, MeasurePreserving (T k) μ μ)
    (f : X → ℝ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (p : ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ x, orbitPowerSum B T f p x ∂μ =
      B.card * ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold orbitPowerSum
  rw [lintegral_finsetSum' B]
  · calc
      ∑ k ∈ B, ∫⁻ x, ‖f (T k x)‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ =
          ∑ k ∈ B, ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        exact lintegral_enorm_rpow_comp_measurePreserving (T k) (hT k hk) f hf p
      _ = B.card * ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const]
        simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
  · intro k hk
    exact aemeasurable_enorm_rpow (f ∘ T k)
      (hf.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving (hT k hk).quasiMeasurePreserving) p

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.eLpNorm_count_sq_eq_finset_sum_rpow
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_count_sq_eq_finset_sum_rpow
    {κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace κ] [Countable κ] [MeasurableSingletonClass κ]
    (B : Finset κ) (F : κ → ℝ) (p : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hptop : p ≠ ∞) (hpreal : 0 < p.toReal)
    (hF : ∀ k, k ∉ B → F k = 0) :
    eLpNorm F p Measure.count ^ 2 =
      (∑ k ∈ B, ‖F k‖ₑ ^ p.toReal) ^ (2 / p.toReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal hp0 hptop]
  rw [← ENNReal.rpow_natCast]
  rw [← ENNReal.rpow_mul]
  have hexp : (1 / p.toReal) * (↑(2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 / p.toReal := by ring
  rw [hexp]
  rw [lintegral_count]
  rw [tsum_eq_sum]
  intro k hk
  rw [hF k hk]
  simp [ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hpreal]

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.eLpNorm_sq_eq_lintegral_rpow
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_sq_eq_lintegral_rpow
    {X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [TopologicalSpace E] [ENorm E]
    (μ : Measure X) (F : X → E) (p : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hptop : p ≠ ∞) :
    eLpNorm F p μ ^ 2 =
      (∫⁻ x, ‖F x‖ₑ ^ p.toReal ∂μ) ^ (2 / p.toReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal hp0 hptop]
  rw [← ENNReal.rpow_natCast]
  rw [← ENNReal.rpow_mul]
  have hexp : (1 / p.toReal) * (↑(2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 / p.toReal := by ring
  rw [hexp]

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.prod_rpow_eq_rpow_sum_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem prod_rpow_eq_rpow_sum_of_nonneg
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (B : ℝ≥0∞) (q : ι → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, B ^ q i = B ^ (∑ i ∈ s, q i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha,
        ih (fun i hi ↦ hq i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))]
      exact (ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg (q a) (∑ i ∈ s, q i)
        (hq a (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi ↦ hq i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))).symm

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.prod_mul_rpow_eq_mul_prod_rpow
statement:
theorem prod_mul_rpow_eq_mul_prod_rpow
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (B : ℝ≥0∞) (I : ι → ℝ≥0∞)
    (q : ι → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i)
    (hqsum : ∑ i ∈ s, q i = 1) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (B * I i) ^ q i = B * ∏ i ∈ s, I i ^ q i
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ∏ i ∈ s, (B * I i) ^ q i = ∏ i ∈ s, (B ^ q i * I i ^ q i) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (hq i hi)]
    _ = (∏ i ∈ s, B ^ q i) * ∏ i ∈ s, I i ^ q i := Finset.prod_mul_distrib
    _ = B * ∏ i ∈ s, I i ^ q i := by
      rw [prod_rpow_eq_rpow_sum_of_nonneg s B q hq, hqsum, ENNReal.rpow_one]

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.eLpNorm_truncOrbit_sq
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_truncOrbit_sq
    {X κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace κ]
    [Countable κ] [MeasurableSingletonClass κ]
    (B : Finset κ) (T : κ → X → X) (f : X → ℝ) (x : X)
    (p : ℝ≥0∞) (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hptop : p ≠ ∞)
    (hpreal : 0 < p.toReal) :
    eLpNorm (truncOrbit B T f x) p Measure.count ^ 2 =
      orbitPowerSum B T f p.toReal x ^ (2 / p.toReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eLpNorm_count_sq_eq_finset_sum_rpow B (truncOrbit B T f x) p hp0 hptop hpreal]
  · congr 1
    unfold orbitPowerSum truncOrbit
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (by simpa using hk)]
  · intro k hk
    unfold truncOrbit
    rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (by simpa using hk)]

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.holder_truncOrbit_norms
statement:
theorem holder_truncOrbit_norms
    {X κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace κ]
    [Countable κ] [MeasurableSingletonClass κ] {μ : Measure X}
    {n : ℕ} (B : Finset κ) (T : κ → X → X)
    (hT : ∀ k ∈ B, MeasurePreserving (T k) μ μ)
    (f : Fin n → X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable (f i) μ)
    (p : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞) (hp0 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (hptop : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hpreal : ∀ i, 0 < (p i).toReal)
    (hqsum : ∑ i, 2 / (p i).toReal = 1) :
    ∫⁻ x, ∏ i, eLpNorm (truncOrbit B T (f i) x) (p i) Measure.count ^ 2 ∂μ ≤
      B.card * ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) μ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let q : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦ 2 / (p i).toReal
  have hqnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i := by
    intro i
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hholder0 :
      ∫⁻ x, ∏ i, orbitPowerSum B T (f i) (p i).toReal x ^ q i ∂μ ≤
        ∏ i, (∫⁻ x, orbitPowerSum B T (f i) (p i).toReal x ∂μ) ^ q i := by
    apply ENNReal.lintegral_prod_norm_pow_le Finset.univ
    · intro i _
      exact aemeasurable_orbitPowerSum B T hT (f i) (hf i) (p i).toReal
    · simpa only [q] using hqsum
    · intro i _
      exact hqnonneg i
  have hholder :
      ∫⁻ x, ∏ i, orbitPowerSum B T (f i) (p i).toReal x ^ q i ∂μ ≤
        ∏ i, (B.card * ∫⁻ x, ‖f i x‖ₑ ^ (p i).toReal ∂μ) ^ q i := by
    calc
      ∫⁻ x, ∏ i, orbitPowerSum B T (f i) (p i).toReal x ^ q i ∂μ ≤
          ∏ i, (∫⁻ x, orbitPowerSum B T (f i) (p i).toReal x ∂μ) ^ q i := hholder0
      _ = ∏ i, (B.card * ∫⁻ x, ‖f i x‖ₑ ^ (p i).toReal ∂μ) ^ q i := by
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [lintegral_orbitPowerSum B T hT (f i) (hf i) (p i).toReal]
  calc
    ∫⁻ x, ∏ i, eLpNorm (truncOrbit B T (f i) x) (p i) Measure.count ^ 2 ∂μ =
        ∫⁻ x, ∏ i, orbitPowerSum B T (f i) (p i).toReal x ^ q i ∂μ := by
      congr with x
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      exact eLpNorm_truncOrbit_sq B T (f i) x (p i) (hp0 i) (hptop i) (hpreal i)
    _ ≤ ∏ i, (B.card * ∫⁻ x, ‖f i x‖ₑ ^ (p i).toReal ∂μ) ^ q i := hholder
    _ = B.card * ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) μ ^ 2 := by
      rw [prod_mul_rpow_eq_mul_prod_rpow Finset.univ B.card
        (fun i ↦ ∫⁻ x, ‖f i x‖ₑ ^ (p i).toReal ∂μ) q
        (fun i _ ↦ hqnonneg i) (by simpa only [q] using hqsum)]
      apply congrArg (fun z : ℝ≥0∞ ↦ (B.card : ℝ≥0∞) * z)
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      symm
      exact eLpNorm_sq_eq_lintegral_rpow μ (f i) (p i) (hp0 i) (hptop i)

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.eLpNorm_two_sq_nat
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_two_sq_nat {α E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    [TopologicalSpace E] [ENorm E] (μ : Measure α) (f : α → E) :
    eLpNorm f 2 μ ^ 2 = ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  rw [show (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal = 2 by norm_num]
  rw [← ENNReal.rpow_natCast]
  rw [← ENNReal.rpow_mul]
  norm_num

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.lintegral_finite_orbit_sum
statement:
theorem lintegral_finite_orbit_sum
    {X κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X)
    (B : Finset κ) (T : κ → X → X)
    (hT : ∀ k ∈ B, MeasurePreserving (T k) μ μ)
    {J : ℕ} (d : Fin J → X → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (d j) μ) :
    ∫⁻ x, ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ B, ‖d j (T k x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ =
      B.card * ∑ j : Fin J, ∫⁻ x, ‖d j x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : ∀ j : Fin J, ∀ k ∈ B,
      AEMeasurable (fun x ↦ ‖d j (T k x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ)) μ := by
    intro j k hk
    exact (((hd j).comp_quasiMeasurePreserving
      (hT k hk).quasiMeasurePreserving).enorm.pow measurable_const.aemeasurable)
  have hterm : ∀ (j : Fin J) (k : κ), k ∈ B →
      ∫⁻ x, ‖d j (T k x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ =
        ∫⁻ x, ‖d j x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ := by
    intro j k hk
    rw [← eLpNorm_two_sq_nat]
    change eLpNorm (d j ∘ T k) 2 μ ^ 2 = _
    rw [eLpNorm_comp_measurePreserving (hd j) (hT k hk)]
    exact eLpNorm_two_sq_nat μ (d j)
  rw [lintegral_finsetSum' Finset.univ]
  · calc
      ∑ j, ∫⁻ x, ∑ k ∈ B, ‖d j (T k x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ =
          ∑ j, ∑ k ∈ B, ∫⁻ x, ‖d j (T k x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        exact lintegral_finsetSum' B (hmeas j)
      _ = ∑ j, ∑ k ∈ B, ∫⁻ x, ‖d j x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        exact hterm j k hk
      _ = B.card * ∑ j : Fin J, ∫⁻ x, ‖d j x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ := by
        calc
          ∑ j, ∑ k ∈ B, ∫⁻ x, ‖d j x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ =
              ∑ j, B.card • ∫⁻ x, ‖d j x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j _
            exact Finset.sum_const _
          _ = B.card * ∑ j : Fin J, ∫⁻ x, ‖d j x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ := by
            simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  · intro j _
    simpa only [Finset.sum_fn] using Finset.aemeasurable_sum B (hmeas j)

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.finite_box_orbit_lower_bound
statement:
theorem finite_box_orbit_lower_bound
    {X κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}
    (B : Finset κ) (T : κ → X → X)
    (hT : ∀ k ∈ B, MeasurePreserving (T k) μ μ)
    {J : ℕ} (d : Fin J → X → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (d j) μ)
    (D : X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hpoint : ∀ x, ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ B,
      ‖d j (T k x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ D x) :
    (B.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm (d j) 2 μ ^ 2 ≤
      ∫⁻ x, D x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (B.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm (d j) 2 μ ^ 2 =
        (B.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ j : Fin J,
          ∫⁻ x, ‖d j x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ := by
      apply congrArg (fun z : ℝ≥0∞ ↦ (B.card : ℝ≥0∞) * z)
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact eLpNorm_two_sq_nat μ (d j)
    _ = ∫⁻ x, ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ B,
        ‖d j (T k x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ :=
      (lintegral_finite_orbit_sum μ B T hT d hd).symm
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, D x ∂μ := lintegral_mono hpoint

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.finite_box_ergodic_to_discrete
statement:
theorem finite_box_ergodic_to_discrete
    {X κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}
    (B B' : Finset κ) (T : κ → X → X)
    (hT : ∀ k ∈ B, MeasurePreserving (T k) μ μ)
    {J : ℕ} (d : Fin J → X → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (d j) μ)
    (A P : ℝ≥0∞) (D Q : X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hpoint : ∀ x, ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ B,
      ‖d j (T k x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ D x)
    (hdiscrete : ∀ x, D x ≤ A * Q x)
    (hQmeas : AEMeasurable Q μ)
    (hright : ∫⁻ x, Q x ∂μ ≤ (B'.card : ℝ≥0∞) * P) :
    (B.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm (d j) 2 μ ^ 2 ≤
      A * ((B'.card : ℝ≥0∞) * P)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (B.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm (d j) 2 μ ^ 2 ≤
        ∫⁻ x, D x ∂μ :=
      finite_box_orbit_lower_bound B T hT d hd D hpoint
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, A * Q x ∂μ := lintegral_mono hdiscrete
    _ = A * ∫⁻ x, Q x ∂μ := lintegral_const_mul'' A hQmeas
    _ ≤ A * ((B'.card : ℝ≥0∞) * P) := mul_le_mul_right hright A

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.holder_exponents_of_inverse_sum
statement:
theorem holder_exponents_of_inverse_sum {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ i, 1 < p i ∧ p i < ∞)
    (hsum : (∑ i, ((p i)⁻¹).toReal) = 1 / 2) :
    (∀ i, p i ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ i, p i ≠ ∞) ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < (p i).toReal) ∧
      ∑ i, 2 / (p i).toReal = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have := (hp i).1
    simp [hi] at this
  have hptop : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞ := by
    intro i
    exact ne_of_lt (hp i).2
  refine ⟨hp0, hptop, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact ENNReal.toReal_pos (hp0 i) (hptop i)
  · calc
      ∑ i, 2 / (p i).toReal = 2 * ∑ i, ((p i)⁻¹).toReal := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [ENNReal.toReal_inv]
        ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [hsum]; norm_num

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.aemeasurable_truncOrbit_normProduct
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_truncOrbit_normProduct
    {X κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace κ]
    [Countable κ] [MeasurableSingletonClass κ] {μ : Measure X}
    {n : ℕ} (B : Finset κ) (T : κ → X → X)
    (hT : ∀ k ∈ B, MeasurePreserving (T k) μ μ)
    (f : Fin n → X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable (f i) μ)
    (p : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞) (hp0 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (hptop : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hpreal : ∀ i, 0 < (p i).toReal) :
    AEMeasurable (fun x ↦
      ∏ i, eLpNorm (truncOrbit B T (f i) x) (p i) Measure.count ^ 2) μ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Finset.prod_fn] using Finset.aemeasurable_prod Finset.univ
    (fun i _ ↦ by
      let q : ℝ := 2 / (p i).toReal
      have heq : (fun x ↦ eLpNorm (truncOrbit B T (f i) x) (p i)
          Measure.count ^ 2) =
          fun x ↦ orbitPowerSum B T (f i) (p i).toReal x ^ q := by
        funext x
        dsimp [q]
        exact eLpNorm_truncOrbit_sq B T (f i) x (p i) (hp0 i) (hptop i) (hpreal i)
      rw [heq]
      exact ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const.aemeasurable.comp_aemeasurable
        (aemeasurable_orbitPowerSum B T hT (f i) (hf i) (p i).toReal))

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.scale_le_last
statement:
theorem scale_le_last {J : ℕ} (N : Fin (J + 1) → ℕ)
    (hN : StrictMono N) (q : Fin (J + 1)) :
    N q ≤ N (Fin.last J)
proof:
:=
  hN.monotone (Fin.le_last q)

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.finite_box_bound_of_finite_sum_cancelled
statement:
theorem finite_box_bound_of_finite_sum_cancelled
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {n J M : ℕ}
    (hM : 0 < M)
    (T : (Fin n → ℕ) → X → X)
    (hT : ∀ k ∈ box n (M + M),
      MeasurePreserving (T k) μ μ)
    (p : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞) (N : Fin (J + 1) → ℕ)
    (f : Fin n → X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, MemLp (f i) (p i) μ)
    (hp0 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (hptop : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hpreal : ∀ i, 0 < (p i).toReal)
    (hqsum : ∑ i, 2 / (p i).toReal = 1)
    (a : Fin (J + 1) → X → ℝ) (d : Fin J → X → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (d j) μ)
    (hjump : ∀ j x, d j x = a j.succ x - a j.castSucc x)
    (A : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hlocal : ∀ x, ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ box n M,
      ‖aux_discreteAverage (N j.succ)
          (fun i ↦ truncOrbit (box n (M + M)) T (f i) x) k -
        aux_discreteAverage (N j.castSucc)
          (fun i ↦ truncOrbit (box n (M + M)) T (f i) x) k‖ₑ
        ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤
        A * ∏ i, eLpNorm
          (truncOrbit (box n (M + M)) T (f i) x)
            (p i) Measure.count ^ 2)
    (haverage : ∀ (x : X) (k : Fin n → ℕ) (q : Fin (J + 1)),
      k ∈ box n M →
      aux_discreteAverage (N q)
          (fun i ↦ truncOrbit (box n (M + M)) T (f i) x) k =
        a q (T k x)) :
    ∑ j, eLpNorm (d j) 2 μ ^ 2 ≤
      A * ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) μ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let B : Finset (Fin n → ℕ) := box n M
  let B' : Finset (Fin n → ℕ) := box n (M + M)
  let F : X → Fin n → (Fin n → ℕ) → ℝ :=
    fun x i ↦ truncOrbit B' T (f i) x
  let Q : X → ℝ≥0∞ := fun x ↦
    ∏ i, eLpNorm (F x i) (p i) Measure.count ^ 2
  have hTinner : ∀ k ∈ B, MeasurePreserving (T k) μ μ := by
    intro k hk
    exact hT k (by simpa only [B, B'] using box_subset_double n M hk)
  have hQmeas : AEMeasurable Q μ := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    simpa only [F, B'] using aemeasurable_truncOrbit_normProduct B' T hT f
      (fun i ↦ (hf i).aestronglyMeasurable) p hp0 hptop hpreal
  have hright : ∫⁻ x, Q x ∂μ ≤
      (B'.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) μ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    simpa only [F, B'] using holder_truncOrbit_norms B' T hT f
      (fun i ↦ (hf i).aestronglyMeasurable) p hp0 hptop hpreal hqsum
  have hpoint : ∀ x, ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ B,
      ‖d j (T k x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ A * Q x := by
    intro x
    calc
      ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ B, ‖d j (T k x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) =
          ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ B,
            ‖aux_discreteAverage (N j.succ) (F x) k -
              aux_discreteAverage (N j.castSucc) (F x) k‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        rw [hjump, haverage x k j.succ (by simpa only [B] using hk),
          haverage x k j.castSucc (by simpa only [B] using hk)]
      _ ≤ A * Q x := by
        simpa only [B, B', F, Q] using hlocal x
  have hbox := finite_box_ergodic_to_discrete B B' T hTinner d hd A
    (∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) μ ^ 2) (fun x ↦ A * Q x) Q hpoint
    (fun _ ↦ le_rfl) hQmeas hright
  have hcancel := cancel_box_ratio hM (by
    simpa only [B, B', mul_assoc] using hbox)
  simpa only [B] using hcancel

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.add_coordinate_mem_box
statement:
theorem add_coordinate_mem_box {n L M : ℕ} (k : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hk : k ∈ box n L) (i : Fin n) (m : ℕ) (hm : m < M) :
    k + aux_coordinate i m ∈ box n (L + M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_box]
  intro j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    have hki : k i < L := (mem_box k).mp hk i
    simp [Pi.add_apply, aux_coordinate]
    omega
  · simp [Pi.add_apply, aux_coordinate, hji]
    have hkj : k j < L := (mem_box k).mp hk j
    omega

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.discreteAverage_truncated_orbit_eq
statement:
theorem discreteAverage_truncated_orbit_eq {X : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {n L M N : ℕ}
    (S : ErgodicSystem X μ n) (f : Fin n → X → ℝ) (x : X)
    (k : Fin n → ℕ) (hk : k ∈ box n L) (hN : N ≤ M) :
    aux_discreteAverage N
      (fun i ↦ truncOrbit
        (box n (L + M)) (aux_orbit S.transformation) (f i) x) k =
      aux_discreteAverage N (aux_orbitFunction S f x) k
proof:
:= by
  unfold aux_discreteAverage
  change (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N,
    ∏ i, truncOrbit
      (box n (L + M)) (aux_orbit S.transformation) (f i) x
      (k + aux_coordinate i m) =
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N,
        ∏ i, aux_orbitFunction S f x i (k + aux_coordinate i m)
  apply congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * z)
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [truncOrbit, Set.indicator_of_mem]
  · rfl
  · apply add_coordinate_mem_box k hk i m
    exact Finset.mem_range.mp hm |>.trans_le hN

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.realErgodicAverage_aestronglyMeasurable
proof:
:= by
  unfold realErgodicAverage
  change AEStronglyMeasurable ((N : ℝ)⁻¹ • fun x ↦
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, ∏ i, f i ((S.transformation i)^[m] x)) μ
  apply (Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_fun_sum (Finset.range N) ?_).const_smul
  intro m _
  apply Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_fun_prod Finset.univ
  intro i _
  change AEStronglyMeasurable (f i ∘ (S.transformation i)^[m]) μ
  exact (hf i).comp_quasiMeasurePreserving
    ((S.measurePreserving i).iterate m).quasiMeasurePreserving

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.realErgodicAverage_sub_aestronglyMeasurable
proof:
:= by
  exact (realErgodicAverage_aestronglyMeasurable S N f hf).sub
    (realErgodicAverage_aestronglyMeasurable S M f hf)

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.realErgodicJumpEnergy_of_finite_sum
statement:
theorem realErgodicJumpEnergy_of_finite_sum
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {n J : ℕ}
    (p : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ i, 1 < p i ∧ p i < ∞)
    (hsum : (∑ i, ((p i)⁻¹).toReal) = 1 / 2)
    (S : ErgodicSystem X μ n) (N : Fin (J + 1) → ℕ)
    (hN : StrictMono N) (hNpos : ∀ j, 0 < N j)
    (f : Fin n → X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, MemLp (f i) (p i) μ)
    (A : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hlocal : ∀ x, ∑ j : Fin J,
      ∑ k ∈ box n (N (Fin.last J)),
        ‖aux_discreteAverage (N j.succ)
            (fun i ↦ truncOrbit
              (box n (N (Fin.last J) + N (Fin.last J)))
              (aux_orbit S.transformation) (f i) x) k -
          aux_discreteAverage (N j.castSucc)
            (fun i ↦ truncOrbit
              (box n (N (Fin.last J) + N (Fin.last J)))
              (aux_orbit S.transformation) (f i) x) k‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤
        A * ∏ i, eLpNorm
          (truncOrbit
            (box n (N (Fin.last J) + N (Fin.last J)))
            (aux_orbit S.transformation) (f i) x)
          (p i) Measure.count ^ 2) :
    realErgodicJumpEnergy S N f ≤
      A * ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) μ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases holder_exponents_of_inverse_sum p hp hsum with
    ⟨hp0, hptop, hpreal, hqsum⟩
  let M : ℕ := N (Fin.last J)
  have hM : 0 < M := by
    dsimp [M]
    exact hNpos (Fin.last J)
  let a : Fin (J + 1) → X → ℝ := fun q ↦ realErgodicAverage S (N q) f
  let d : Fin J → X → ℝ := fun j x ↦ a j.succ x - a j.castSucc x
  have hd : ∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (d j) μ := by
    intro j
    dsimp [d, a]
    exact realErgodicAverage_sub_aestronglyMeasurable S
      (N j.succ) (N j.castSucc) f (fun i ↦ (hf i).aestronglyMeasurable)
  have hjump : ∀ j x, d j x = a j.succ x - a j.castSucc x := by
    intro j x
    rfl
  have haverage : ∀ (x : X) (k : Fin n → ℕ) (q : Fin (J + 1)),
      k ∈ box n M →
      aux_discreteAverage (N q)
          (fun i ↦ truncOrbit
            (box n (M + M)) (aux_orbit S.transformation) (f i) x) k =
        a q (aux_orbit S.transformation k x) := by
    intro x k q hk
    calc
      aux_discreteAverage (N q)
          (fun i ↦ truncOrbit
            (box n (M + M)) (aux_orbit S.transformation) (f i) x) k =
          aux_discreteAverage (N q) (aux_orbitFunction S f x) k :=
        discreteAverage_truncated_orbit_eq S f x k hk (scale_le_last N hN q)
      _ = realErgodicAverage S (N q) f (aux_orbit S.transformation k x) :=
        aux_discreteAverage_orbitFunction S f x k (N q)
      _ = a q (aux_orbit S.transformation k x) := rfl
  have hbox := finite_box_bound_of_finite_sum_cancelled
    hM (aux_orbit S.transformation)
    (fun k _ ↦ aux_orbit_measurePreserving
      S.transformation k S.measurePreserving)
    p N f hf hp0 hptop hpreal hqsum a d hd hjump A (by
      intro x
      simpa only [M, ENNReal.rpow_two] using hlocal x) haverage
  unfold realErgodicJumpEnergy
  change ∑ j, eLpNorm (d j) 2 μ ^ 2 ≤
    A * ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) μ ^ 2
  exact hbox

name: Auto.aux_ofReal_two_pow_mul
statement:
theorem aux_ofReal_two_pow_mul (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * C) =
      ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal C
proof:
:= by
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)]
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num)]
  norm_num

name: Auto.aux_realErgodicJumpBound_of_realVariable
statement:
theorem aux_realErgodicJumpBound_of_realVariable {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (p : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞) (C : ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 1 < p i ∧ p i < ∞)
    (hsum : (∑ i, ((p i)⁻¹).toReal) = 1 / 2)
    (hreal : realVariableJumpBound p C g) :
    realErgodicJumpBound.{u} p
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6) * C)) g
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ μ S J hJ N hN hNpos f hf
  rcases aux_ErgodicBox.holder_exponents_of_inverse_sum p hp hsum with
    ⟨hp0, hptop, _hpreal, _hqsum⟩
  let Cd : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6) * C
  have hbox := aux_ErgodicBox.realErgodicJumpEnergy_of_finite_sum
    p hp hsum S N hN hNpos f hf
    (ENNReal.ofReal Cd * ENNReal.ofReal (g J)) (by
      intro x
      exact aux_finite_forward_jump_bound_of_realVariable hn p C g hreal hJ
        N hN hNpos
        (fun i ↦ aux_ErgodicBox.truncOrbit
          (aux_ErgodicBox.box n
            (N (Fin.last J) + N (Fin.last J)))
          (aux_orbit S.transformation) (f i) x)
        (aux_ErgodicBox.box n (N (Fin.last J))) hp0 hptop)
  have hconstant :
      ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * Cd) =
        ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal Cd :=
    aux_ofReal_two_pow_mul n Cd
  change realErgodicJumpEnergy S N f ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * Cd) * ENNReal.ofReal (g J) *
      ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) μ ^ 2
  rw [hconstant]
  simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hbox

name: Auto.ct_calderon_transference_external
statement:
theorem ct_calderon_transference_external {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (p : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞) (hp : ∀ i, 1 < p i ∧ p i < ∞)
    (hsum : (∑ i, ((p i)⁻¹).toReal) = 1 / 2) (C : ℝ) (_hC : 0 < C) :
    0 < calderonTransferenceConstant n ∧ ∀ g : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ J, 0 < J → 1 ≤ g J) →
      realVariableJumpBound p C g →
        realErgodicJumpBound.{u} p (calderonTransferenceConstant n * C) g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by dsimp [calderonTransferenceConstant]; positivity, ?_⟩
  intro g _hg hreal
  have h := aux_realErgodicJumpBound_of_realVariable (by omega) p C g hp hsum hreal
  have hconstant : calderonTransferenceConstant n * C =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ n * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6) * C) := by
    dsimp [calderonTransferenceConstant]
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (4 * n + 6) * C =
          (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + (3 * n + 6)) * C := by
            congr 1
            ring
      _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6)) * C := by
            rw [pow_add]
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ n * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6) * C) := by ring
  rw [hconstant]
  exact h

name: Auto.aux_wienerEnvelope_eq_sSup
statement:
theorem aux_wienerEnvelope_eq_sSup {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    {f : E → F} {r : ℝ} {x : E} :
    wienerEnvelope f r x = sSup ((fun y : E ↦ ‖f y‖) '' closedBall x r)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  congr 1
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨x + z, ?_, rfl⟩
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨y - x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hy
    · simp

name: Auto.continuous_wienerEnvelope
statement:
theorem continuous_wienerEnvelope {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] {f : E → F} (hf : Continuous f) (r : ℝ) :
    Continuous (wienerEnvelope f r)
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun x : E ↦
    sSup ((fun z : E ↦ ‖f (x + z)‖) '' closedBall 0 r))
  exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) r).continuous_sSup
    (show Continuous (fun p : E × E ↦ ‖f (p.1 + p.2)‖) by fun_prop)

name: Auto.measurable_wienerEnvelope
proof:
:=
  (continuous_wienerEnvelope hf r).measurable

name: Auto.aux_exists_wienerEnvelope_eq_and_ge
statement:
theorem aux_exists_wienerEnvelope_eq_and_ge {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] {f : E → F} (hf : Continuous f) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (x : E) :
    ∃ z ∈ closedBall (0 : E) r, wienerEnvelope f r x = ‖f (x + z)‖ ∧
      ∀ w ∈ closedBall (0 : E) r, ‖f (x + w)‖ ≤ ‖f (x + z)‖
proof:
:= by
  let h : Continuous (fun z : E ↦ ‖f (x + z)‖) := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hEq, hzmax⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) r).exists_sSup_image_eq_and_ge
      (Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hr) h.continuousOn
  exact ⟨z, hz, hEq, hzmax⟩

name: Auto.upperSemicontinuous_wienerEnvelope
statement:
theorem upperSemicontinuous_wienerEnvelope {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] {f : E → F} (hf : Continuous f) (r : ℝ) :
    UpperSemicontinuous (wienerEnvelope f r)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_wienerEnvelope hf r).upperSemicontinuous

name: Auto.localSupremumMeasurability
statement:
theorem localSupremumMeasurability {d : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → 𝕜} (hf : Continuous f) {r : ℝ} (_hr : 0 < r) :
    UpperSemicontinuous (wienerEnvelope f r) ∧ Measurable (wienerEnvelope f r)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨upperSemicontinuous_wienerEnvelope hf r, measurable_wienerEnvelope hf r⟩

theorem MemW0.aux_continuous {E 𝕜 : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasureSpace E]

name: Auto.MemW0.aux_integrable_envelope
statement:
theorem MemW0.aux_integrable_envelope {E 𝕜 : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasureSpace E]

name: Auto.aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg
statement:
theorem aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] {f : E → F} (hf : Continuous f) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (x : E) :
    0 ≤ wienerEnvelope f r x
proof:
:= by
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  let h : Continuous (fun z : E ↦ ‖f (x + z)‖) := by fun_prop
  calc
    0 ≤ ‖f (x + 0)‖ := norm_nonneg _
    _ ≤ sSup ((fun z : E ↦ ‖f (x + z)‖) '' closedBall 0 r) := by
      apply le_csSup
      · exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) r).bddAbove_image h.continuousOn
      · exact ⟨0, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr, rfl⟩

name: Auto.aux_norm_le_wienerEnvelope
statement:
theorem aux_norm_le_wienerEnvelope {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] {f : E → F} (hf : Continuous f) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (x : E) :
    ‖f x‖ ≤ wienerEnvelope f r x
proof:
:= by
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  let h : Continuous (fun z : E ↦ ‖f (x + z)‖) := by fun_prop
  simpa using
    (le_csSup ((isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) r).bddAbove_image h.continuousOn)
      ⟨0, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr, rfl⟩)

name: Auto.aux_norm_le_wienerEnvelope_of_mem_closedBall
statement:
theorem aux_norm_le_wienerEnvelope_of_mem_closedBall {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [ProperSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] {f : E → F} (hf : Continuous f) {r : ℝ}
    {x y : E} (hy : y ∈ closedBall x r) :
    ‖f y‖ ≤ wienerEnvelope f r x
proof:
:= by
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  let h : Continuous (fun z : E ↦ ‖f (x + z)‖) := by fun_prop
  apply le_csSup
  · exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) r).bddAbove_image h.continuousOn
  · refine ⟨y - x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hy
    · abel_nf

name: Auto.aux_wienerEnvelope_mono_radius
statement:
theorem aux_wienerEnvelope_mono_radius {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] {f : E → F} (hf : Continuous f) {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hrs : r ≤ s) (x : E) :
    wienerEnvelope f r x ≤ wienerEnvelope f s x
proof:
:= by
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  apply csSup_le_csSup
  · let h : Continuous (fun z : E ↦ ‖f (x + z)‖) := by fun_prop
    exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) s).bddAbove_image h.continuousOn
  · exact (Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hr).image _
  · exact Set.image_mono (closedBall_subset_closedBall hrs)

name: Auto.aux_wienerEnvelope_comp_continuousLinearMap_le
statement:
theorem aux_wienerEnvelope_comp_continuousLinearMap_le {E F K : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [ProperSpace F]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedAddCommGroup K]
    (e : E →L[ℝ] F) {f : F → K} (hf : Continuous f) (x : E) :
    wienerEnvelope (f ∘ e) 1 x ≤ wienerEnvelope f ‖e‖ (e x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  apply csSup_le ((Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr zero_le_one).image _)
  rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  apply le_csSup
  · exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : F) ‖e‖).bddAbove_image
      (show Continuous (fun w : F ↦ ‖f (e x + w)‖) by fun_prop).continuousOn
  · refine ⟨e z, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr
      simpa [dist_eq_norm] using
        (calc
          ‖e z‖ ≤ ‖e‖ * ‖z‖ := e.le_opNorm z
          _ ≤ ‖e‖ * 1 := by
            gcongr
            simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
          _ = ‖e‖ := mul_one _)
    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, e.map_add]

name: Auto.MemW0.aux_comp_continuousLinearMap_of_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem MemW0.aux_comp_continuousLinearMap_of_measurePreserving
    {E F K : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    [ProperSpace E] [ProperSpace F] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [MeasureSpace F] [BorelSpace F]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] {f : F → K} (hf : MemW0 f) (e : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (he : MeasurePreserving e volume volume)
    (hr : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f ‖e‖)) :
    MemW0 (f ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hf.1.comp e.continuous, ?_⟩
  have hcomp : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f ‖e‖ ∘ e) :=
    he.integrable_comp_of_integrable hr
  refine hcomp.mono_nonneg
    (continuous_wienerEnvelope (hf.1.comp e.continuous) 1).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun x ↦ aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg (hf.1.comp e.continuous) zero_le_one x)
    (ae_of_all _ fun x ↦ ?_)
  exact aux_wienerEnvelope_comp_continuousLinearMap_le e hf.1 x

name: Auto.aux_wienerEnvelope_comp_linearIsometryEquiv
statement:
theorem aux_wienerEnvelope_comp_linearIsometryEquiv {E F K : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [NormedAddCommGroup K]
    (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) {f : F → K} (x : E) :
    wienerEnvelope (f ∘ e) 1 x = wienerEnvelope f 1 (e x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  congr 1
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨e z, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, e.map_add]
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨e.symm w, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, e.map_add, e.apply_symm_apply]

name: Auto.MemW0.aux_comp_linearIsometryEquiv
statement:
theorem MemW0.aux_comp_linearIsometryEquiv {E F K : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [NormedAddCommGroup K]
    {f : F → K} (hf : MemW0 f) (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) :
    MemW0 (f ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hf.1.comp e.continuous, ?_⟩
  have hcomp : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f 1 ∘ e) :=
    (e.measurePreserving).integrable_comp_emb e.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding |>.mpr hf.2
  convert hcomp using 1
  ext x
  exact aux_wienerEnvelope_comp_linearIsometryEquiv e x

name: Auto.aux_integrable_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_between
statement:
theorem aux_integrable_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_between {E F K : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [ProperSpace E]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure E)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [ProperSpace F]
    [MeasureSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure F)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] {g : F → K} (hg : Integrable g) (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) :
    Integrable (g ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (Measure.map (e : E → F) volume) :=
    e.isAddHaarMeasure_map volume
  have hscalar : Measure.map (e : E → F) volume =
      Measure.addHaarScalarFactor (Measure.map (e : E → F) volume) volume • volume :=
    Measure.isAddLeftInvariant_eq_smul (Measure.map (e : E → F) volume) volume
  have hmap : Integrable g (Measure.map (e : E → F) volume) := by
    rw [hscalar]
    exact hg.smul_measure_nnreal
  exact hmap.comp_measurable e.continuous.measurable

name: Auto.aux_integral_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem aux_integral_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_eq {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [ProperSpace E]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure E)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [ProperSpace F]
    [MeasureSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure F)]
    (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) {g : F → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) :
    (∫ x, g (e x)) =
      (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor (Measure.map (e : E → F) volume) volume : ℝ) *
        ∫ y, g y
proof:
:= by
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (Measure.map (e : E → F) volume) :=
    e.isAddHaarMeasure_map volume
  have hscalar : Measure.map (e : E → F) volume =
      Measure.addHaarScalarFactor (Measure.map (e : E → F) volume) volume • volume :=
    Measure.isAddLeftInvariant_eq_smul (Measure.map (e : E → F) volume) volume
  calc
    (∫ x, g (e x)) = ∫ y, g y ∂Measure.map (e : E → F) volume :=
      (integral_map e.continuous.aemeasurable hg.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    _ = ∫ y, g y ∂(Measure.addHaarScalarFactor (Measure.map (e : E → F) volume) volume •
        volume) :=
      congrArg (fun μ : Measure F => ∫ y, g y ∂μ) hscalar
    _ = (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor (Measure.map (e : E → F) volume) volume : ℝ) *
        ∫ y, g y := by
      rw [integral_smul_nnreal_measure]
      rfl

name: Auto.MemW0.aux_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_between_of_integrable_radius
statement:
theorem MemW0.aux_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_between_of_integrable_radius {E F K : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [ProperSpace E]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure E)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [ProperSpace F]
    [MeasureSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure F)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] {f : F → K} (hf : MemW0 f) (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F)
    (hr : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f ‖(e : E →L[ℝ] F)‖)) :
    MemW0 (f ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hf.1.comp e.continuous, ?_⟩
  have hcomp : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f ‖(e : E →L[ℝ] F)‖ ∘ e) :=
    aux_integrable_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_between hr e
  refine hcomp.mono_nonneg
    (continuous_wienerEnvelope (hf.1.comp e.continuous) 1).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun x ↦ aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg (hf.1.comp e.continuous) zero_le_one x)
    (ae_of_all _ fun x ↦ ?_)
  exact aux_wienerEnvelope_comp_continuousLinearMap_le (e : E →L[ℝ] F) hf.1 x

name: Auto.aux_exists_orthogonalSplit_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem aux_exists_orthogonalSplit_measurePreserving {V : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    [MeasurableSpace V] [BorelSpace V] (s : Submodule ℝ V) :
    ∃ e : V ≃L[ℝ] s × sᗮ, MeasurePreserving e
proof:
:= by
  let e₁ : V ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] WithLp 2 (s × sᗮ) := s.orthogonalDecomposition
  let e₂ : WithLp 2 (s × sᗮ) ≃L[ℝ] s × sᗮ :=
    WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ s sᗮ
  refine ⟨e₁.toContinuousLinearEquiv.trans e₂, ?_⟩
  have h₁ : MeasurePreserving e₁ := e₁.measurePreserving
  have h₂ : MeasurePreserving e₂ := WithLp.volume_preserving_ofLp s sᗮ
  change MeasurePreserving (e₂ ∘ e₁)
  exact h₂.comp h₁

name: Auto.aux_orthogonalDecomposition_range_apply
statement:
theorem aux_orthogonalDecomposition_range_apply {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (π : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E) :
    let s : Submodule ℝ F := π.range
    let e : F ≃L[ℝ] s × sᗮ :=
      s.orthogonalDecomposition.toContinuousLinearEquiv.trans
        (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ s sᗮ)
    e (π x) = (π.rangeRestrict x, 0)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.trans_apply]
  change (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ π.range (π.range)ᗮ)
      ((π.range).orthogonalDecomposition (π x)) = (π.rangeRestrict x, 0)
  rw [Submodule.orthogonalDecomposition_apply, WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv_apply]
  change ((π.range).orthogonalProjectionOnto (π x),
    (π.range)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto (π x)) = (π.rangeRestrict x, 0)
  have hx : π x ∈ π.range := π.mem_range_self x
  apply Prod.ext
  · calc
      (π.range).orthogonalProjectionOnto (π x) = (⟨π x, hx⟩ : π.range) :=
        (π.range).orthogonalProjectionOnto_mem_subspace_eq_self ⟨π x, hx⟩
      _ = π.rangeRestrict x := Subtype.ext (by rfl)
  · exact (π.range).orthogonalProjectionOnto_orthogonal_apply_eq_zero hx

name: Auto.aux_wienerEnvelope_wienerEnvelope_le
statement:
theorem aux_wienerEnvelope_wienerEnvelope_le {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] {f : E → F} (hf : Continuous f) {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (x : E) :
    wienerEnvelope (wienerEnvelope f r) s x ≤ wienerEnvelope f (r + s) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  apply csSup_le ((Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hs).image _)
  rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  change ‖wienerEnvelope f r (x + z)‖ ≤ wienerEnvelope f (r + s) x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hf hr _)]
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  apply csSup_le ((Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hr).image _)
  rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  let h : Continuous (fun q : E ↦ ‖f (x + q)‖) := by fun_prop
  apply le_csSup
  · exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) (r + s)).bddAbove_image h.continuousOn
  · refine ⟨z + w, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr
      calc
        dist (z + w) 0 = ‖z + w‖ := by simp [dist_eq_norm]
        _ ≤ ‖z‖ + ‖w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ s + r := by
          gcongr
          · simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
          · simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
        _ = r + s := add_comm _ _
    · abel_nf

name: Auto.aux_exists_finite_closedBall_cover
statement:
theorem aux_exists_finite_closedBall_cover {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (s : ℝ) :
    ∃ t : Finset E, ∀ y ∈ closedBall (0 : E) s, ∃ z ∈ t, y ∈ closedBall z r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, -, hu, hcover⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) s).finite_cover_balls (half_pos hr)
  refine ⟨hu.toFinset, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcover hy) with ⟨z, hzu, hyz⟩
  refine ⟨z, by simpa using hzu, ?_⟩
  exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr
    ((Metric.mem_ball.mp hyz).le.trans (by linarith))

name: Auto.aux_card_le_sharp_packing
statement:
theorem aux_card_le_sharp_packing {d : ℕ} {r s : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (t : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)))
    (ht : ∀ c ∈ t, ‖c‖ ≤ s)
    (htsep : ∀ c ∈ t, ∀ e ∈ t, c ≠ e → r ≤ ‖c - e‖) :
    (t.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 * s / r) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let μ : Measure E := Measure.addHaar
  let δ : ℝ := r / 2
  let ρ : ℝ := s + r / 2
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    positivity
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := by
    dsimp [ρ]
    linarith
  set A : Set E := ⋃ c ∈ t, ball c δ with hA
  have D : Set.Pairwise (t : Set E) (Disjoint on fun c ↦ ball c δ) := by
    rintro c hc e he hce
    apply Metric.ball_disjoint_ball
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    convert htsep c hc e he hce using 1
    all_goals
      dsimp [δ]
      ring
  have A_subset : A ⊆ ball (0 : E) ρ := by
    refine iUnion₂_subset fun c hc ↦ ?_
    apply ball_subset_ball'
    calc
      δ + dist c 0 ≤ δ + s := by
        rw [dist_zero_right]
        exact add_le_add le_rfl (ht c hc)
      _ = ρ := by
        dsimp [δ, ρ]
        ring
  have I :
      (t.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) := by
    calc
      (t.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) = μ A := by
        rw [hA, measure_biUnion_finset D fun c _ ↦ measurableSet_ball]
        simp only [μ.addHaar_ball_of_pos _ hδ]
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ μ (ball (0 : E) ρ) := measure_mono A_subset
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) := by
        simp only [μ.addHaar_ball_of_pos _ hρ]
  have J : (t.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E) :=
    (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left (measure_ball_pos _ _ zero_lt_one).ne'
      measure_ball_lt_top.ne).1 I
  have K : (t.card : ℝ) ≤ (ρ / δ) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E := by
    have h := ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (pow_nonneg hρ.le _) J
    have hδpow : 0 < δ ^ Module.finrank ℝ E := pow_pos hδ _
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_natCast,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (pow_nonneg hδ.le _)] at h
    rw [div_pow]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hδpow).2 h
  have hratio : ρ / δ ≤ 3 * s / r := by
    dsimp [ρ, δ]
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  calc
    (t.card : ℝ) ≤ (ρ / δ) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E := K
    _ ≤ (3 * s / r) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (div_nonneg (by dsimp [ρ]; linarith) hδ.le) hratio _
    _ = (3 * s / r) ^ d := by simp [E]

name: Auto.aux_exists_finset_cover_closedBall_card_le
statement:
theorem aux_exists_finset_cover_closedBall_card_le {d : ℕ} {r s : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    ∃ t : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)),
      ((closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) s : Set _) ⊆
        ⋃ c ∈ t, closedBall c r) ∧
      (t.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 * s / r) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let A : Set E := closedBall 0 s
  let ε : NNReal := r.toNNReal / 2
  have hε : ε ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    exact div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (Real.toNNReal_pos.mpr hr)) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨C, hCA, hCfin, hCcover⟩ :=
    Metric.exists_finite_isCover_of_isCompact hε (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) s)
  have htwo : 2 * ε = r.toNNReal := by
    dsimp [ε]
    field_simp
  have hpack : Metric.packingNumber r.toNNReal A ≤ C.encard := by
    rw [← htwo]
    exact (Metric.packingNumber_two_mul_le_externalCoveringNumber ε A).trans
      hCcover.externalCoveringNumber_le_encard
  have hpack_lt : Metric.packingNumber r.toNNReal A < ⊤ :=
    hpack.trans_lt hCfin.encard_lt_top
  have hpack_ne : Metric.packingNumber r.toNNReal A ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt hpack_lt
  let S : Set E := Metric.maximalSeparatedSet r.toNNReal A
  have hSfin : S.Finite := by
    apply Set.encard_lt_top_iff.mp
    rw [show S = Metric.maximalSeparatedSet r.toNNReal A from rfl,
      Metric.encard_maximalSeparatedSet hpack_ne]
    exact hpack_lt
  refine ⟨hSfin.toFinset, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨c, hcS, hxc⟩ := Metric.isCover_maximalSeparatedSet hpack_ne hx
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨c, hSfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hcS, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
    simpa only [coe_nndist, Real.coe_toNNReal r hr.le] using
      (NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr (edist_le_coe.mp hxc))
  · apply aux_card_le_sharp_packing hr hrs
    · intro c hc
      have hcA : c ∈ A := Metric.maximalSeparatedSet_subset (hSfin.mem_toFinset.mp hc)
      simpa [A, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hcA
    · intro c hc e he hce
      have hsep : (r.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < edist c e :=
        Metric.isSeparated_maximalSeparatedSet
          (hSfin.mem_toFinset.mp hc) (hSfin.mem_toFinset.mp he) hce
      rw [edist_nndist] at hsep
      have hsepNN : r.toNNReal < nndist c e := ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.mp hsep
      simpa only [coe_nndist, Real.coe_toNNReal r hr.le, dist_eq_norm] using
        le_of_lt (NNReal.coe_lt_coe.mpr hsepNN)

name: Auto.aux_wienerEnvelope_le_sum_of_cover
statement:
theorem aux_wienerEnvelope_le_sum_of_cover {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] {f : E → F} (hf : Continuous f) {r s : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (t : Finset E)
    (hcover : ∀ y ∈ closedBall (0 : E) s, ∃ z ∈ t, y ∈ closedBall z r) (x : E) :
    wienerEnvelope f s x ≤ ∑ z ∈ t, wienerEnvelope f r (x + z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  apply csSup_le ((Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hs).image _)
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hzt, hyz⟩ := hcover y hy
  calc
    ‖f (x + y)‖ ≤ wienerEnvelope f r (x + z) := by
      unfold wienerEnvelope
      let h : Continuous (fun w : E ↦ ‖f ((x + z) + w)‖) := by fun_prop
      apply le_csSup
      · exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) r).bddAbove_image h.continuousOn
      · refine ⟨y - z, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hyz
        · abel_nf
    _ ≤ ∑ z ∈ t, wienerEnvelope f r (x + z) :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun w hw ↦ aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hf hr _) hzt

name: Auto.aux_integrable_wienerEnvelope_of_integrable'
statement:
theorem aux_integrable_wienerEnvelope_of_integrable' {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [ProperSpace E] [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [Measure.IsAddRightInvariant (volume : Measure E)] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    {f : E → F} (hf : Continuous f) {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hfr : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f r)) :
    Integrable (wienerEnvelope f s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := aux_exists_finite_closedBall_cover (E := E) r hr s
  have hsum : Integrable (fun x ↦ ∑ z ∈ t, wienerEnvelope f r (x + z)) := by
    apply integrable_finsetSum
    intro z hz
    exact hfr.comp_add_right z
  refine hsum.mono_nonneg (continuous_wienerEnvelope hf s).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun x ↦ aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hf hs x) (ae_of_all _ fun x ↦ ?_)
  exact aux_wienerEnvelope_le_sum_of_cover hf (le_of_lt hr) hs t ht x

name: Auto.aux_integral_wienerEnvelope_le_card_mul_of_addHaar
statement:
theorem aux_integral_wienerEnvelope_le_card_mul_of_addHaar {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E] [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [Measure.IsAddRightInvariant (volume : Measure E)] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    {f : E → F} (hf : Continuous f) {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hfr : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f r)) (t : Finset E)
    (hcover : ∀ y ∈ closedBall (0 : E) s, ∃ z ∈ t, y ∈ closedBall z r) :
    (∫ x, wienerEnvelope f s x) ≤ (t.card : ℝ) * ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x
proof:
:= by
  have hsint : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f s) :=
    aux_integrable_wienerEnvelope_of_integrable' hf hr hs hfr
  have hsum : Integrable (fun x : E => ∑ z ∈ t, wienerEnvelope f r (x + z)) := by
    exact integrable_finsetSum t fun z hz => hfr.comp_add_right z
  calc
    (∫ x, wienerEnvelope f s x) ≤ ∫ x, ∑ z ∈ t, wienerEnvelope f r (x + z) :=
      integral_mono hsint hsum (fun x =>
        aux_wienerEnvelope_le_sum_of_cover hf (le_of_lt hr) hs t hcover x)
    _ = ∑ z ∈ t, ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r (x + z) :=
      integral_finsetSum t fun z hz => hfr.comp_add_right z
    _ = ∑ _z ∈ t, ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x := by
      simp_rw [integral_add_right_eq_self]
    _ = (t.card : ℝ) * ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x := by simp

name: Auto.aux_exists_wienerEnvelope_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_bound
statement:
theorem aux_exists_wienerEnvelope_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_bound {E F K : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [ProperSpace E]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure E)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [ProperSpace F]
    [MeasureSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure F)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ f : F → K, MemW0 f →
      (∫ x, wienerEnvelope (f ∘ e) 1 x) ≤ C * ∫ y, wienerEnvelope f 1 y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
    aux_exists_finite_closedBall_cover (E := F) 1 zero_lt_one ‖(e : E →L[ℝ] F)‖
  let a : ℝ := (Measure.addHaarScalarFactor (Measure.map (e : E → F) volume) volume : ℝ)
  refine ⟨max 1 (a * (t.card : ℝ)),
    lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by
    dsimp [a]
    positivity
  have hrad : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f ‖(e : E →L[ℝ] F)‖) :=
    aux_integrable_wienerEnvelope_of_integrable' hf.1 zero_lt_one (norm_nonneg _) hf.2
  have hrad_bound :
      (∫ y, wienerEnvelope f ‖(e : E →L[ℝ] F)‖ y) ≤
        (t.card : ℝ) * ∫ y, wienerEnvelope f 1 y :=
    aux_integral_wienerEnvelope_le_card_mul_of_addHaar hf.1 zero_lt_one (norm_nonneg _) hf.2 t ht
  have hcomp : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f ‖(e : E →L[ℝ] F)‖ ∘ e) :=
    aux_integrable_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_between hrad e
  have hleft : Integrable (wienerEnvelope (f ∘ e) 1) := by
    refine hcomp.mono_nonneg
      (continuous_wienerEnvelope (hf.1.comp e.continuous) 1).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg (hf.1.comp e.continuous) zero_le_one x)
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    exact aux_wienerEnvelope_comp_continuousLinearMap_le e.toContinuousLinearMap hf.1 x
  have hmap : (∫ x, wienerEnvelope f ‖(e : E →L[ℝ] F)‖ (e x)) =
      a * ∫ y, wienerEnvelope f ‖(e : E →L[ℝ] F)‖ y := by
    simpa [a] using aux_integral_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_eq e
      (continuous_wienerEnvelope hf.1 ‖(e : E →L[ℝ] F)‖)
  have hnon : 0 ≤ ∫ y, wienerEnvelope f 1 y :=
    integral_nonneg fun y => aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hf.1 zero_le_one y
  calc
    (∫ x, wienerEnvelope (f ∘ e) 1 x) ≤
        ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f ‖(e : E →L[ℝ] F)‖ (e x) :=
      integral_mono hleft hcomp (fun x =>
        aux_wienerEnvelope_comp_continuousLinearMap_le e.toContinuousLinearMap hf.1 x)
    _ = a * ∫ y, wienerEnvelope f ‖(e : E →L[ℝ] F)‖ y := hmap
    _ ≤ a * ((t.card : ℝ) * ∫ y, wienerEnvelope f 1 y) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrad_bound ha
    _ = (a * (t.card : ℝ)) * ∫ y, wienerEnvelope f 1 y := by ring
    _ ≤ max 1 (a * (t.card : ℝ)) * ∫ y, wienerEnvelope f 1 y :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hnon

name: Auto.MemW0.aux_mem_wienerEnvelope
statement:
theorem MemW0.aux_mem_wienerEnvelope {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [Measure.IsAddRightInvariant (volume : Measure E)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] {f : E → F} (hf : MemW0 f) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    MemW0 (wienerEnvelope f r)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (wienerEnvelope f r) := continuous_wienerEnvelope hf.1 r
  refine ⟨hcont, ?_⟩
  have hinter : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f (r + 1)) :=
    aux_integrable_wienerEnvelope_of_integrable' hf.1 zero_lt_one (by linarith) hf.2
  refine hinter.mono_nonneg (continuous_wienerEnvelope hcont 1).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun x ↦ aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hcont zero_le_one x)
    (ae_of_all _ fun x ↦ ?_)
  exact aux_wienerEnvelope_wienerEnvelope_le hf.1 hr zero_le_one x

name: Auto.integrable_wienerEnvelope_iff
statement:

name: Auto.aux_integral_wienerEnvelope_le_card_mul
statement:
theorem aux_integral_wienerEnvelope_le_card_mul {d : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → 𝕜} (hf : Continuous f) {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hfr : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f r))
    (t : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)))
    (hcover : ∀ y ∈ closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) s,
      ∃ z ∈ t, y ∈ closedBall z r) :
    (∫ x, wienerEnvelope f s x) ≤ (t.card : ℝ) * ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x
proof:
:= by
  have hsint : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f s) :=
    aux_integrable_wienerEnvelope_of_integrable hf hr hs hfr
  have hsum : Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) ↦
      ∑ z ∈ t, wienerEnvelope f r (x + z)) := by
    exact integrable_finsetSum t fun z hz ↦ hfr.comp_add_right z
  calc
    (∫ x, wienerEnvelope f s x) ≤ ∫ x, ∑ z ∈ t, wienerEnvelope f r (x + z) :=
      integral_mono hsint hsum (fun x ↦
        aux_wienerEnvelope_le_sum_of_cover hf (le_of_lt hr) hs t hcover x)
    _ = ∑ z ∈ t, ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r (x + z) :=
      integral_finsetSum t fun z hz ↦ hfr.comp_add_right z
    _ = ∑ _z ∈ t, ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x := by

name: Auto.aux_integral_wienerEnvelope_le_max_one_three_mul_div_pow_mul
statement:
theorem aux_integral_wienerEnvelope_le_max_one_three_mul_div_pow_mul {d : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → 𝕜} (hf : Continuous f)
    {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) (hfr : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f r)) :
    (∫ x, wienerEnvelope f s x) ≤
      max 1 ((3 * s / r) ^ d) * ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x
proof:
:= by
  have hnon : 0 ≤ ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x :=
    integral_nonneg fun x ↦ aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hf (le_of_lt hr) x
  by_cases hsr : s ≤ r
  · have hsint : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f s) :=
      aux_integrable_wienerEnvelope_of_integrable hf hr (le_of_lt hs) hfr
    calc
      (∫ x, wienerEnvelope f s x) ≤ ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x :=
        integral_mono hsint hfr
          (fun x ↦ aux_wienerEnvelope_mono_radius hf (le_of_lt hs) hsr x)
      _ = 1 * ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x := (one_mul _).symm
      _ ≤ max 1 ((3 * s / r) ^ d) * ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hnon
  · have hrs : r ≤ s := le_of_not_ge hsr
    obtain ⟨t, htcover, htcard⟩ := aux_exists_finset_cover_closedBall_card_le hr hrs
    have hcover : ∀ y ∈ closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) s,
        ∃ z ∈ t, y ∈ closedBall z r := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨z, hzt, hyz⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (htcover hy)
      exact ⟨z, hzt, hyz⟩
    calc
      (∫ x, wienerEnvelope f s x) ≤ (t.card : ℝ) * ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x :=
        aux_integral_wienerEnvelope_le_card_mul hf hr (le_of_lt hs) hfr t hcover
      _ ≤ (3 * s / r) ^ d * ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htcard hnon
      _ ≤ max 1 ((3 * s / r) ^ d) * ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hnon

name: Auto.wienerNorm_le_max_one_three_mul_div_pow_mul
statement:
theorem wienerNorm_le_max_one_three_mul_div_pow_mul {d : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → 𝕜} (hf : Continuous f)
    {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) :
    wienerNorm f s ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C_wienerNormRadiusIndependence d r s) * wienerNorm f r
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ := C_wienerNormRadiusIndependence d r s
  have hCpos : 0 < C := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
  by_cases htop : wienerNorm f r = ∞
  · change wienerNorm f s ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C * wienerNorm f r
    rw [htop]
    rw [ENNReal.mul_top (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.mpr hCpos)]
    exact le_top
  · have hfr : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f r) :=
      (lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable
        (continuous_wienerEnvelope hf r).aestronglyMeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ fun x => aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hf (le_of_lt hr) x)).mp (by
          simpa [wienerNorm] using htop)
    have hfs : Integrable (wienerEnvelope f s) :=
      aux_integrable_wienerEnvelope_of_integrable hf hr (le_of_lt hs) hfr
    have hreal := aux_integral_wienerEnvelope_le_max_one_three_mul_div_pow_mul hf hr hs hfr
    have hwr : wienerNorm f r = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x) := by
      unfold wienerNorm
      symm
      exact ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hfr
        (ae_of_all _ fun x => aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hf (le_of_lt hr) x)
    have hws : wienerNorm f s = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, wienerEnvelope f s x) := by
      unfold wienerNorm
      symm
      exact ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hfs
        (ae_of_all _ fun x => aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hf (le_of_lt hs) x)
    calc
      wienerNorm f s = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, wienerEnvelope f s x) := hws
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ∫ x, wienerEnvelope f r x) :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by simpa [C, C_wienerNormRadiusIndependence] using hreal)
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal C * wienerNorm f r := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul hCpos.le, ← hwr]

name: Auto.memW0_iff_integrable_wienerEnvelope
statement:
theorem memW0_iff_integrable_wienerEnvelope {d : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → 𝕜} (hf : Continuous f) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    MemW0 f ↔ Integrable (wienerEnvelope f r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [MemW0]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
    exact (integrable_wienerEnvelope_iff hf zero_lt_one hr).mp h
  · intro h
    exact ⟨hf, (integrable_wienerEnvelope_iff hf hr zero_lt_one).mp h⟩

name: Auto.aux_integral_norm_le_integral_wienerEnvelope
statement:

name: Auto.aux_norm_mul_unitClosedBallVolume_le_integral_wienerEnvelope
statement:
theorem aux_norm_mul_unitClosedBallVolume_le_integral_wienerEnvelope {d : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → 𝕜} (hf : MemW0 f)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    ‖f x‖ * volume.real (closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1) ≤
      ∫ y, wienerEnvelope f 1 y
proof:
:= by
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let s : Set E := closedBall x 1
  have hs : MeasurableSet s := measurableSet_closedBall
  have hs_fin : volume s ≠ ∞ := measure_closedBall_lt_top.ne
  have hbound : ∀ y ∈ s, ‖f x‖ ≤ wienerEnvelope f 1 y := by
    intro y hy
    apply aux_norm_le_wienerEnvelope_of_mem_closedBall hf.aux_continuous
    simpa [s, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_comm] using hy
  have hset : ‖f x‖ * volume.real s ≤ ∫ y in s, wienerEnvelope f 1 y :=
    setIntegral_ge_of_const_le_real hs hs_fin hbound hf.aux_integrable_envelope.integrableOn
  calc
    ‖f x‖ * volume.real (closedBall (0 : E) 1) = ‖f x‖ * volume.real s := by
      rw [show volume.real s = volume.real (closedBall (0 : E) 1) by
        simpa [s] using MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_real_closedBall_center volume x 1]
    _ ≤ ∫ y in s, wienerEnvelope f 1 y := hset
    _ ≤ ∫ y, wienerEnvelope f 1 y :=
      setIntegral_le_integral hf.aux_integrable_envelope
        (ae_of_all _ fun y ↦ aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hf.aux_continuous zero_le_one y)

name: Auto.aux_unitClosedBallVolume_pos

name: Auto.aux_unitClosedBallVolume_eq_gamma
statement:
theorem aux_unitClosedBallVolume_eq_gamma {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    volume.real (closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1) =
      (Real.sqrt Real.pi) ^ d / Real.Gamma ((d : ℝ) / 2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (Fin d) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hd
  change (volume (closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)).toReal = _
  rw [EuclideanSpace.volume_closedBall]
  simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_one, Fintype.card_fin, one_pow, one_mul,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal_eq_iff]
  positivity

name: Auto.aux_norm_le_integral_wienerEnvelope_div_unitClosedBallVolume
statement:

    [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜] {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → 𝕜} (hf : MemW0 f)

name: Auto.MemW0.aux_memLp_top
statement:
theorem MemW0.aux_memLp_top {d : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜]

    ((∫ y, wienerEnvelope f 1 y) /
      volume.real (closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1))

name: Auto.MemW0.memLp
statement:
theorem MemW0.memLp {d : ℕ} {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → 𝕜} (hf : MemW0 f) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    MemLp f p volume
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p ∞ with rfl | hp_top
  · exact hf.aux_memLp_top
  have hp_zero : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hp_zero
    rw [hp_zero] at hp
    norm_num at hp
  apply (integrable_norm_rpow_iff hf.aux_continuous.aestronglyMeasurable hp_zero hp_top).mp
  let C : ℝ := max 1 ((∫ y, wienerEnvelope f 1 y) /
    volume.real (closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1))
  have hC : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C := by
    intro x
    exact (aux_norm_le_integral_wienerEnvelope_div_unitClosedBallVolume hf x).trans
      (le_max_right _ _)
  have hp_real : 1 ≤ p.toReal := by
    simpa using ENNReal.toReal_mono hp_top hp
  have hp_sub : 0 ≤ p.toReal - 1 := sub_nonneg.mpr hp_real
  refine (hf.aux_integrable.norm.const_mul (C ^ (p.toReal - 1))).mono' ?_ ?_
  · exact ((Real.continuous_rpow_const ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).comp hf.aux_continuous.norm)
      |>.aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)]
    calc
      ‖f x‖ ^ p.toReal = ‖f x‖ ^ (p.toReal - 1) * ‖f x‖ := by
        calc
          ‖f x‖ ^ p.toReal = ‖f x‖ ^ ((p.toReal - 1) + 1) := by
            congr 1
            linarith
          _ = ‖f x‖ ^ (p.toReal - 1) * ‖f x‖ ^ 1 :=
            Real.rpow_add_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hp_sub zero_le_one
          _ = ‖f x‖ ^ (p.toReal - 1) * ‖f x‖ := by simp
      _ ≤ C ^ (p.toReal - 1) * ‖f x‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg _) (hC x) hp_sub)
          (norm_nonneg _)

      (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mpr hf).eLpNorm_ne_top
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal htop, ← integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm hf.1]

name: Auto.aux_eLpNorm_interpolation_one_top_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem aux_eLpNorm_interpolation_one_top_of_one_lt
    {E 𝕜 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜] {μ : Measure E}
    {f : E → 𝕜} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q) :
    eLpNorm f (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ ≤
      (eLpNorm f 1 μ) ^ q⁻¹ * (eLpNorm f ∞ μ) ^ (1 - q⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  let a : E → ℝ := fun x ↦ ‖f x‖
  let b : E → ℝ := fun x ↦ ‖f x‖ ^ (q - 1)
  have hq0 : 0 < q := zero_lt_one.trans hq
  have hqsub : 0 < q - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hq
  have ha : AEStronglyMeasurable a μ := hf.norm
  have hmul :
      eLpNorm (fun x ↦ a x * b x) 1 μ ≤
        (1 : ℝ≥0∞) * eLpNorm a 1 μ * eLpNorm b ∞ μ := by
    apply eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_mul_eLpNorm_top 1 ha b (· * ·) 1
    filter_upwards with x
    simp
  have hab : (fun x ↦ a x * b x) = fun x ↦ ‖f x‖ ^ q := by
    funext x
    dsimp [a, b]
    by_cases hx : ‖f x‖ = 0
    · simp [hx, Real.zero_rpow hq0.ne']
    · have hfx : f x ≠ 0 := by
        intro hfx
        apply hx
        simp [hfx]
      have hpos : 0 < (‖f x‖ : ℝ) := norm_pos_iff.mpr hfx
      calc
        ‖f x‖ * ‖f x‖ ^ (q - 1) = ‖f x‖ ^ (1 : ℝ) * ‖f x‖ ^ (q - 1) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_one]
        _ = ‖f x‖ ^ ((1 : ℝ) + (q - 1)) :=
          (@Real.rpow_add ‖f x‖ hpos 1 (q - 1)).symm
        _ = ‖f x‖ ^ q := by
          congr 1
          ring
  have hpow : eLpNorm f (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ ^ q ≤
      eLpNorm f 1 μ * eLpNorm f ∞ μ ^ (q - 1) := by
    have hqsub0 : ENNReal.ofReal (q - 1) ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hqsub)
    calc
      eLpNorm f (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ ^ q =
          eLpNorm (fun x ↦ ‖f x‖ ^ q) 1 μ := by
        symm
        simpa using (eLpNorm_norm_rpow (p := (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) f hq0)
      _ = eLpNorm (fun x ↦ a x * b x) 1 μ := by rw [hab]
      _ ≤ (1 : ℝ≥0∞) * eLpNorm a 1 μ * eLpNorm b ∞ μ := hmul
      _ = eLpNorm f 1 μ * eLpNorm f ∞ μ ^ (q - 1) := by
        rw [show a = fun x ↦ ‖f x‖ by rfl, eLpNorm_norm]
        rw [show b = fun x ↦ ‖f x‖ ^ (q - 1) by rfl,
          eLpNorm_norm_rpow f hqsub]
        rw [ENNReal.top_mul hqsub0, eLpNorm_exponent_top]
        simp
  have hpow' := ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hpow (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)
  rw [← ENNReal.rpow_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0.ne', ENNReal.rpow_one] at hpow'
  rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le), ← ENNReal.rpow_mul] at hpow'
  convert hpow' using 1
  congr 3
  field_simp

name: Auto.aux_eLpNorm_interpolation_one_top_of_one_le
