name: Auto.aux_mean_profile_sSup_le
statement:
theorem aux_mean_profile_sSup_le (n : ℕ) (A : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (h : ∀ xi : ℝ, ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n * ‖iteratedDeriv n F xi‖ ≤ A) :
    ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n *
      sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv n F xi‖) ≤ A
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 0 < ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
  have hs : sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv n F xi‖) ≤
      A / ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n := by
    apply csSup_le
    · exact Set.range_nonempty _
    rintro _ ⟨xi, rfl⟩
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hq).2
    calc
      ‖iteratedDeriv n F xi‖ * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n =
          ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n * ‖iteratedDeriv n F xi‖ := by ring
      _ ≤ A := h xi
  calc
    ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n *
        sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv n F xi‖) ≤
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n * (A / ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hq.le
    _ = A := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hq]

name: Auto.aux_mean_maxUpTo_le
statement:
theorem aux_mean_maxUpTo_le (f : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (B : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ N → f n ≤ B) :
    aux_maxUpTo f N ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  unfold aux_maxUpTo
  apply Finset.max'_le
  intro z hz
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hz with ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
  exact h n (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hn))

name: Auto.aux_mean_gaussian_base_difference
statement:
theorem aux_mean_gaussian_base_difference (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (c beta : ℝ) (phiHat : ℝ → ℂ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbeta0 : 0 ≤ beta) (hbeta1 : beta ≤ 1)
    (hphi : ContDiff ℝ N phiHat)
    (hsupp : tsupport phiHat ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hphiBound : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ N → ∀ xi : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv m phiHat xi‖ ≤ c)
    (x y : ℝ) :
    ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (gaussianBumpQuotient beta phiHat) (x + y) -
        FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (gaussianBumpQuotient beta phiHat) x‖ ≤
      C_meanValueBumpEstimate N *
        (c * aux_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate N) *
        min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
        (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N)
proof:
:= by
  let Q : ℝ → ℂ := gaussianBumpQuotient beta phiHat
  have hQ : ContDiff ℝ N Q :=
    aux_gaussianBumpEstimate_contDiff N beta phiHat hphi
  have hQsupp : tsupport Q ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    change tsupport (fun xi : ℝ =>
      (((Auto.gaussian (beta * xi))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * phiHat xi) ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
    exact tsupport_mul_subset_right.trans hsupp
  have hQcompact : HasCompactSupport Q :=
    isCompact_Icc.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure hQsupp
  let P : ℝ := aux_maxUpTo (fun m : ℕ =>
    ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ m *
      sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv m Q xi‖)) N
  have hPm (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ N) :
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ m *
          sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv m Q xi‖) ≤
        c * C_gaussianBumpEstimate m := by
    apply aux_mean_profile_sSup_le
    intro xi
    dsimp [Q]
    exact aux_gaussianBumpEstimate_pointwise m c beta phiHat hc.le hbeta0 hbeta1
      (hphi.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hm)) hsupp
      (fun k hk z => hphiBound k (hk.trans hm) z) xi
  have hP : P ≤ c * aux_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate N := by
    dsimp [P]
    apply aux_mean_maxUpTo_le
    intro m hm
    calc
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ m *
          sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv m Q xi‖) ≤
        c * C_gaussianBumpEstimate m := hPm m hm
      _ ≤ c * aux_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate N :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (aux_le_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate hm) hc.le
  have hbase := meanValueBumpEstimate N (by omega)
    (FourierTransformInv.fourierInv Q) Q
    ((smoothDecay2 N hN Q hQ hQcompact).1) rfl hQsupp hQ x y
  change ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv Q (x + y) -
      FourierTransformInv.fourierInv Q x‖ ≤ _
  calc
    ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv Q (x + y) -
        FourierTransformInv.fourierInv Q x‖ ≤
      C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * P * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
        (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N) := by
          simpa only [P] using hbase
    _ ≤ C_meanValueBumpEstimate N *
        (c * aux_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate N) *
        min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
        (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N) := by
      have hfactor : 0 ≤ C_meanValueBumpEstimate N *
          min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
          (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N) := by
        apply mul_nonneg
        · apply mul_nonneg
          · unfold C_meanValueBumpEstimate
            positivity
          · exact le_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
        · simp only [bracketBump]
          positivity
      calc
        C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * P * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
            (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N) =
          (C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
            (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N)) * P := by ring
        _ ≤ (C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
            (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N)) *
            (c * aux_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate N) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP hfactor
        _ = C_meanValueBumpEstimate N *
            (c * aux_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate N) *
            min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
              (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N) := by ring

name: Auto.aux_mean_rescaled_difference
statement:
theorem aux_mean_rescaled_difference (N : ℕ) (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a A : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hbase : ∀ u v : ℝ,
      ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv Q (u + v) -
          FourierTransformInv.fourierInv Q u‖ ≤
        A * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |v|) *
          (bracketBump (u + v) ^ N + bracketBump u ^ N))
    (x y : ℝ) :
    ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (fun xi : ℝ => Q (a * xi)) (x + y) -
        FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (fun xi : ℝ => Q (a * xi)) x‖ ≤
      A * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * a⁻¹ * |y|) *
        (scaledBracketBump N a (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N a x)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : 0 ≤ a⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr ha.le
  have hbase' := hbase (a⁻¹ * x) (a⁻¹ * y)
  have harg : a⁻¹ * x + a⁻¹ * y = a⁻¹ * (x + y) := by ring
  rw [harg] at hbase'
  have hscale : |a⁻¹ * y| = a⁻¹ * |y| := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hinv]
  rw [hscale] at hbase'
  rw [aux_inverseFourier_comp_mul_pos Q a (x + y) ha,
    aux_inverseFourier_comp_mul_pos Q a x ha, ← smul_sub,
    norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hinv]
  calc
    a⁻¹ * ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv Q (a⁻¹ * (x + y)) -
        FourierTransformInv.fourierInv Q (a⁻¹ * x)‖ ≤
      a⁻¹ * (A * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * (a⁻¹ * |y|)) *
        (bracketBump (a⁻¹ * (x + y)) ^ N + bracketBump (a⁻¹ * x) ^ N)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbase' hinv
    _ = A * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * a⁻¹ * |y|) *
        (scaledBracketBump N a (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N a x) := by
      simp only [scaledBracketBump, bracketBump]
      ring_nf

name: Auto.aux_mean_gaussian_rescaled_difference
statement:
theorem aux_mean_gaussian_rescaled_difference (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (c beta a : ℝ) (phiHat : ℝ → ℂ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbeta0 : 0 ≤ beta) (hbeta1 : beta ≤ 1) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hphi : ContDiff ℝ N phiHat)
    (hsupp : tsupport phiHat ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hphiBound : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ N → ∀ xi : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv m phiHat xi‖ ≤ c)
    (x y : ℝ) :
    ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv
        (fun xi : ℝ => gaussianBumpQuotient beta phiHat (a * xi)) (x + y) -
      FourierTransformInv.fourierInv
        (fun xi : ℝ => gaussianBumpQuotient beta phiHat (a * xi)) x‖ ≤
      C_meanValueBumpEstimate N *
        (c * aux_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate N) *
        min 1 (2 * Real.pi * a⁻¹ * |y|) *
        (scaledBracketBump N a (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N a x)
proof:
:= by
  exact aux_mean_rescaled_difference N (gaussianBumpQuotient beta phiHat) a
    (C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * (c * aux_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate N)) ha
    (fun u v => aux_mean_gaussian_base_difference N hN c beta phiHat hc hbeta0 hbeta1
      hphi hsupp hphiBound u v) x y

name: Auto.aux_mean_tsupport_comp_two_subset
statement:
theorem aux_mean_tsupport_comp_two_subset (phiHat : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hsupp : tsupport phiHat ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    tsupport (fun xi : ℝ => phiHat (2 * xi)) ⊆ Set.Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  change closure (Function.support (fun xi : ℝ => phiHat (2 * xi))) ⊆
    Set.Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2)
  apply closure_minimal
  · intro xi hxi
    by_contra hxiIcc
    apply hxi
    apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
    intro hmem
    have hscaled := hsupp hmem
    have hinterval : xi ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2) := by
      constructor <;> linarith [hscaled.1, hscaled.2]
    exact (hxiIcc hinterval).elim
  · exact isClosed_Icc

name: Auto.aux_mean_second_tilde_support
statement:
theorem aux_mean_second_tilde_support (phiHat : ℝ → ℂ) (mu lambda t nu : ℝ)
    (hlambda : lambda = 1 / 2)
    (hsupp : tsupport phiHat ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    tsupport (fun xi : ℝ => secondGaussianMultiplier phiHat mu lambda t nu (2 * xi)) ⊆
      Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  change tsupport (fun xi : ℝ =>
    aux_secondGaussianQ phiHat mu lambda (2 * xi) * aux_secondGaussianS t nu (2 * xi)) ⊆
      Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
  refine tsupport_mul_subset_left.trans ?_
  change tsupport (fun xi : ℝ =>
    (((Auto.gaussian (mu * (2 * xi)))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (phiHat (lambda * (2 * xi)) - phiHat (2 * xi))) ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
  refine tsupport_mul_subset_right.trans ?_
  refine (tsupport_sub _ _).trans ?_
  apply Set.union_subset
  · have heq : (fun xi : ℝ => phiHat (lambda * (2 * xi))) = phiHat := by
      funext xi
      rw [hlambda]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [heq]
    exact hsupp
  · exact (aux_mean_tsupport_comp_two_subset phiHat hsupp).trans (by
      intro xi hxi
      constructor <;> linarith [hxi.1, hxi.2])

name: Auto.aux_mean_profile_comp_two_le
statement:
theorem aux_mean_profile_comp_two_le (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ n F) (hFcompact : HasCompactSupport F) (A : ℝ)
    (h : ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n *
      sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv n F xi‖) ≤ A) :
    ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n *
      sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv n (fun xi : ℝ => F (2 * xi)) xi‖) ≤
        (2 : ℝ) ^ n * A
proof:
:= by
  have hFbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv n F xi‖) :=
    (hF.continuous_iteratedDeriv n (by simp)).norm.bddAbove_range_of_hasCompactSupport
      (aux_hasCompactSupport_iteratedDeriv F hFcompact n).norm
  apply aux_mean_profile_sSup_le
  intro xi
  have hmem : ‖iteratedDeriv n F (2 * xi)‖ ≤
      sSup (Set.range fun z : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv n F z‖) :=
    le_csSup hFbdd ⟨2 * xi, rfl⟩
  have hderiv := congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_const_smul hF 2) xi
  rw [hderiv, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  calc
    ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n *
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * ‖iteratedDeriv n F (2 * xi)‖) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ n *
        (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n * ‖iteratedDeriv n F (2 * xi)‖) := by ring
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n *
        (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n *
          sSup (Set.range fun z : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv n F z‖)) := by
          gcongr
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n * A := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (by positivity)

name: Auto.aux_mean_second_tilde_base_difference
statement:
theorem aux_mean_second_tilde_base_difference (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (phi phiHat : ℝ → ℂ) (hphiW0 : MemW0 phi)
    (hphiHat : phiHat = FourierTransform.fourier phi) (hc : 0 < c)
    (mu lambda t nu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 < mu) (hmulambda : mu ≤ lambda)
    (hlambda : lambda ≤ 1 / 2) (hlambdaEq : lambda = 1 / 2)
    (ht : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 ≤ t) (hnu : nu ∈ Set.Ico (-1 : ℝ) 0)
    (hplateau : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2), phiHat u = 1)
    (hphi : ContDiff ℝ N phiHat) (hsupp : tsupport phiHat ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hphiBound : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ N → ∀ xi : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv m phiHat xi‖ ≤ c)
    (x y : ℝ) :
    ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv
        (fun xi : ℝ => secondGaussianMultiplier phiHat mu lambda t nu (2 * xi)) (x + y) -
      FourierTransformInv.fourierInv
        (fun xi : ℝ => secondGaussianMultiplier phiHat mu lambda t nu (2 * xi)) x‖ ≤
      C_meanValueBumpEstimate N *
        (c * aux_maxUpTo (fun l => (2 : ℝ) ^ l * C_secondGaussianEstimate l) N) *
        min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
          (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N)
proof:
:= by
  let R : ℝ → ℂ := secondGaussianMultiplier phiHat mu lambda t nu
  let T : ℝ → ℂ := fun xi : ℝ => R (2 * xi)
  have hlambdaPos : 0 < lambda := hmu.trans_le hmulambda
  have hRcont : ContDiff ℝ N R := by
    simpa only [R] using
      (secondGaussianEstimate c N phi phiHat hphiW0 hphiHat hc mu lambda t nu hmu hmulambda
        hlambda ht hnu hplateau hphi hsupp hphiBound).1
  have hRcompact : HasCompactSupport R := by
    simpa only [R] using
      aux_secondGaussianMultiplier_hasCompactSupport phiHat mu lambda t nu hlambdaPos.ne' hsupp
  have hTcont : ContDiff ℝ N T := by
    dsimp [T]
    exact hRcont.comp (by fun_prop)
  have hTsupp : tsupport T ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
    dsimp [T, R]
    exact aux_mean_second_tilde_support phiHat mu lambda t nu hlambdaEq hsupp
  have hTcompact : HasCompactSupport T :=
    isCompact_Icc.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure hTsupp
  let P : ℝ := aux_maxUpTo (fun m : ℕ =>
    ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ m *
      sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv m T xi‖)) N
  have hPm (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ N) :
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ m *
          sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv m T xi‖) ≤
        c * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * C_secondGaussianEstimate m) := by
    have hRm : ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ m *
        sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv m R xi‖) ≤
          c * C_secondGaussianEstimate m := by
      have hsecond := secondGaussianEstimate c m phi phiHat hphiW0 hphiHat hc mu lambda t nu
        hmu hmulambda hlambda ht hnu hplateau
        (hphi.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hm)) hsupp
        (fun k hk z => hphiBound k (hk.trans hm) z)
      calc
        ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ m *
            sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv m R xi‖) ≤
          ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ m *
            max (∫ xi : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv m R xi‖)
              (sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv m R xi‖)) := by
                gcongr
                exact le_max_right _ _
        _ ≤ c * C_secondGaussianEstimate m := by
          simpa only [R] using hsecond.2
    calc
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ m *
          sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv m T xi‖) ≤
        (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (c * C_secondGaussianEstimate m) := by
          simpa only [T] using
            aux_mean_profile_comp_two_le m R (hRcont.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hm)) hRcompact
              (c * C_secondGaussianEstimate m) hRm
      _ = c * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * C_secondGaussianEstimate m) := by ring
  have hP : P ≤ c * aux_maxUpTo (fun l => (2 : ℝ) ^ l * C_secondGaussianEstimate l) N := by
    dsimp [P]
    apply aux_mean_maxUpTo_le
    intro m hm
    calc
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ m *
          sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv m T xi‖) ≤
        c * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * C_secondGaussianEstimate m) := hPm m hm
      _ ≤ c * aux_maxUpTo (fun l => (2 : ℝ) ^ l * C_secondGaussianEstimate l) N :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (aux_le_maxUpTo (fun l => (2 : ℝ) ^ l * C_secondGaussianEstimate l) hm) hc.le
  have hbase := meanValueBumpEstimate N (by omega)
    (FourierTransformInv.fourierInv T) T
    ((smoothDecay2 N hN T hTcont hTcompact).1) rfl hTsupp hTcont x y
  change ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv T (x + y) -
      FourierTransformInv.fourierInv T x‖ ≤ _
  calc
    ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv T (x + y) -
        FourierTransformInv.fourierInv T x‖ ≤
      C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * P * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
        (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N) := by
          simpa only [P] using hbase
    _ ≤ C_meanValueBumpEstimate N *
        (c * aux_maxUpTo (fun l => (2 : ℝ) ^ l * C_secondGaussianEstimate l) N) *
        min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
          (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N) := by
      have hfactor : 0 ≤ C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
          (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N) := by
        apply mul_nonneg
        · apply mul_nonneg
          · unfold C_meanValueBumpEstimate
            positivity
          · exact le_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
        · simp only [bracketBump]
          positivity
      calc
        C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * P * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
            (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N) =
          (C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
            (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N)) * P := by ring
        _ ≤ (C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
            (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N)) *
            (c * aux_maxUpTo (fun l => (2 : ℝ) ^ l * C_secondGaussianEstimate l) N) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP hfactor
        _ = C_meanValueBumpEstimate N *
            (c * aux_maxUpTo (fun l => (2 : ℝ) ^ l * C_secondGaussianEstimate l) N) *
            min 1 (2 * Real.pi * |y|) *
              (bracketBump (x + y) ^ N + bracketBump x ^ N) := by ring

name: Auto.aux_mean_min_double
statement:
theorem aux_mean_min_double (z : ℝ) :
    min 1 (2 * z) ≤ 2 * min 1 z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzOne : 1 ≤ z
  · calc
      min 1 (2 * z) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * 1 := by norm_num
      _ = 2 * min 1 z := by rw [min_eq_left hzOne]
  · have hzOne' : z ≤ 1 := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hzOne)
    calc
      min 1 (2 * z) ≤ 2 * z := min_le_right _ _
      _ = 2 * min 1 z := by rw [min_eq_right hzOne']

name: Auto.aux_mean_half_scale_compare
statement:
theorem aux_mean_half_scale_compare (N : ℕ) {lambdaMinus lambdaPlus x y : ℝ}
    (hlambdaMinus : 0 < lambdaMinus) (hlambdaPlus : 0 < lambdaPlus)
    (hhalf : lambdaPlus = 2 * lambdaMinus) :
    min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaMinus⁻¹ * |y|) *
        (scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus x) ≤
      4 * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
        (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x)
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : lambdaMinus ≤ lambdaPlus := by rw [hhalf]; nlinarith
  have hAt : lambdaPlus ≤ 2 * lambdaMinus := by rw [hhalf]
  have hbracket (z : ℝ) :
      scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus z ≤ 2 * scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus z :=
    aux_scaledBracketBump_scale_le N hlambdaMinus hlambdaPlus hscale (by norm_num) hAt
  have hbracketSum :
      scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus x ≤
        2 * (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x) := by
    calc
      scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus x ≤
          2 * scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + 2 * scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x :=
        add_le_add (hbracket (x + y)) (hbracket x)
      _ = 2 * (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x) := by ring
  have hphase : 2 * Real.pi * lambdaMinus⁻¹ * |y| =
      2 * (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) := by
    rw [hhalf]
    field_simp [hlambdaMinus.ne']
  let z : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|
  have hmin : min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaMinus⁻¹ * |y|) ≤ 2 * min 1 z := by
    rw [hphase]
    exact aux_mean_min_double z
  have hsumNonneg :
      0 ≤ scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x := by
    apply add_nonneg <;> exact aux_scaledBracketBump_nonneg N hlambdaPlus _
  have hminNonneg : 0 ≤ min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaMinus⁻¹ * |y|) := by
    exact le_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  calc
    min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaMinus⁻¹ * |y|) *
        (scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus x) ≤
        min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaMinus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (2 * (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbracketSum hminNonneg
    _ ≤ (2 * min 1 z) *
          (2 * (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmin (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hsumNonneg)
    _ = 4 * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
        (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x) := by
      dsimp [z]
      ring

name: Auto.meanFourScaleGaussianKernel
statement:
theorem meanFourScaleGaussianKernel (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (phi phiHat : ℝ → ℂ) (hphiW0 : MemW0 phi)
    (hphiHat : phiHat = FourierTransform.fourier phi) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hsupp : tsupport phiHat ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hplateau : ∀ xi ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2), phiHat xi = 1)
    (hphi : ContDiff ℝ N phiHat)
    (hphiBound : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ N → ∀ xi : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv m phiHat xi‖ ≤ c)
    (muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu : ℝ)
    (hmuMinus : 0 < muMinus) (hmuPlus : 0 < muPlus)
    (hlambdaMinus : 0 < lambdaMinus) (hlambdaPlus : 0 < lambdaPlus)
    (hscales : 2 * muMinus ≤ 2 * lambdaMinus ∧ 2 * lambdaMinus ≤ lambdaPlus ∧
      lambdaPlus ≤ muPlus)
    (hlambdaEq : lambdaPlus = 2 * lambdaMinus)
    (hnu : nu ∈ Set.Ico (-1 : ℝ) 0) :
    MemW0 (fourScaleGaussianRho phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu) ∧
      ∀ x y : ℝ,
        ‖fourScaleGaussianRho phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
          fourScaleGaussianRho phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu x‖ ≤
          c * C_meanFourScaleGaussianKernel N *
            min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
              (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hscales with ⟨hscale0, hscale1, hscale2⟩
  let betaMinus : ℝ := muMinus * Real.sqrt |nu| / lambdaMinus
  let beta : ℝ := muMinus * Real.sqrt |nu| / lambdaPlus
  let a : ℝ := lambdaMinus / lambdaPlus
  let t : ℝ := Real.sqrt (muPlus ^ 2 - muMinus ^ 2) / lambdaPlus
  rcases aux_fourScaleGaussian_normalized_parameters
    hmuMinus hlambdaMinus hlambdaPlus hscale0 hscale1 hnu with
    ⟨hbetaMinus0, hbetaMinusOne, hbeta0, hbetaOne, hbetaPos, hbetaLeA, haOne⟩
  have hbetaMinus0' : 0 ≤ betaMinus := by simpa only [betaMinus] using hbetaMinus0
  have hbetaMinusOne' : betaMinus ≤ 1 := by simpa only [betaMinus] using hbetaMinusOne
  have hbeta0' : 0 ≤ beta := by simpa only [beta] using hbeta0
  have hbetaOne' : beta ≤ 1 := by simpa only [beta] using hbetaOne
  have hbetaPos' : 0 < beta := by simpa only [beta] using hbetaPos
  have hbetaLeA' : beta ≤ a := by simpa only [beta, a] using hbetaLeA
  have haOne' : a ≤ 1 / 2 := by simpa only [a] using haOne
  have haHalf : a = 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp [a]
    rw [hlambdaEq]
    field_simp [hlambdaMinus.ne']
  have ht : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 ≤ t := by
    simpa only [t] using
      aux_fourScaleGaussian_t_lower_bound hmuMinus hmuPlus hlambdaMinus hlambdaPlus
        hscale0 hscale1 hscale2
  let K : ℝ := C_meanValueBumpEstimate N
  let G : ℝ := aux_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate N
  let S : ℝ := aux_maxUpTo (fun l => (2 : ℝ) ^ l * C_secondGaussianEstimate l) N
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by
    dsimp [K, C_meanValueBumpEstimate]
    positivity
  have hG : 0 ≤ G := by
    dsimp [G]
    exact (aux_C_gaussianBumpEstimate_nonneg 0).trans
      (aux_le_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := by
    dsimp [S]
    have hzero : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ 0 * C_secondGaussianEstimate 0 := by
      simpa using aux_C_secondGaussianEstimate_nonneg 0
    exact hzero.trans
      (aux_le_maxUpTo (fun l => (2 : ℝ) ^ l * C_secondGaussianEstimate l) (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hKG : 0 ≤ K * (c * G) := mul_nonneg hK (mul_nonneg hc.le hG)
  have hKS : 0 ≤ K * (c * S) := mul_nonneg hK (mul_nonneg hc.le hS)
  have h0eq := aux_fourScaleGaussian_varRho0_rescale phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu hlambdaMinus.ne'
  have h1eq := aux_fourScaleGaussian_varRho1_rescale phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu hlambdaPlus.ne'
  have h2eq := aux_fourScaleGaussian_varRho2_rescale phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu
    hlambdaPlus.ne'
  have h0raw (x y : ℝ) :
      ‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu x‖ ≤
        K * (c * G) * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaMinus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus x) := by
    rw [h0eq]
    simpa only [K, G] using
      aux_mean_gaussian_rescaled_difference N hN c betaMinus lambdaMinus phiHat hc hbetaMinus0'
        hbetaMinusOne' hlambdaMinus hphi hsupp hphiBound x y
  have h1raw (x y : ℝ) :
      ‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho1 phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianVarRho1 phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu x‖ ≤
        K * (c * G) * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x) := by
    rw [h1eq]
    let F : ℝ → ℂ := FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (fun xi : ℝ => gaussianBumpQuotient
      (muMinus * Real.sqrt |nu| / lambdaPlus) phiHat (lambdaPlus * xi))
    change ‖-F (x + y) - -F x‖ ≤ _
    have hneg : -F (x + y) - -F x = -(F (x + y) - F x) := by ring
    rw [hneg, norm_neg]
    simpa [F, K, G, beta] using
      aux_mean_gaussian_rescaled_difference N hN c beta lambdaPlus phiHat hc hbeta0'
        hbetaOne' hlambdaPlus hphi hsupp hphiBound x y
  have h2frequency :
      (fun xi : ℝ => secondGaussianMultiplier phiHat beta a t nu (lambdaPlus * xi)) =
        (fun xi : ℝ => (fun z : ℝ => secondGaussianMultiplier phiHat beta a t nu (2 * z))
          (lambdaMinus * xi)) := by
    funext xi
    rw [hlambdaEq]
    congr 1
    ring
  have h2raw (x y : ℝ) :
      ‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu x‖ ≤
        K * (c * S) * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaMinus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus x) := by
    rw [h2eq, h2frequency]
    simpa only [K, S] using aux_mean_rescaled_difference N
      (fun z : ℝ => secondGaussianMultiplier phiHat beta a t nu (2 * z)) lambdaMinus
      (C_meanValueBumpEstimate N *
        (c * aux_maxUpTo (fun l => (2 : ℝ) ^ l * C_secondGaussianEstimate l) N))
      hlambdaMinus
      (fun u v => aux_mean_second_tilde_base_difference c N hN phi phiHat hphiW0 hphiHat hc
        beta a t nu hbetaPos' hbetaLeA' haOne' haHalf ht hnu hplateau hphi hsupp hphiBound u v) x y
  have h0 (x y : ℝ) :
      ‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu x‖ ≤
        4 * K * (c * G) * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x) := by
    calc
      ‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu (x + y) -
          fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu x‖ ≤
        K * (c * G) * (min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaMinus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus x)) := by
          convert h0raw x y using 1; ring
      _ ≤ K * (c * G) *
          (4 * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
            (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (aux_mean_half_scale_compare N hlambdaMinus hlambdaPlus hlambdaEq) hKG
      _ = 4 * K * (c * G) * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x) := by ring
  have h2 (x y : ℝ) :
      ‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu x‖ ≤
        4 * K * (c * S) * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x) := by
    calc
      ‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
          fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu x‖ ≤
        K * (c * S) * (min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaMinus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaMinus x)) := by
          convert h2raw x y using 1; ring
      _ ≤ K * (c * S) *
          (4 * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
            (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (aux_mean_half_scale_compare N hlambdaMinus hlambdaPlus hlambdaEq) hKS
      _ = 4 * K * (c * S) * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x) := by ring
  have hmem := (fourScaleGaussianKernel c N hN phi phiHat hphiW0 hphiHat hc hsupp hplateau hphi
    hphiBound muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu hmuMinus hmuPlus hlambdaMinus hlambdaPlus
    ⟨hscale0, hscale1, hscale2⟩ hnu).1
  refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
  intro x y
  have hdecompEq := (gaussianBumpDecomposition phi phiHat hphiW0 hphiHat hsupp hplateau
    hmuMinus hmuPlus hlambdaMinus hlambdaPlus ⟨hscale0, hscale1, hscale2⟩ hnu).2
  have hdecomp (z : ℝ) :
      fourScaleGaussianRho phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu z =
        (fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu z +
          fourScaleGaussianVarRho1 phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu z) +
          fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu z := by
    simpa only [Pi.add_apply] using congrFun hdecompEq z
  have hd :
      fourScaleGaussianRho phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianRho phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu x =
      ((fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu (x + y) -
          fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu x) +
        (fourScaleGaussianVarRho1 phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
          fourScaleGaussianVarRho1 phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu x)) +
        (fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
          fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu x) := by
    rw [hdecomp (x + y), hdecomp x]
    ring
  rw [hd]
  calc
    ‖(fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu x +
      (fourScaleGaussianVarRho1 phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianVarRho1 phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu x)) +
      (fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu x)‖ ≤
      ‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu x +
        (fourScaleGaussianVarRho1 phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
          fourScaleGaussianVarRho1 phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu x)‖ +
        ‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
          fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu x‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianVarRho0 phiHat muMinus lambdaMinus nu x‖ +
      ‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho1 phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
        fourScaleGaussianVarRho1 phiHat muMinus lambdaPlus nu x‖) +
        ‖fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu (x + y) -
          fourScaleGaussianVarRho2 phiHat muMinus muPlus lambdaMinus lambdaPlus nu x‖ :=
        add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl
    _ ≤ (4 * K * (c * G) * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
        (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x) +
      K * (c * G) * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
        (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x)) +
        4 * K * (c * S) * min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x) :=
        add_le_add (add_le_add (h0 x y) (h1raw x y)) (h2 x y)
    _ = c * C_meanFourScaleGaussianKernel N *
        min 1 (2 * Real.pi * lambdaPlus⁻¹ * |y|) *
          (scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus (x + y) + scaledBracketBump N lambdaPlus x) := by
      dsimp [C_meanFourScaleGaussianKernel, K, G, S]
      ring

name: Auto.aux_mean_maxUpTo_lt
statement:
theorem aux_mean_maxUpTo_lt (f : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (B : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ N → f n < B) :
    aux_maxUpTo f N < B
proof:
:= by
  unfold aux_maxUpTo
  apply (Finset.max'_lt_iff _ _).mpr
  intro z hz
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hz with ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
  exact h n (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hn))

name: Auto.aux_C_meanFourScaleGaussianKernel_bound
statement:
theorem aux_C_meanFourScaleGaussianKernel_bound (N : ℕ) :
    C_meanFourScaleGaussianKernel N ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  let K : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * N + 1)
  let G : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (8 * (N + 1) ^ 2)
  let S : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 20 * (N + 1) ^ 3)
  let M : ℝ := aux_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate N
  let T : ℝ := aux_maxUpTo (fun n => (2 : ℝ) ^ n * C_secondGaussianEstimate n) N
  have hK : C_meanValueBumpEstimate N ≤ K := by
    simpa only [K] using aux_C_meanValueBumpEstimate_le N
  have hM : M ≤ G := by
    dsimp [M, G]
    apply aux_mean_maxUpTo_le
    intro n hn
    calc
      C_gaussianBumpEstimate n ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (8 * (n + 1) ^ 2) :=
        (constantGaussianBumpEstimate n).1
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (8 * (N + 1) ^ 2) := by
        apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num)
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left 8
          (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.succ_le_succ hn) 2)
  have hT : T ≤ S := by
    dsimp [T, S]
    apply aux_mean_maxUpTo_le
    intro n hn
    have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ N :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hn
    have hsecond : C_secondGaussianEstimate n ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (20 * (N + 1) ^ 3) := by
      calc
        C_secondGaussianEstimate n ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (20 * (n + 1) ^ 3) :=
          (constantSecondGaussianEstimate n).1
        _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (20 * (N + 1) ^ 3) := by
          apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num)
          exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left 20
            (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.succ_le_succ hn) 3)
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ n * C_secondGaussianEstimate n ≤
          (2 : ℝ) ^ N * (2 : ℝ) ^ (20 * (N + 1) ^ 3) :=
        mul_le_mul hpow hsecond (aux_C_secondGaussianEstimate_nonneg n) (by positivity)
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (N + 20 * (N + 1) ^ 3) := by rw [← pow_add]
  have hMnonneg : 0 ≤ M := by
    dsimp [M]
    exact (aux_C_gaussianBumpEstimate_nonneg 0).trans
      (aux_le_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hTnonneg : 0 ≤ T := by
    dsimp [T]
    have hzero : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ 0 * C_secondGaussianEstimate 0 := by
      simpa using aux_C_secondGaussianEstimate_nonneg 0
    exact hzero.trans
      (aux_le_maxUpTo (fun n => (2 : ℝ) ^ n * C_secondGaussianEstimate n) (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hfirst : 5 * C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * M ≤ 5 * K * G := by
    have hKG : C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * M ≤ K * G :=
      mul_le_mul hK hM hMnonneg (by positivity)
    nlinarith [hKG]
  have hsecond : 4 * C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * T ≤ 4 * K * S := by
    have hKT : C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * T ≤ K * S :=
      mul_le_mul hK hT hTnonneg (by positivity)
    nlinarith [hKT]
  have hcubeOne : 1 ≤ (N + 1) ^ 3 := by
    calc
      1 = 1 ^ 3 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ (N + 1) ^ 3 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _)) 3
  have hNcube : N ≤ (N + 1) ^ 3 := by
    calc
      N ≤ N + 1 := Nat.le_succ _
      _ = (N + 1) ^ 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ (N + 1) ^ 3 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos _) (by omega)
  have hsqCube : (N + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (N + 1) ^ 3 :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos _) (by omega)
  have hExpFirst : 4 + 2 * N + 8 * (N + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1 := by
    omega
  have hExpSecond : 3 * N + 3 + 20 * (N + 1) ^ 3 ≤ 30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1 := by
    omega
  have hfirstPow : 5 * K * G ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1) := by
    calc
      5 * K * G ≤ 8 * K * G := by
        have hKGnonneg : 0 ≤ K * G := mul_nonneg (by dsimp [K]; positivity)
          (by dsimp [G]; positivity)
        nlinarith
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (4 + 2 * N + 8 * (N + 1) ^ 2) := by
        dsimp [K, G]
        rw [show (8 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ 3 by norm_num, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1) :=
        pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hExpFirst
  have hsecondPow : 4 * K * S ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1) := by
    calc
      4 * K * S = (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * N + 3 + 20 * (N + 1) ^ 3) := by
        dsimp [K, S]
        rw [show (4 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 by norm_num, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1) :=
        pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hExpSecond
  have htargetPos : 0 < 30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 := by positivity
  rw [C_meanFourScaleGaussianKernel]
  change 5 * C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * M + 4 * C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * T ≤ _
  calc
    5 * C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * M + 4 * C_meanValueBumpEstimate N * T ≤
        5 * K * G + 4 * K * S := add_le_add hfirst hsecond
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1) +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1) := add_le_add hfirstPow hsecondPow
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3) := by
      calc
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1) +
            (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1) =
            (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1) * 2 := by ring
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((30 * (N + 1) ^ 3 - 1) + 1) := (pow_succ _ _).symm
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (30 * (N + 1) ^ 3) := by
          congr 1

name: Auto.aux_C_meanFourScaleGaussianKernel_two_lt_value
statement:
theorem aux_C_meanFourScaleGaussianKernel_two_lt_value :
    C_meanFourScaleGaussianKernel 2 < 20397963318112
proof:
:= by
  have hM : aux_maxUpTo C_gaussianBumpEstimate 2 < 124 := by
    apply aux_mean_maxUpTo_lt
    intro n hn
    interval_cases n
    · exact (constantGaussianBumpEstimate 0).2.1.trans (by norm_num)
    · exact (constantGaussianBumpEstimate 0).2.2.1.trans (by norm_num)
    · exact (constantGaussianBumpEstimate 0).2.2.2.1
  have hS : aux_maxUpTo (fun n => (2 : ℝ) ^ n * C_secondGaussianEstimate n) 2 <
      4 * 159359088384 := by
    apply aux_mean_maxUpTo_lt
    intro n hn

name: Auto.aux_finiteHolder_lintegral
statement:
theorem aux_finiteHolder_lintegral {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → α → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (f i) μ)
    (p : Fin m → ℝ) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1) (hp_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) :
    ∫⁻ x, ∏ i, (f i x) ^ p i ∂μ ≤ ∏ i, (∫⁻ x, f i x ∂μ) ^ p i
proof:
:= by

name: Auto.aux_lintegral_prod_le_eLpNorm_fintype
statement:
theorem aux_lintegral_prod_le_eLpNorm_fintype {α ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    [Fintype ι] (μ : Measure α) (hι : 0 < Fintype.card ι)
    (f : ι → α → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (f i) μ) :
    ∫⁻ x, ∏ i, f i x ∂μ ≤ ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0∞) μ
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := Fintype.card ι
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [r] using
      (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hι) : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≠ 0)
  have hp : ∑ _i : ι, r⁻¹ = 1 := by
    simp [r, hr]
  have hp_nonneg : ∀ i : ι, 0 ≤ r⁻¹ := fun _ => inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)
  have hholder :
      ∫⁻ x, ∏ i, ((f i x) ^ r) ^ r⁻¹ ∂μ ≤
        ∏ i, (∫⁻ x, f i x ^ r ∂μ) ^ r⁻¹ := by
    simpa using ENNReal.lintegral_prod_norm_pow_le (ι := ι) (μ := μ) Finset.univ
      (f := fun i x => (f i x) ^ r)
      (fun i _ => ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const.measurable.comp_aemeasurable (hf i))
      (p := fun _ => r⁻¹) hp (fun i _ => hp_nonneg i)
  have hnorm (i : ι) :
      (∫⁻ x, f i x ^ r ∂μ) ^ r⁻¹ = eLpNorm (f i) (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0∞) μ := by
    symm
    rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal]
    · simp [r]
    · simpa [r] using hr
    · exact ENNReal.coe_ne_top
  calc
    (∫⁻ x, ∏ i, f i x ∂μ) =
        ∫⁻ x, ∏ i, ((f i x) ^ r) ^ r⁻¹ ∂μ := by
          apply lintegral_congr
          intro x
          simp [← ENNReal.rpow_mul, hr]
    _ ≤ ∏ i, (∫⁻ x, f i x ^ r ∂μ) ^ r⁻¹ := hholder
    _ = ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0∞) μ := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact hnorm i

name: Auto.aux_abs_integral_mul_le_holder
statement:
theorem aux_abs_integral_mul_le_holder {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) (f g : α → ℝ)
    (hf : MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ) (hg : MemLp g (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ) :
    |∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ| ≤
      (∫ x, |f x| ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) * (∫ x, |g x| ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    |∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ| ≤ ∫ x, |f x * g x| ∂μ := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ = ∫ x, ‖f x‖ * ‖g x‖ ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with x
      rw [abs_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ (∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) *
        (∫ x, ‖g x‖ ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q) :=
      integral_mul_norm_le_Lp_mul_Lq hpq hf hg
    _ = (∫ x, |f x| ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) *
        (∫ x, |g x| ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q) := by
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: Auto.aux_weightedCauchySchwarz
statement:
theorem aux_weightedCauchySchwarz {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (w A B : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    (hA : MemLp (fun x => Real.sqrt (w x) * A x) 2 μ)
    (hB : MemLp (fun x => Real.sqrt (w x) * B x) 2 μ) :
    |∫ x, w x * A x * B x ∂μ| ≤
      (∫ x, |Real.sqrt (w x) * A x| ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) *
        (∫ x, |Real.sqrt (w x) * B x| ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hcs := aux_abs_integral_mul_le_holder μ
    (p := (2 : ℝ)) (q := (2 : ℝ)) Real.HolderConjugate.two_two
    (fun x => Real.sqrt (w x) * A x) (fun x => Real.sqrt (w x) * B x)
    (by simpa using hA) (by simpa using hB)
  convert hcs using 1
  apply congrArg abs
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with x
  calc
    w x * A x * B x =
        (Real.sqrt (w x) * Real.sqrt (w x)) * A x * B x := by
      nth_rw 1 [← Real.mul_self_sqrt (hw x)]
    _ = Real.sqrt (w x) * A x * (Real.sqrt (w x) * B x) := by ring

name: Auto.aux_weightedCauchySchwarz_square_bound
statement:
theorem aux_weightedCauchySchwarz_square_bound {T X Y : ℝ}
    (hX : 0 ≤ X) (hY : 0 ≤ Y)
    (h : |T| ≤ Real.sqrt X * Real.sqrt Y) :
    |T| ^ 2 ≤ X * Y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    |T| ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt X * Real.sqrt Y) ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg T)
        (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg X) (Real.sqrt_nonneg Y))).mpr h
    _ = X * Y := by rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hX, Real.sq_sqrt hY]

name: Auto.aux_finite_weightedCauchySchwarz
statement:
theorem aux_finite_weightedCauchySchwarz
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (J : ℕ)
    (r w A : Fin J → α → ℝ) (B : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ j x, 0 ≤ w j x)
    (hrw : ∀ j x, |r j x| ≤ w j x)
    (hA : ∀ j, MemLp (fun x => Real.sqrt (w j x) * A j x) 2 μ)
    (hB : ∀ j, MemLp (fun x => Real.sqrt (w j x) * B x) 2 μ)
    (hrAB : ∀ j, Integrable (fun x => r j x * A j x * B x) μ) :
    |∑ j, ∫ x, r j x * A j x * B x ∂μ| ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ j, ∫ x, |Real.sqrt (w j x) * A j x| ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ) *
        (∑ j, ∫ x, |Real.sqrt (w j x) * B x| ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  let X : Fin J → ℝ := fun j =>
    ∫ x, |Real.sqrt (w j x) * A j x| ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ
  let Y : Fin J → ℝ := fun j =>
    ∫ x, |Real.sqrt (w j x) * B x| ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ
  have hX (j : Fin J) : 0 ≤ X j := by
    apply integral_nonneg
    intro x
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _
  have hY (j : Fin J) : 0 ≤ Y j := by
    apply integral_nonneg
    intro x
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _
  have hAabs (j : Fin J) :
      MemLp (fun x => Real.sqrt (w j x) * |A j x|) 2 μ := by
    have hfun : (fun x => Real.sqrt (w j x) * |A j x|) =
        |(fun x => Real.sqrt (w j x) * A j x)| := by
      funext x
      simp only [Pi.abs_apply, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    rw [hfun]
    exact (hA j).abs
  have hBabs (j : Fin J) :
      MemLp (fun x => Real.sqrt (w j x) * |B x|) 2 μ := by
    have hfun : (fun x => Real.sqrt (w j x) * |B x|) =
        |(fun x => Real.sqrt (w j x) * B x)| := by
      funext x
      simp only [Pi.abs_apply, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    rw [hfun]
    exact (hB j).abs
  have hWeightedInt (j : Fin J) :
      Integrable (fun x => w j x * |A j x| * |B x|) μ := by
    have hprod := (hAabs j).integrable_mul (hBabs j)
    convert hprod using 1
    funext x
    calc
      w j x * |A j x| * |B x| =
          (Real.sqrt (w j x) * Real.sqrt (w j x)) * |A j x| * |B x| := by
        nth_rw 1 [← Real.mul_self_sqrt (hw j x)]
      _ = (Real.sqrt (w j x) * |A j x|) *
          (Real.sqrt (w j x) * |B x|) := by ring
  have hOne (j : Fin J) :
      |∫ x, r j x * A j x * B x ∂μ| ≤ Real.sqrt (X j) * Real.sqrt (Y j) := by
    have hdom :
        (∫ x, |r j x * A j x * B x| ∂μ) ≤
          ∫ x, w j x * |A j x| * |B x| ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono
      · exact (hrAB j).abs
      · exact hWeightedInt j
      · intro x
        calc
          |r j x * A j x * B x| = |r j x| * |A j x| * |B x| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          _ ≤ w j x * |A j x| * |B x| := by
            calc
              |r j x| * |A j x| * |B x| = |r j x| * (|A j x| * |B x|) := by ring
              _ ≤ w j x * (|A j x| * |B x|) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hrw j x) (by positivity)
              _ = w j x * |A j x| * |B x| := by ring
    have hcs := aux_weightedCauchySchwarz μ (w j) (fun x => |A j x|)
      (fun x => |B x|) (hw j) (hAabs j) (hBabs j)
    have hWeighted_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ x, w j x * |A j x| * |B x| ∂μ := by
      apply integral_nonneg
      intro x
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw j x) (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _)
    calc
      |∫ x, r j x * A j x * B x ∂μ| ≤
          ∫ x, |r j x * A j x * B x| ∂μ := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
      _ ≤ ∫ x, w j x * |A j x| * |B x| ∂μ := hdom
      _ = |∫ x, w j x * |A j x| * |B x| ∂μ| := (abs_of_nonneg hWeighted_nonneg).symm
      _ ≤ (∫ x, |(Real.sqrt (w j x) * |A j x|)| ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) *
          (∫ x, |(Real.sqrt (w j x) * |B x|)| ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) := hcs
      _ = Real.sqrt (X j) * Real.sqrt (Y j) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
        congr 2 <;> apply integral_congr_ae <;> filter_upwards [] with x <;>
          simp [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
  have hsum :
      |∑ j, ∫ x, r j x * A j x * B x ∂μ| ≤
        ∑ j, Real.sqrt (X j) * Real.sqrt (Y j) := by
    calc
      |∑ j, ∫ x, r j x * A j x * B x ∂μ| ≤
          ∑ j, |∫ x, r j x * A j x * B x ∂μ| := by
        simpa using Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs
          (fun j : Fin J => ∫ x, r j x * A j x * B x ∂μ) Finset.univ
      _ ≤ ∑ j, Real.sqrt (X j) * Real.sqrt (Y j) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        exact hOne j
  have hsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ j, Real.sqrt (X j) * Real.sqrt (Y j) := by
    positivity
  have hfinite :
      |∑ j, Real.sqrt (X j) * Real.sqrt (Y j)| ^ 2 ≤
        (∑ j, (Real.sqrt (X j)) ^ 2) * (∑ j, (Real.sqrt (Y j)) ^ 2) := by
    apply aux_weightedCauchySchwarz_square_bound
    · positivity
    · positivity
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg hsum_nonneg] using
      (Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt Finset.univ
        (fun j : Fin J => Real.sqrt (X j)) (fun j : Fin J => Real.sqrt (Y j)))
  calc
    |∑ j, ∫ x, r j x * A j x * B x ∂μ| ^ 2 ≤
        (∑ j, Real.sqrt (X j) * Real.sqrt (Y j)) ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hsum_nonneg).mpr hsum
    _ = |∑ j, Real.sqrt (X j) * Real.sqrt (Y j)| ^ 2 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hsum_nonneg]
    _ ≤ (∑ j, (Real.sqrt (X j)) ^ 2) * (∑ j, (Real.sqrt (Y j)) ^ 2) := hfinite
    _ = (∑ j, X j) * (∑ j, Y j) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hX j)),
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hY j))]
    _ = _ := by rfl

    _ = |∑ j, Real.sqrt (X j) * Real.sqrt (Y j)| ^ 2 := by

    _ ≤ (∑ j, (Real.sqrt (X j)) ^ 2) * (∑ j, (Real.sqrt (Y j)) ^ 2) := hfinite
    _ = (∑ j, X j) * (∑ j, Y j) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hX j)),
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hY j))]
    _ = _ := by rfl

name: Auto.aux_measurePreserving_cubeReorder
statement:
theorem aux_measurePreserving_cubeReorder (d r : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving (aux_cubeReorderEquiv d r) volume volume
proof:
:= by
  have hassoc : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.symm :
        RealVector d × (RealVector d × RealVector r) ≃ᵐ
          (RealVector d × RealVector d) × RealVector r) volume volume :=
    (volume_preserving_prodAssoc (α₁ := RealVector d) (β₁ := RealVector d)
      (γ₁ := RealVector r)).symm
  have hswap : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr
        (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : RealVector d × RealVector d ≃ᵐ
          RealVector d × RealVector d)
        (MeasurableEquiv.refl (RealVector r))) volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving
      (Prod.map (Prod.swap : RealVector d × RealVector d → RealVector d × RealVector d)
        (id : RealVector r → RealVector r)) volume volume
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      (aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap
        (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) (volume : Measure (RealVector d))).prod
        (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (RealVector r)))
  change MeasurePreserving
    ((MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : RealVector d × RealVector d ≃ᵐ
        RealVector d × RealVector d)
      (MeasurableEquiv.refl (RealVector r))) ∘ MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.symm)
      volume volume
  exact hswap.comp hassoc

    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [ProperSpace E]

    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [ProperSpace F]
    [MeasureSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure F)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] {f : F → K} (hf : MemW0 f) (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) :
    MemW0 (f ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  apply hf.aux_comp_continuousLinearEquiv_between_of_integrable_radius e

name: Auto.aux_memW0_integrable_of_addHaar
statement:
theorem aux_memW0_integrable_of_addHaar {E K : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [ProperSpace E]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure E)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] {f : E → K} (hf : MemW0 f) : Integrable f
proof:
:= by
  refine hf.2.mono hf.1.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hf.1 zero_le_one x)] using
    aux_norm_le_wienerEnvelope hf.1 zero_le_one x

name: Auto.aux_memW0_abs
statement:
theorem aux_memW0_abs {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} (hf : MemW0 f) :
    MemW0 (fun x => |f x|)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hf.1.abs, ?_⟩
  have hEnvelope : wienerEnvelope (fun x => |f x|) 1 = wienerEnvelope f 1 := by
    funext x
    simp [wienerEnvelope, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [hEnvelope]
  exact hf.2

name: Auto.aux_memW0_add
statement:
theorem aux_memW0_add {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {f g : E → ℝ} (hf : MemW0 f) (hg : MemW0 g) :
    MemW0 (fun x => f x + g x)
proof:
:= by
  let hcont : Continuous (fun x : E => f x + g x) := hf.1.add hg.1
  refine ⟨hcont, ?_⟩
  have hsum : Integrable (fun x : E => wienerEnvelope f 1 x + wienerEnvelope g 1 x) :=
    hf.2.add hg.2
  refine hsum.mono_nonneg (continuous_wienerEnvelope hcont 1).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun x => aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hcont zero_le_one x)
    (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  apply csSup_le ((Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr zero_le_one).image _)
  rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  change ‖f (x + z) + g (x + z)‖ ≤
    sSup ((fun w : E => ‖f (x + w)‖) '' closedBall 0 1) +
      sSup ((fun w : E => ‖g (x + w)‖) '' closedBall 0 1)
  calc
    ‖f (x + z) + g (x + z)‖ ≤ ‖f (x + z)‖ + ‖g (x + z)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ sSup ((fun w : E => ‖f (x + w)‖) '' closedBall 0 1) +
        sSup ((fun w : E => ‖g (x + w)‖) '' closedBall 0 1) :=
      add_le_add
        (aux_norm_le_wienerEnvelope_of_mem_closedBall hf.1 (by
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz))
        (aux_norm_le_wienerEnvelope_of_mem_closedBall hg.1 (by
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz))

name: Auto.aux_memW0_finset_sum
statement:
theorem aux_memW0_finset_sum {E ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, MemW0 (f i)) :
    MemW0 (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      refine ⟨continuous_zero, ?_⟩
      change Integrable (wienerEnvelope (fun _ : E => (0 : ℝ)) 1)
      have hzeroEnv : wienerEnvelope (fun _ : E => (0 : ℝ)) 1 = 0 := by
        funext x
        simp [wienerEnvelope]
      rw [hzeroEnv]
      exact integrable_zero E ℝ (volume : Measure E)
  | insert a s ha hs =>
      have hrest : MemW0 (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x) := by
        apply hs
        intro i hi
        exact hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
      have hadd := aux_memW0_add (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) hrest
      convert hadd using 1
      funext x
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: Auto.aux_continuous_integral_slice_of_addHaar
statement:
theorem aux_continuous_integral_slice_of_addHaar {E F K : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [ProperSpace E]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SFinite (volume : Measure E)]
    [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure E)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [ProperSpace F]
    [MeasureSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [SFinite (volume : Measure F)]
    [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure F)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K] {f : E × F → K} (hf : MemW0 f) :
    Continuous (fun u : E => ∫ v, f (u, v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro u₀
  have hgood_ae : ∀ᵐ u' ∂(volume : Measure E),
      Integrable (fun v => wienerEnvelope f 1 (u', v)) := by
    exact hf.2.prod_right_ae
  obtain ⟨u', hu', hu'good⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae
    (s := ball u₀ (1 / 2))
    ((measure_ball_pos (volume : Measure E) u₀ (by norm_num)).ne')
    (ae_restrict_of_ae hgood_ae)
  apply tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
    (fun v => wienerEnvelope f 1 (u', v))
  · filter_upwards [] with u
    exact (hf.1.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds u₀ (by norm_num : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ))] with u hu
    filter_upwards [] with v
    apply aux_norm_le_wienerEnvelope_of_mem_closedBall hf.1
    apply Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr
    rw [Prod.dist_eq]
    apply max_le
    · change dist u u' ≤ 1
      apply le_of_lt
      calc
        dist u u' ≤ dist u u₀ + dist u₀ u' := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < 1 / 2 + 1 / 2 := add_lt_add (Metric.mem_ball.mp hu)
          (by simpa [dist_comm] using (Metric.mem_ball.mp hu'))
        _ = 1 := by norm_num
    · change dist v v ≤ 1
      simp
  · exact hu'good
  · filter_upwards [] with v
    exact hf.1.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
      (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousAt

name: Auto.aux_memW0_integral_slice_of_addHaar
statement:
theorem aux_memW0_integral_slice_of_addHaar {E F K : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [ProperSpace E]
    [MeasureSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SFinite (volume : Measure E)]
    [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure E)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [ProperSpace F]
    [MeasureSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [SFinite (volume : Measure F)]
    [Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure F)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K] {f : E × F → K} (hf : MemW0 f) :
    MemW0 (fun u : E => ∫ v, f (u, v))
proof:
:= by
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (E × F)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let F₀ : E × F → ℝ := wienerEnvelope f 1
  have hF₀ : MemW0 F₀ := hf.aux_mem_wienerEnvelope zero_le_one
  have hF₀_slice (u : E) : Integrable (fun v => F₀ (u, v)) :=
    aux_memW0_integrable_of_addHaar (hF₀.aux_memW0_slice_of_addHaar u)
  have hf_slice (u : E) : Integrable (fun v => f (u, v)) :=
    aux_memW0_integrable_of_addHaar (hf.aux_memW0_slice_of_addHaar u)
  have hcont : Continuous (fun u : E => ∫ v, f (u, v)) :=
    aux_continuous_integral_slice_of_addHaar hf
  refine ⟨hcont, ?_⟩
  have hH : Integrable (fun u : E => ∫ v, F₀ (u, v)) := hf.2.integral_prod_left
  refine hH.mono_nonneg (continuous_wienerEnvelope hcont 1).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun u => aux_wienerEnvelope_nonneg hcont zero_le_one u)
    (ae_of_all _ fun u => ?_)
  unfold wienerEnvelope
  apply csSup_le ((Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr zero_le_one).image _)
  rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  change ‖∫ v, f (u + w, v)‖ ≤ ∫ v, F₀ (u, v)
  calc
    ‖∫ v, f (u + w, v)‖ ≤ ∫ v, ‖f (u + w, v)‖ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ ≤ ∫ v, F₀ (u, v) := by
      apply integral_mono (hf_slice (u + w)).norm (hF₀_slice u)
      intro v
      change ‖f (u + w, v)‖ ≤ wienerEnvelope f 1 (u, v)
      apply aux_norm_le_wienerEnvelope_of_mem_closedBall hf.1
      apply Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr
      rw [Prod.dist_eq]
      apply max_le
      · simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
      · simp

name: Auto.aux_eLpNorm_one_integral_slice_le
statement:
theorem aux_eLpNorm_one_integral_slice_le {E F K : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSpace F] (μ : Measure E) (ν : Measure F)
    [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K]
    {f : E × F → K} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (μ.prod ν)) :
    eLpNorm (fun u : E => ∫ v, f (u, v) ∂ν) 1 μ ≤ eLpNorm f 1 (μ.prod ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : AEMeasurable (fun uv : E × F => ‖f uv‖ₑ) (μ.prod ν) :=
    hf.enorm
  rw [eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm, eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm]
  calc
    (∫⁻ u : E, ‖∫ v, f (u, v) ∂ν‖ₑ ∂μ) ≤
        ∫⁻ u : E, (∫⁻ v : F, ‖f (u, v)‖ₑ ∂ν) ∂μ := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro u
      exact enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm _
    _ = ∫⁻ uv : E × F, ‖f uv‖ₑ ∂(μ.prod ν) := by
      simpa using (lintegral_prod (fun uv : E × F => ‖f uv‖ₑ) hmeas).symm

name: Auto.aux_concatVectorEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem aux_concatVectorEquiv_apply (n k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (u : RealVector k) (v : RealVector (n - k)) :
    aux_concatVectorEquiv n k hkn (u, v) = concatVector n k hkn u v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.1 < k
  · let j : Fin k := ⟨i.1, hi⟩
    have he : aux_concatIndexEquiv n k hkn (Sum.inl j) = i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [aux_concatIndexEquiv, j]
    rw [← he]
    change
      (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ)
        (aux_concatIndexEquiv n k hkn)
        ((MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
          (fun _ : Fin k ⊕ Fin (n - k) => ℝ)).symm (u, v)))
        (aux_concatIndexEquiv n k hkn (Sum.inl j)) = _
    rw [MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply]
    change u j = _
    simp [aux_concatIndexEquiv, concatVector, j, hi]
  · let j : Fin (n - k) := ⟨i.1 - k, by omega⟩
    have he : aux_concatIndexEquiv n k hkn (Sum.inr j) = i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [aux_concatIndexEquiv, j]; omega
    rw [← he]
    change
      (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ)
        (aux_concatIndexEquiv n k hkn)
        ((MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
          (fun _ : Fin k ⊕ Fin (n - k) => ℝ)).symm (u, v)))
        (aux_concatIndexEquiv n k hkn (Sum.inr j)) = _
    rw [MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply]
    change v j = concatVector n k hkn u v
      (aux_concatIndexEquiv n k hkn (Sum.inr j))
    unfold concatVector
    have hnot : ¬ (aux_concatIndexEquiv n k hkn (Sum.inr j)).1 < k := by
      simp [aux_concatIndexEquiv, j]
    rw [dif_neg hnot]
    apply congrArg v
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [aux_concatIndexEquiv, j]

name: Auto.aux_prod_cubeCorners_snoc
statement:
theorem aux_prod_cubeCorners_snoc {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (k : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2) → M) :
    (∏ h : Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2, f h) =
      ∏ h : Fin k → Fin 2, ∏ a : Fin 2, f (Fin.snoc h a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : (Fin k → Fin 2) × Fin 2 ≃ (Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2) :=
    (Equiv.prodComm _ _).trans (Fin.snocEquiv fun _ => Fin 2)
  calc
    (∏ h : Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2, f h) =
        ∏ ha : (Fin k → Fin 2) × Fin 2, f (Fin.snoc ha.1 ha.2) := by
      symm
      apply Fintype.prod_equiv e (fun ha => f (Fin.snoc ha.1 ha.2)) f
      intro ha
      rfl
    _ = ∏ h : Fin k → Fin 2, ∏ a : Fin 2, f (Fin.snoc h a) := by
      simpa using
        (Fintype.prod_prod_type (fun ha : (Fin k → Fin 2) × Fin 2 =>
          f (Fin.snoc ha.1 ha.2)))

name: Auto.aux_prod_cubeCorners_snoc_two

      ∏ h : Fin k → Fin 2, f (Fin.snoc h 0) * f (Fin.snoc h 1)

  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl

name: Auto.aux_prismPoint_succ_bridge_cast
statement:
theorem aux_prismPoint_succ_bridge_cast (k d : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (y : RealVector k × RealVector k) (r0 r1 : ℝ) (x : RealVector (d + 1))
    (h : Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      (Fin.lastCases r0 (fun l => y.1 l), Fin.lastCases r1 (fun l => y.2 l))
      (aux_newPrismFiber k d x) h (Fin.cast (by omega) i) =
    prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k) hk (by omega) y
      (Fin.cons (if h (Fin.last k) = 0 then r0 else r1) (aux_oldPrismTail k d x))
      (fun l => h l.castSucc) (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  by_cases hjk : j.1 < k
  · let jOld : Fin k := ⟨j.1, hjk⟩
    have hjNew : (⟨j.1, by omega⟩ : Fin (k + 1)) = jOld.castSucc := Fin.ext rfl
    unfold prismPoint
    simp only [concatVector]
    rw [dif_pos (by omega), dif_pos hjk]
    change cubeCorner
      (Fin.lastCases r0 (fun l => y.1 l), Fin.lastCases r1 (fun l => y.2 l)) h
        ⟨j.1, by omega⟩ = cubeCorner y (fun l => h l.castSucc) jOld
    rw [hjNew]
    simp [cubeCorner]
  · have hjge : k ≤ j.1 := Nat.le_of_not_gt hjk
    by_cases hjeq : j.1 = k
    · unfold prismPoint
      simp only [concatVector]
      rw [dif_pos (by omega), dif_neg hjk]
      let : NeZero (k + 1 + d - k) := ⟨by omega⟩
      have hjLast : (⟨j.1, by omega⟩ : Fin (k + 1)) = Fin.last k := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [hjeq]
      have hjZero : (⟨j.1 - k, by omega⟩ : Fin (k + 1 + d - k)) =
          (0 : Fin (k + 1 + d - k)) := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [hjeq]
      rw [hjLast, hjZero]
      have hiOldNe : (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ : Fin (k + 1 + d - k + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro hi
        have hx := congrArg Fin.val hi
        simp at hx
      unfold eraseVector
      rw [show (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ : Fin (k + 1 + d - k + 1)).succAbove
          (0 : Fin (k + 1 + d - k)) = 0 from Fin.succAbove_ne_zero_zero hiOldNe]
      simp [cubeCorner]
    · have hjgt : k < j.1 := by omega
      have hjSub : j.1 - k = j.1 - (k + 1) + 1 := by omega
      have hlow : k + 1 + d - k = d + 1 := by omega
      have hnew : k + 1 + d - (k + 1) = d := by omega
      have hnewFiber : k + 1 + d - (k + 1) + 1 = d + 1 := by omega
      let lNew : Fin (k + 1 + d - (k + 1)) := ⟨j.1 - (k + 1), by omega⟩
      let lOld : Fin (k + 1 + d - k) := ⟨j.1 - k, by omega⟩
      unfold prismPoint
      simp only [concatVector]
      rw [dif_neg (by omega), dif_neg hjk]
      change eraseVector (Fin.cast (by omega) i) (aux_newPrismFiber k d x) lNew =
        eraseVector (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ)
          (Fin.cons (if h (Fin.last k) = 0 then r0 else r1) (aux_oldPrismTail k d x)) lOld
      let l : Fin d := Fin.cast hnew lNew
      let q : Fin (k + 1 + d - k) := Fin.cast hlow.symm (i.succAbove l)
      have hLold : lOld = Fin.cast hlow.symm l.succ := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [lOld, l, hjSub]
        rfl
      have hIold : (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ : Fin (k + 1 + d - k + 1)) =
          Fin.cast (congrArg Nat.succ hlow.symm) i.succ := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp
      have hAbove :
          (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ :
              Fin (k + 1 + d - k + 1)).succAbove lOld = q.succ := by
        rw [hIold, hLold, ← aux_finCast_succAbove hlow.symm i.succ l.succ,
          Fin.succ_succAbove_succ]
        exact aux_finCast_succ hlow.symm (i.succAbove l)
      have hLnew : lNew = Fin.cast hnew.symm l := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [l]
      have hInew : (Fin.cast (by omega) i : Fin (k + 1 + d - (k + 1) + 1)) =
          Fin.cast hnewFiber.symm i := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp
      have hNewAbove :
          (Fin.cast (by omega) i : Fin (k + 1 + d - (k + 1) + 1)).succAbove lNew =
            Fin.cast hnewFiber.symm (i.succAbove l) := by
        rw [hInew, hLnew, ← aux_finCast_succAbove hnew.symm i l]
      unfold eraseVector
      rw [hAbove, Fin.cons_succ]
      unfold aux_newPrismFiber aux_oldPrismTail
      rw [hNewAbove]
      congr 1

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellative_a2CornerProduct
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellative_a2CornerProduct (k d : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (F : Fin (k + 1 + d) → RealVector (k + 1 + d) → ℝ)
    (y : RealVector k × RealVector k) (r0 r1 : ℝ) (x : RealVector (d + 1)) :
    (∏ h : Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2, ∏ i : Fin (d + 1),
      F (prismIndex (show 1 ≤ k + 1 by omega) (by omega) (Fin.cast (by omega) i))
        (prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
          (Fin.lastCases r0 (fun l => y.1 l), Fin.lastCases r1 (fun l => y.2 l))
          (aux_newPrismFiber k d x) h (Fin.cast (by omega) i))) =
      (∏ h : Fin k → Fin 2, ∏ i : Fin (d + 1),
        F (prismIndex hk (by omega) (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ))
          (prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k) hk (by omega) y
            (Fin.cons r0 (aux_oldPrismTail k d x)) h (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ))) *
      (∏ h : Fin k → Fin 2, ∏ i : Fin (d + 1),
        F (prismIndex hk (by omega) (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ))
          (prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k) hk (by omega) y
            (Fin.cons r1 (aux_oldPrismTail k d x)) h (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [aux_prod_cubeCorners_snoc_two]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro h _
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    have hidx :
        prismIndex (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k + 1) (show 1 ≤ k + 1 by omega)
          (by omega) (Fin.cast (by omega) i) =
          prismIndex (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k) hk (by omega)
            (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [prismIndex]
      omega
    have hpt :
        prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
          (Fin.lastCases r0 (fun l => y.1 l), Fin.lastCases r1 (fun l => y.2 l))
          (aux_newPrismFiber k d x) (Fin.snoc h 0) (Fin.cast (by omega) i) =
        prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k) hk (by omega) y
          (Fin.cons r0 (aux_oldPrismTail k d x)) h (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ) := by
      simpa using aux_prismPoint_succ_bridge_cast k d hk y r0 r1 x (Fin.snoc h 0) i
    rw [hidx]
    exact congrArg (F _) hpt
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro h _
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    have hidx :
        prismIndex (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k + 1) (show 1 ≤ k + 1 by omega)
          (by omega) (Fin.cast (by omega) i) =
          prismIndex (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k) hk (by omega)
            (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [prismIndex]
      omega
    have hpt :
        prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
          (Fin.lastCases r0 (fun l => y.1 l), Fin.lastCases r1 (fun l => y.2 l))
          (aux_newPrismFiber k d x) (Fin.snoc h 1) (Fin.cast (by omega) i) =
        prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k) hk (by omega) y
          (Fin.cons r1 (aux_oldPrismTail k d x)) h (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ) := by
      simpa using aux_prismPoint_succ_bridge_cast k d hk y r0 r1 x (Fin.snoc h 1) i
    rw [hidx]
    exact congrArg (F _) hpt

name: Auto.aux_measurePreserving_fourBlockReorder
statement:
theorem aux_measurePreserving_fourBlockReorder (k d : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving (aux_fourBlockReorder k d) volume volume
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc :
        (RealVector k × (ℝ × RealVector d)) × ℝ ≃ᵐ
          RealVector k × ((ℝ × RealVector d) × ℝ)) volume volume :=
    volume_preserving_prodAssoc (α₁ := RealVector k) (β₁ := ℝ × RealVector d) (γ₁ := ℝ)
  have h2a : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc :
      (ℝ × RealVector d) × ℝ ≃ᵐ ℝ × (RealVector d × ℝ)) volume volume :=
    volume_preserving_prodAssoc (α₁ := ℝ) (β₁ := RealVector d) (γ₁ := ℝ)
  have h2b : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ)
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : RealVector d × ℝ ≃ᵐ ℝ × RealVector d)) volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (Prod.map (id : ℝ → ℝ)
      (Prod.swap : RealVector d × ℝ → ℝ × RealVector d)) volume volume
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod, id_eq] using
      (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure ℝ)).prod
        (aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) (volume : Measure ℝ))
  have h2c : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.symm :
      ℝ × (ℝ × RealVector d) ≃ᵐ (ℝ × ℝ) × RealVector d) volume volume :=
    (volume_preserving_prodAssoc (α₁ := ℝ) (β₁ := ℝ) (γ₁ := RealVector d)).symm
  let e2 : (ℝ × RealVector d) × ℝ ≃ᵐ (ℝ × ℝ) × RealVector d :=
    MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.trans
      ((MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ)
        (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : RealVector d × ℝ ≃ᵐ ℝ × RealVector d)).trans
        MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.symm)
  have h2 : MeasurePreserving e2 volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.symm ∘
      ((MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ)
        (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : RealVector d × ℝ ≃ᵐ ℝ × RealVector d)) ∘
        MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc)) volume volume
    exact h2c.comp (h2b.comp h2a)
  have h2' : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl (RealVector k)) e2) volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (Prod.map (id : RealVector k → RealVector k) e2) volume volume
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod, id_eq] using
      (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (RealVector k))).prod h2
  have h3 : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.symm :
      RealVector k × ((ℝ × ℝ) × RealVector d) ≃ᵐ
        (RealVector k × (ℝ × ℝ)) × RealVector d) volume volume :=
    (volume_preserving_prodAssoc (α₁ := RealVector k) (β₁ := ℝ × ℝ) (γ₁ := RealVector d)).symm
  have hsplit : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.symm :
      RealVector k × (ℝ × ℝ) ≃ᵐ (RealVector k × ℝ) × ℝ) volume volume :=
    (volume_preserving_prodAssoc (α₁ := RealVector k) (β₁ := ℝ) (γ₁ := ℝ)).symm
  have h4 : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.symm : RealVector k × (ℝ × ℝ) ≃ᵐ (RealVector k × ℝ) × ℝ)
      (MeasurableEquiv.refl (RealVector d))) volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving
      (Prod.map (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.symm :
        RealVector k × (ℝ × ℝ) → (RealVector k × ℝ) × ℝ)
        (id : RealVector d → RealVector d)) volume volume
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod, id_eq] using
      hsplit.prod (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
  have htotal := h4.comp (h3.comp (h2'.comp h1))
  convert htotal using 1; rfl

name: Auto.aux_measurePreserving_scalarAffine
statement:
theorem aux_measurePreserving_scalarAffine (d : ℕ) (c : RealVector d → ℝ)
    (hc : Continuous c) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun p : ℝ × RealVector d => (c p.2 - p.1, p.2))
      volume volume
proof:
:= by
  have hskewProd : MeasurePreserving
      (fun p : RealVector d × ℝ => (p.1, p.2 + c p.1))
      ((volume : Measure (RealVector d)).prod (volume : Measure ℝ))
      ((volume : Measure (RealVector d)).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) := by
    have h := MeasurePreserving.skew_product
      (μa := (volume : Measure (RealVector d))) (μb := (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
      (μc := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (μd := (volume : Measure ℝ))
      (g := fun p q => q + c p)
      (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
      (continuous_snd.add (hc.comp continuous_fst)).measurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun p => (measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℝ) (c p)).map_eq)
    simpa only [id_eq] using h
  have hskew : MeasurePreserving
      (fun p : RealVector d × ℝ => (p.1, p.2 + c p.1))
      (volume : Measure (RealVector d × ℝ)) (volume : Measure (RealVector d × ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using hskewProd
  have hswap₁ : MeasurePreserving
      (Prod.swap : ℝ × RealVector d → RealVector d × ℝ) volume volume := by
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      (aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap (volume : Measure ℝ) (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
  have hswap₂ : MeasurePreserving
      (Prod.swap : RealVector d × ℝ → ℝ × RealVector d) volume volume := by
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      (aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) (volume : Measure ℝ))
  have htranslation : MeasurePreserving
      (fun p : ℝ × RealVector d => (p.1 + c p.2, p.2)) volume volume := by
    convert hswap₂.comp (hskew.comp hswap₁) using 1; rfl
  have hnegProd : MeasurePreserving
      (Prod.map (fun q : ℝ => -q) (id : RealVector d → RealVector d))
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (RealVector d))) :=
    (Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure ℝ)).prod
      (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
  have hneg : MeasurePreserving
      (fun p : ℝ × RealVector d => (-p.1, p.2))
      (volume : Measure (ℝ × RealVector d)) (volume : Measure (ℝ × RealVector d)) := by
    convert hnegProd using 1 <;> rfl
  convert htranslation.comp hneg using 1
  funext p
  rcases p with ⟨q, t⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    ring
  · rfl

name: Auto.aux_measurePreserving_a2AffineMap
statement:
theorem aux_measurePreserving_a2AffineMap (d : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving
      (fun p : ℝ × RealVector (d + 1) => (p.2, p.2 0 - p.1)) volume volume
proof:
:= by
  have haff : MeasurePreserving
      (fun p : ℝ × RealVector (d + 1) => (p.2 0 - p.1, p.2)) volume volume :=
    aux_measurePreserving_scalarAffine (d + 1) (fun x => x 0)
      (continuous_apply (A := fun _ : Fin (d + 1) => ℝ) 0)
  have hswap : MeasurePreserving
      (Prod.swap : ℝ × RealVector (d + 1) → RealVector (d + 1) × ℝ) volume volume := by
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      (aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap (volume : Measure ℝ)
        (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1))))
  convert hswap.comp haff using 1

name: Auto.aux_measurePreserving_scalarTranslation
statement:
theorem aux_measurePreserving_scalarTranslation (d : ℕ) (c : RealVector d → ℝ)
    (hc : Continuous c) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun p : ℝ × RealVector d => (p.1 + c p.2, p.2))
      volume volume
proof:
:= by
  have hnegProd : MeasurePreserving
      (Prod.map (fun q : ℝ => -q) (id : RealVector d → RealVector d))
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (RealVector d))) :=
    (Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure ℝ)).prod
      (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
  have hneg : MeasurePreserving
      (fun p : ℝ × RealVector d => (-p.1, p.2))
      (volume : Measure (ℝ × RealVector d)) (volume : Measure (ℝ × RealVector d)) := by
    convert hnegProd using 1 <;> rfl
  convert (aux_measurePreserving_scalarAffine d c hc).comp hneg using 1
  funext p
  rcases p with ⟨q, t⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    ring
  · rfl

name: Auto.aux_measurePreserving_prismInnerReorder
statement:
theorem aux_measurePreserving_prismInnerReorder (k d : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving (aux_prismInnerReorderEquiv k d) volume volume
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.symm :
        RealVector d × (RealVector k × ℝ) ≃ᵐ (RealVector d × RealVector k) × ℝ)
      volume volume :=
    (volume_preserving_prodAssoc (α₁ := RealVector d) (β₁ := RealVector k)
      (γ₁ := ℝ)).symm
  have h₂ : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr
        (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : RealVector d × RealVector k ≃ᵐ
          RealVector k × RealVector d)
        (MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ)) volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving
      (Prod.map (Prod.swap : RealVector d × RealVector k → RealVector k × RealVector d)
        (id : ℝ → ℝ)) volume volume
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      (aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap
        (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) (volume : Measure (RealVector k))).prod
        (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure ℝ))
  have h₃ : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc :
        (RealVector k × RealVector d) × ℝ ≃ᵐ RealVector k × (RealVector d × ℝ))
      volume volume :=
    volume_preserving_prodAssoc (α₁ := RealVector k) (β₁ := RealVector d) (γ₁ := ℝ)
  have h₄ : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl (RealVector k))
        (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : RealVector d × ℝ ≃ᵐ ℝ × RealVector d)) volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving
      (Prod.map (id : RealVector k → RealVector k)
        (Prod.swap : RealVector d × ℝ → ℝ × RealVector d)) volume volume
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (RealVector k))).prod
        (aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap
          (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) (volume : Measure ℝ))
  change MeasurePreserving
    ((MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl (RealVector k))
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : RealVector d × ℝ ≃ᵐ ℝ × RealVector d)) ∘
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc ∘
        ((MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr
          (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : RealVector d × RealVector k ≃ᵐ
            RealVector k × RealVector d)
          (MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ)) ∘ MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.symm))) volume volume
  exact h₄.comp (h₃.comp (h₂.comp h₁))
