name: Auto.aux_coordinateSum_insertNth
statement:
theorem aux_coordinateSum_insertNth (d : ℕ) (j : Fin (d + 1))
    (r : RealVector d) (q : ℝ) :
    coordinateSum (j.insertNth q r) = q + coordinateSum r
proof:
:= by
  unfold coordinateSum
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove]
  rw [Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  exact Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove (α := fun _ : Fin (d + 1) => ℝ) j q r a

name: Auto.aux_succAbove_last
statement:
theorem aux_succAbove_last (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (d + 2))
    (hi : i ≠ Fin.last (d + 1)) :
    i.succAbove (Fin.last d) = Fin.last (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hilt : i.1 < d + 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have hge : d + 1 ≤ i.1 := Nat.le_of_not_gt h
    have hle : i.1 ≤ d + 1 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ i.2
    apply hi
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [Fin.val_last]
    omega
  have hnot : ¬ (Fin.last d).castSucc < i := by
    intro h
    have hlt : d < i.1 := by
      change d < i.1 at h
      exact h
    omega
  rw [Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc]
  · rfl
  · exact le_of_not_gt hnot

name: Auto.aux_succAbove_nonlast_comm
statement:
theorem aux_succAbove_nonlast_comm (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (d + 2))
    (hi : i ≠ Fin.last (d + 1)) (a : Fin (d + 1)) (ha : a ≠ Fin.last d) :
    i.succAbove a =
      ((aux_nonlastIndex (d + 1) i hi).succAbove
        (aux_nonlastIndex d a ha)).castSucc
proof:
:= by
  have hi_eq : aux_nonlastIndex (d + 1) i hi = i.castPred hi := Fin.ext rfl
  have ha_eq : aux_nonlastIndex d a ha = a.castPred ha := Fin.ext rfl
  rw [hi_eq, ha_eq]
  exact (congrArg Fin.castSucc (Fin.castPred_succAbove_castPred hi ha)).symm

name: Auto.aux_mToKPoint_erase_nonlast
statement:
theorem aux_mToKPoint_erase_nonlast (d : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (d + 2)) (hi : i ≠ Fin.last (d + 1))
    (z : RealVector (d + 2) × ℝ) (r : RealVector d) (q : ℝ) :
    (eraseVector i (mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z
      ((aux_nonlastIndex (d + 1) i hi).insertNth q r)).1,
      eraseVector i (mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z
        ((aux_nonlastIndex (d + 1) i hi).insertNth q r)).2) =
      mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (eraseVector i z.1, z.2 - q) r
proof:
:= by
  let j : Fin (d + 1) := aux_nonlastIndex (d + 1) i hi
  have hsum : coordinateSum (j.insertNth q r) = q + coordinateSum r :=
    aux_coordinateSum_insertNth d j r q
  apply Prod.ext <;> funext a
  · by_cases ha : a = Fin.last d
    · subst a
      have hlast := aux_succAbove_last d i hi
      have htop : (⟨d + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 2)) = Fin.last (d + 1) := Fin.ext rfl
      have hbottom : (⟨d, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1)) = Fin.last d := Fin.ext rfl
      simp [eraseVector, mToKPoint, lastIndex, j, hlast, hsum, htop, hbottom]
      ring
    · let b : Fin d := aux_nonlastIndex d a ha
      have hcomm := aux_succAbove_nonlast_comm d i hi a ha
      have htop : (⟨d + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 2)) = Fin.last (d + 1) := Fin.ext rfl
      have hbottom : (⟨d, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1)) = Fin.last d := Fin.ext rfl
      have hglobal : i.succAbove a ≠ Fin.last (d + 1) := by
        rw [hcomm]
        exact Fin.ne_last_of_lt (j.succAbove b).castSucc_lt_last
      have hglobal_lt : (i.succAbove a).1 < d + 1 := by
        rw [hcomm]
        exact (j.succAbove b).isLt
      have hcast : (⟨(i.succAbove a).1, hglobal_lt⟩ : Fin (d + 1)) = j.succAbove b := by
        apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
        change (i.succAbove a).1 = (j.succAbove b).1
        simpa [j, b] using congrArg (fun x : Fin (d + 2) => x.1) hcomm
      simp [eraseVector, mToKPoint, lastIndex, j, b, aux_nonlastIndex, ha, htop,
        hbottom, hglobal, hcast]
  · by_cases ha : a = Fin.last d
    · subst a
      have hlast := aux_succAbove_last d i hi
      have htop : (⟨d + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 2)) = Fin.last (d + 1) := Fin.ext rfl
      have hbottom : (⟨d, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1)) = Fin.last d := Fin.ext rfl
      simp [eraseVector, mToKPoint, lastIndex, j, hlast, hsum, htop, hbottom]
      ring
    · let b : Fin d := aux_nonlastIndex d a ha
      have hcomm := aux_succAbove_nonlast_comm d i hi a ha
      have htop : (⟨d + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 2)) = Fin.last (d + 1) := Fin.ext rfl
      have hbottom : (⟨d, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1)) = Fin.last d := Fin.ext rfl
      have hglobal : i.succAbove a ≠ Fin.last (d + 1) := by
        rw [hcomm]
        exact Fin.ne_last_of_lt (j.succAbove b).castSucc_lt_last
      have hglobal_lt : (i.succAbove a).1 < d + 1 := by
        rw [hcomm]
        exact (j.succAbove b).isLt
      have hcast : (⟨(i.succAbove a).1, hglobal_lt⟩ : Fin (d + 1)) = j.succAbove b := by
        apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
        change (i.succAbove a).1 = (j.succAbove b).1
        simpa [j, b] using congrArg (fun x : Fin (d + 2) => x.1) hcomm
      simp [eraseVector, mToKPoint, lastIndex, j, b, aux_nonlastIndex, ha, htop,
        hbottom, hglobal, hcast]

name: Auto.aux_eraseVector_eq
statement:
theorem aux_eraseVector_eq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (d + 2))
    (x : RealVector (d + 2)) :
    aux_eraseVector (d + 2) (by omega) i x = eraseVector i x
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp [aux_eraseVector, eraseVector]

name: Auto.aux_mToKPoint_at_nonlast
statement:
theorem aux_mToKPoint_at_nonlast (d : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (d + 2)) (hi : i ≠ Fin.last (d + 1))
    (z : RealVector (d + 2) × ℝ) (r : RealVector d) (q : ℝ) :
    ((mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z
        ((aux_nonlastIndex (d + 1) i hi).insertNth q r)).1 i,
      (mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z
        ((aux_nonlastIndex (d + 1) i hi).insertNth q r)).2 i) =
      (z.1 i + q, q)
proof:
:= by
  let j : Fin (d + 1) := aux_nonlastIndex (d + 1) i hi
  have hj : j.castSucc = i := aux_nonlastIndex_castSucc (d + 1) i hi
  have htop : (⟨d + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 2)) = Fin.last (d + 1) := Fin.ext rfl
  have hi_top : i ≠ (⟨d + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 2)) := by
    rw [htop]
    exact hi
  have hi_lt := aux_nonlastIndex_lt (d + 1) i hi
  have hcast : (⟨i.1, hi_lt⟩ : Fin (d + 1)) = j := by
    apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
    change i.1 = j.1
    simp [j, aux_nonlastIndex]
  have hins : (j.insertNth q r : RealVector (d + 1)) j = q := by
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_same (α := fun _ : Fin (d + 1) => ℝ) j q r
  have hins' : ((aux_nonlastIndex (d + 1) i hi).insertNth q r : RealVector (d + 1)) j = q := by
    simp [j]
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp [mToKPoint, lastIndex, hi_top, hcast, hins']
  · simp [mToKPoint, lastIndex, hi_top, hcast, hins']

name: Auto.aux_mToK_tensorSquareExtension_eq_positivity_nonlast
statement:
theorem aux_mToK_tensorSquareExtension_eq_positivity_nonlast (d : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (d + 2)) (hi : i ≠ Fin.last (d + 1))
    (tildeM : MKernel (d + 1)) (htildeM : MemW0 tildeM)
    (phi : ℝ → ℝ) (hphi : MemW0 phi) :
    mToK (d + 2) (by omega) (tensorSquareExtension (d + 2) (by omega) i tildeM phi) =
      positivityKernel (d + 1) (mToK (d + 1) (by omega) tildeM) phi i
proof:
:= by
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin d)
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1))) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin (d + 1))
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 2))) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin (d + 2))
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector d × ℝ)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1) × ℝ)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : NormedSpace ℝ (RealVector (d + 1)) := Pi.normedSpace
  let j : Fin (d + 1) := aux_nonlastIndex (d + 1) i hi
  have hM : MemW0 (tensorSquareExtension (d + 2) (by omega) i tildeM phi) := by
    have hErase (x : RealVector (d + 2)) :
        aux_eraseVector (d + 2) (by omega) i x = eraseVector i x := by
      funext a
      simp [aux_eraseVector, eraseVector]
    have h := aux_memW0_tensorSquareExtensionSucc (d + 1) i tildeM htildeM phi hphi
    change MemW0 (fun y : RealVector (d + 2) × RealVector (d + 2) =>
      tildeM (aux_eraseVector (d + 2) (by omega) i y.1,
        aux_eraseVector (d + 2) (by omega) i y.2) * tensorSquare phi (y.1 i, y.2 i))
    simpa only [hErase] using h
  have hsplit : MeasurePreserving
      ((aux_eraseCoordinateSplit d j).toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv) volume volume := by
    simpa using aux_measurePreserving_eraseCoordinateSplit d j
  have hinv := hsplit.symm ((aux_eraseCoordinateSplit d j).toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv)
  have hswap : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : ℝ × RealVector d ≃ᵐ RealVector d × ℝ)
      volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : ℝ × RealVector d → RealVector d × ℝ)
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
      ((volume : Measure (RealVector d)).prod (volume : Measure ℝ))
    exact aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap (volume : Measure ℝ) (volume : Measure (RealVector d))
  funext z
  let A : RealVector (d + 1) → ℝ := fun p =>
    tensorSquareExtension (d + 2) (by omega) i tildeM phi
      (mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z p)
  have hA : Integrable A := by
    have hW := mToK_integrand_memW0 (d + 2) (d + 2) (by omega) le_rfl
      (tensorSquareExtension (d + 2) (by omega) i tildeM phi) hM z
    have hInt := aux_memW0_integrable_of_addHaar
      (E := RealVector (d + 1)) (K := ℝ) hW
    simpa [A] using hInt
  let B : RealVector d × ℝ → ℝ := fun rq =>
    A (j.insertNth rq.2 rq.1 : RealVector (d + 1))
  let C : ℝ × RealVector d → ℝ := fun qr =>
    A (j.insertNth qr.1 qr.2 : RealVector (d + 1))
  have hB : Integrable B := by
    have h := hinv.integrable_comp_of_integrable hA
    change Integrable (fun rq : RealVector d × ℝ =>
      A (((aux_eraseCoordinateSplit d j).toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv).symm rq)) at h
    change Integrable (fun rq : RealVector d × ℝ =>
      A (j.insertNth rq.2 rq.1 : RealVector (d + 1)))
    exact h
  have hC : Integrable C := by
    have h := hswap.integrable_comp_of_integrable hB
    change Integrable (fun qr : ℝ × RealVector d =>
      B (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm qr)) at h
    change Integrable (fun qr : ℝ × RealVector d =>
      A (j.insertNth qr.1 qr.2 : RealVector (d + 1)))
    exact h
  have hFubini :
      (∫ q : ℝ, ∫ r : RealVector d, A (j.insertNth q r : RealVector (d + 1))) =
        ∫ p : RealVector (d + 1), A p := by
    calc
      (∫ q : ℝ, ∫ r : RealVector d, A (j.insertNth q r)) =
          ∫ qr : ℝ × RealVector d, C qr := by
            exact (integral_prod C hC).symm
      _ = ∫ rq : RealVector d × ℝ, B rq := hswap.integral_comp' B
      _ = ∫ p : RealVector (d + 1), A p := by
        rw [← hsplit.integral_comp' B]
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [] with p
        exact congrArg A ((aux_eraseCoordinateSplit d j).left_inv p)
  unfold mToK positivityKernel
  change (∫ p : RealVector (d + 1), A p) =
    ∫ q : ℝ, (∫ r : RealVector d,
      tildeM (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (eraseVector i z.1, z.2 - q) r)) *
        phi (z.1 i + q) * phi q
  rw [← hFubini]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with q
  let R : RealVector d → ℝ := fun r =>
    tildeM (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (eraseVector i z.1, z.2 - q) r)
  have hpoint (r : RealVector d) :
      A (j.insertNth q r : RealVector (d + 1)) =
        R r * phi (z.1 i + q) * phi q := by
    change
      tildeM
          (aux_eraseVector (d + 2) (by omega) i
              (mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z (j.insertNth q r)).1,
            aux_eraseVector (d + 2) (by omega) i
              (mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z (j.insertNth q r)).2) *
          tensorSquare phi
            ((mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z (j.insertNth q r)).1 i,
              (mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z (j.insertNth q r)).2 i) =
        R r * phi (z.1 i + q) * phi q
    rw [aux_eraseVector_eq, aux_eraseVector_eq,
      aux_mToKPoint_erase_nonlast d i hi z r q,
      aux_mToKPoint_at_nonlast d i hi z r q]
    simp only [R, tensorSquare]
    ring
  calc
    (∫ r : RealVector d, A (j.insertNth q r : RealVector (d + 1))) =
        ∫ r : RealVector d, R r * phi (z.1 i + q) * phi q := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards [] with r
          exact hpoint r
    _ = (∫ r : RealVector d, R r) * phi (z.1 i + q) * phi q := by
      rw [integral_mul_const, integral_mul_const]
    _ = _ := by rfl

name: Auto.aux_mToK_nonnegative
statement:
theorem aux_mToK_nonnegative (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (M : MKernel k)
    (hM_nonneg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ M y) (z : RealVector k × ℝ) :
    0 ≤ mToK k hk M z
proof:
:= by
  unfold mToK
  apply integral_nonneg
  intro p
  exact hM_nonneg _

name: Auto.aux_measurePreserving_lastFibreEquiv
statement:
theorem aux_measurePreserving_lastFibreEquiv (d : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    MeasurePreserving (aux_lastFibreEquiv d s)
      (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1)))
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : MeasurePreserving (aux_lastCoordinateSplit d) volume volume :=
    aux_measurePreserving_lastCoordinateSplit d
  have hshear : MeasurePreserving
      (fun rt : RealVector d × ℝ => (rt.1, s - coordinateSum rt.1 - rt.2))
      ((volume : Measure (RealVector d)).prod (volume : Measure ℝ))
      ((volume : Measure (RealVector d)).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) := by
    refine MeasurePreserving.skew_product
      (μa := (volume : Measure (RealVector d))) (μb := (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
      (μc := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (μd := (volume : Measure ℝ))
      (f := id) (g := fun r t => s - coordinateSum r - t)
      (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (RealVector d))) ?_ ?_
    · exact
        ((continuous_const.sub ((aux_continuous_coordinateSum d).comp continuous_fst)).sub
          continuous_snd).measurable
    · filter_upwards [] with r
      have hneg : MeasurePreserving (fun t : ℝ => -t) volume volume :=
        Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure ℝ)
      have hadd : MeasurePreserving (fun t : ℝ => (s - coordinateSum r) + t)
          volume volume :=
        measurePreserving_add_left (volume : Measure ℝ) (s - coordinateSum r)
      have hreflect : MeasurePreserving (fun t : ℝ => s - coordinateSum r - t)
          volume volume := by
        convert hadd.comp hneg using 1
        funext t
        simp only [Function.comp_apply]
        ring
      exact hreflect.map_eq
  have hswap : MeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : RealVector d × ℝ → ℝ × RealVector d)
      ((volume : Measure (RealVector d)).prod (volume : Measure ℝ))
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (RealVector d))) :=
    aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) (volume : Measure ℝ)
  have htotal := hswap.comp (hshear.comp hsplit)
  convert htotal using 1
  funext p
  apply Prod.ext
  · change s - coordinateSum p =
      s - coordinateSum (fun j : Fin d => p j.castSucc) - p (Fin.last d)
    unfold coordinateSum
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    ring
  · rfl

name: Auto.mToK_terminalFibreIntegral
statement:
theorem mToK_terminalFibreIntegral (d : ℕ) (M : MKernel (d + 1))
    (hM : MemW0 M) (z : RealVector (d + 1) × ℝ) :
    (∫ q : ℝ, mToK (d + 1) (by omega) M (z.1, z.2 - q)) =
      ∫ p : RealVector (d + 1), M (z.1 + p, p)
proof:
:= by
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin d)
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1))) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin (d + 1))
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (ℝ × RealVector d)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1) × ℝ)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure
      (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1) × (ℝ × RealVector d))) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure
      (volume : Measure ((RealVector (d + 1) × ℝ) × RealVector d)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure
      (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1) × RealVector (d + 1))) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let e : (RealVector (d + 1) × (ℝ × RealVector d)) ≃L[ℝ]
      (RealVector (d + 1) × RealVector (d + 1)) :=
    (ContinuousLinearEquiv.prodAssoc ℝ (RealVector (d + 1)) ℝ (RealVector d)).symm.trans
      (aux_mToKContinuousLinearEquiv (d + 1) (by omega))
  have hE : MemW0 (M ∘ e) :=
    aux_memW0_comp_continuousLinearEquiv hM e
  have hslice : MemW0 (fun sp : ℝ × RealVector d =>
      M (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, sp.1) sp.2)) := by
    have hs := hE.aux_memW0_slice_of_addHaar z.1
    convert hs using 1
    funext sp
    rcases sp with ⟨s, p⟩
    rfl
  have hslice_int : Integrable (fun sp : ℝ × RealVector d =>
      M (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, sp.1) sp.2)) :=
    aux_memW0_integrable_of_addHaar hslice
  let t : ℝ × RealVector d → ℝ × RealVector d := fun qp => (z.2 - qp.1, qp.2)
  have ht_scalar : MeasurePreserving (fun q : ℝ => z.2 - q) volume volume := by
    have hneg : MeasurePreserving (fun q : ℝ => -q) volume volume :=
      Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure ℝ)
    have hadd : MeasurePreserving (fun q : ℝ => z.2 + q) volume volume :=
      measurePreserving_add_left (volume : Measure ℝ) z.2
    convert hadd.comp hneg using 1
    funext q
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    ring
  have ht : MeasurePreserving t volume volume := by
    have hprod := ht_scalar.prod (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
    convert hprod using 1 <;> rfl
  have hA : Integrable (fun qp : ℝ × RealVector d =>
      M (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - qp.1) qp.2)) := by
    have h := ht.integrable_comp_of_integrable hslice_int
    change Integrable (fun qp : ℝ × RealVector d =>
      M (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - qp.1) qp.2)) at h
    exact h
  let eLast := aux_lastFibreEquiv d z.2
  have hLast : MeasurePreserving eLast volume volume :=
    aux_measurePreserving_lastFibreEquiv d z.2
  have hLastInv := hLast.symm eLast
  let C : RealVector (d + 1) → ℝ := fun p => M (z.1 + p, p)
  have hpoint (qp : ℝ × RealVector d) :
      M (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - qp.1) qp.2) =
        C (eLast.symm qp) := by
    rcases qp with ⟨q, r⟩
    change M (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - q) r) =
      M (z.1 + eLast.symm (q, r), eLast.symm (q, r))
    congr 1
    have hlast : lastIndex (d + 1) (by omega) = Fin.last d := Fin.ext rfl
    apply Prod.ext <;> funext a
    · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun b => ?_) a
      · simp [eLast, aux_lastFibreEquiv, mToKPoint, hlast]
        ring
      · have hne : b.castSucc ≠ Fin.last d := Fin.ne_last_of_lt b.castSucc_lt_last
        simp [eLast, aux_lastFibreEquiv, mToKPoint, hlast, hne]
    · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun b => ?_) a
      · simp [eLast, aux_lastFibreEquiv, mToKPoint, hlast]
        ring
      · have hne : b.castSucc ≠ Fin.last d := Fin.ne_last_of_lt b.castSucc_lt_last
        simp [eLast, aux_lastFibreEquiv, mToKPoint, hlast, hne]
  unfold mToK
  calc
    (∫ q : ℝ, ∫ p : RealVector d,
        M (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - q) p)) =
        ∫ qp : ℝ × RealVector d,
          M (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - qp.1) qp.2) := by
      simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
        (integral_prod (fun qp : ℝ × RealVector d =>
          M (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - qp.1) qp.2)) hA).symm
    _ = ∫ qp : ℝ × RealVector d, C (eLast.symm qp) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with qp
      exact hpoint qp
    _ = ∫ p : RealVector (d + 1), C p := hLastInv.integral_comp' C

name: Auto.mToK_terminalFibreIntegral_general
statement:
theorem mToK_terminalFibreIntegral_general {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (M : MKernel k) (hM : MemW0 M) (z : RealVector k × ℝ) :
    (∫ q : ℝ, mToK k hk M (z.1, z.2 - q)) =
      ∫ p : RealVector k, M (z.1 + p, p)
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ d =>
    have hhk : hk = Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le d) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst hhk
    exact mToK_terminalFibreIntegral d M hM z

name: Auto.aux_mToKPoint_erase_last
statement:
theorem aux_mToKPoint_erase_last (d : ℕ)
    (z : RealVector (d + 2) × ℝ) (q : ℝ) (r : RealVector d) :
    (eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1))
        (mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z
          ((aux_lastFibreEquiv d z.2).symm (q, r))).1,
      eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1))
        (mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z
          ((aux_lastFibreEquiv d z.2).symm (q, r))).2) =
      mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega)
        (eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1)) z.1, z.2 - q) r
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ((aux_lastFibreEquiv d z.2).symm (q, r) : RealVector ((d + 2) - 1)) =
      (Fin.lastCases (z.2 - coordinateSum r - q) (fun j => r j) :
        RealVector ((d + 2) - 1)) := rfl
  have hlastBig : lastIndex (d + 2) (by omega) = Fin.last (d + 1) := Fin.ext rfl
  have hlastSmall : lastIndex (d + 1) (by omega) = Fin.last d := Fin.ext rfl
  rw [hp]
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext a
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun b => ?_) a
    · have hbig_nonlast : (Fin.last d).castSucc ≠ Fin.last (d + 1) := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last] at hv
        omega
      simp only [eraseVector, mToKPoint, hlastBig, Nat.add_one_sub_one,
        aux_coordinateSum_lastCases, Fin.succAbove_last, hbig_nonlast, ↓reduceDIte,
        Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last, hlastSmall]
      have hidx : (⟨d, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1)) = Fin.last d := Fin.ext rfl
      rw [hidx]
      simp
      ring
    · have hbig_nonlast : b.castSucc.castSucc ≠ Fin.last (d + 1) := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last] at hv
        omega
      have hsmall_nonlast : b.castSucc ≠ Fin.last d := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last] at hv
        omega
      simp only [eraseVector, mToKPoint, hlastBig, Nat.add_one_sub_one,
        aux_coordinateSum_lastCases, Fin.succAbove_last, hbig_nonlast, ↓reduceDIte,
        Fin.val_castSucc, hlastSmall, hsmall_nonlast, Fin.eta, add_right_inj]
      have hidx : (⟨b.1, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1)) = b.castSucc := Fin.ext rfl
      rw [hidx]
      simp
  · funext a
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun b => ?_) a
    · simp only [eraseVector, mToKPoint, hlastBig, Nat.add_one_sub_one,
        aux_coordinateSum_lastCases, Fin.succAbove_last, Fin.castSucc_ne_last, ↓reduceDIte,
        Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last, hlastSmall]
      have hidx : (⟨d, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1)) = Fin.last d := Fin.ext rfl
      rw [hidx]
      simp
      ring
    · have hbig_nonlast : b.castSucc.castSucc ≠ Fin.last (d + 1) := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last] at hv
        omega
      have hsmall_nonlast : b.castSucc ≠ Fin.last d := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last] at hv
        omega
      simp only [eraseVector, mToKPoint, hlastBig, Nat.add_one_sub_one,
        aux_coordinateSum_lastCases, Fin.succAbove_last, hbig_nonlast, ↓reduceDIte,
        Fin.val_castSucc, hlastSmall, hsmall_nonlast, Fin.eta]
      have hidx : (⟨b.1, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1)) = b.castSucc := Fin.ext rfl
      rw [hidx]
      simp

name: Auto.aux_mToKPoint_at_last
statement:
theorem aux_mToKPoint_at_last (d : ℕ)
    (z : RealVector (d + 2) × ℝ) (q : ℝ) (r : RealVector d) :
    ((mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z
        ((aux_lastFibreEquiv d z.2).symm (q, r))).1 (Fin.last (d + 1)),
      (mToKPoint (d + 2) (by omega) z
        ((aux_lastFibreEquiv d z.2).symm (q, r))).2 (Fin.last (d + 1))) =
      (z.1 (Fin.last (d + 1)) + q, q)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ((aux_lastFibreEquiv d z.2).symm (q, r) : RealVector ((d + 2) - 1)) =
      (Fin.lastCases (z.2 - coordinateSum r - q) (fun j => r j) :
        RealVector ((d + 2) - 1)) := rfl
  have hlastBig : lastIndex (d + 2) (by omega) = Fin.last (d + 1) := Fin.ext rfl
  rw [hp]
  simp [mToKPoint, hlastBig, aux_coordinateSum_lastCases]
  constructor <;> ring

name: Auto.aux_mToK_tensorSquareExtension_eq_positivity_last
statement:
theorem aux_mToK_tensorSquareExtension_eq_positivity_last (d : ℕ)
    (tildeM : MKernel (d + 1)) (htildeM : MemW0 tildeM)
    (phi : ℝ → ℝ) (hphi : MemW0 phi) :
    mToK (d + 1 + 1) (by omega)
      (tensorSquareExtension (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) (Fin.last (d + 1)) tildeM phi) =
      positivityKernel (d + 1) (mToK (d + 1) (by omega) tildeM) phi
        (Fin.last (d + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin d)
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1))) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin (d + 1))
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1 + 1))) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin (d + 1 + 1))
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector d × ℝ)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1) × ℝ)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : NormedSpace ℝ (RealVector (d + 1)) := Pi.normedSpace
  have hM : MemW0
      (tensorSquareExtension (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) (Fin.last (d + 1)) tildeM phi) := by
    have hErase (x : RealVector (d + 1 + 1)) :
        aux_eraseVector (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) (Fin.last (d + 1)) x =
          eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1)) x := by
      funext a
      simp [aux_eraseVector, eraseVector]
    have h := aux_memW0_tensorSquareExtensionSucc (d + 1) (Fin.last (d + 1))
      tildeM htildeM phi hphi
    change MemW0 (fun y : RealVector (d + 1 + 1) × RealVector (d + 1 + 1) =>
      tildeM (aux_eraseVector (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) (Fin.last (d + 1)) y.1,
        aux_eraseVector (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) (Fin.last (d + 1)) y.2) *
        tensorSquare phi (y.1 (Fin.last (d + 1)), y.2 (Fin.last (d + 1))))
    simpa only [hErase] using h
  funext z
  let e := aux_lastFibreEquiv d z.2
  have hE : MeasurePreserving e
      (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1)))
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (RealVector d))) :=
    aux_measurePreserving_lastFibreEquiv d z.2
  have hEinv := hE.symm e
  let A : RealVector (d + 1) → ℝ := fun p =>
    tensorSquareExtension (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) (Fin.last (d + 1)) tildeM phi
      (mToKPoint (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) z p)
  have hA : Integrable A := by
    have hW := mToK_integrand_memW0 (d + 1 + 1) (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) le_rfl
      (tensorSquareExtension (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) (Fin.last (d + 1)) tildeM phi) hM z
    have hInt := aux_memW0_integrable_of_addHaar
      (E := RealVector (d + 1)) (K := ℝ) hW
    simpa [A] using hInt
  let B : ℝ × RealVector d → ℝ := A ∘ e.symm
  have hB : Integrable B := by
    exact hEinv.integrable_comp_of_integrable hA
  have hB_eq (q : ℝ) (r : RealVector d) :
      B (q, r) =
        tildeM (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega)
          (eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1)) z.1, z.2 - q) r) *
          phi (z.1 (Fin.last (d + 1)) + q) * phi q := by
    change tensorSquareExtension (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) (Fin.last (d + 1)) tildeM phi
      (mToKPoint (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) z (e.symm (q, r))) = _
    have hErase (x : RealVector (d + 1 + 1)) :
        aux_eraseVector (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) (Fin.last (d + 1)) x =
          eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1)) x := by
      funext a
      simp [aux_eraseVector, eraseVector]
    have herase :
        (eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1))
            (mToKPoint (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) z (e.symm (q, r))).1,
          eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1))
            (mToKPoint (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) z (e.symm (q, r))).2) =
          mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega)
            (eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1)) z.1, z.2 - q) r := by
      simpa [e] using aux_mToKPoint_erase_last d z q r
    have hat :
        ((mToKPoint (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) z (e.symm (q, r))).1 (Fin.last (d + 1)),
          (mToKPoint (d + 1 + 1) (by omega) z (e.symm (q, r))).2 (Fin.last (d + 1))) =
          (z.1 (Fin.last (d + 1)) + q, q) := by
      simpa [e] using aux_mToKPoint_at_last d z q r
    unfold tensorSquareExtension tensorSquare
    simp only [hErase]
    rw [mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    · exact congrArg tildeM herase
    · exact congrArg (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => phi y.1 * phi y.2) hat
  have hFubini :
      (∫ q : ℝ, ∫ r : RealVector d, B (q, r)) = ∫ qr : ℝ × RealVector d, B qr := by
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using (integral_prod B hB).symm
  change (∫ p : RealVector (d + 1), A p) = ∫ q : ℝ,
    (∫ r : RealVector d,
      tildeM (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega)
        (eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1)) z.1, z.2 - q) r)) *
        phi (z.1 (Fin.last (d + 1)) + q) * phi q
  calc
    (∫ p : RealVector (d + 1), A p) = ∫ p : RealVector (d + 1), B (e p) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with p
      change A p = A (e.symm (e p))
      exact (congrArg A (e.left_inv p)).symm
    _ = ∫ qr : ℝ × RealVector d, B qr := hE.integral_comp' B
    _ = ∫ q : ℝ, ∫ r : RealVector d, B (q, r) := hFubini.symm
    _ = ∫ q : ℝ,
        (∫ r : RealVector d,
          tildeM (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega)
            (eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1)) z.1, z.2 - q) r)) *
            phi (z.1 (Fin.last (d + 1)) + q) * phi q := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with q
      calc
        (∫ r : RealVector d, B (q, r)) = ∫ r : RealVector d,
            tildeM (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega)
              (eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1)) z.1, z.2 - q) r) *
              phi (z.1 (Fin.last (d + 1)) + q) * phi q := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards [] with r
          exact hB_eq q r
        _ = (∫ r : RealVector d,
            tildeM (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega)
              (eraseVector (Fin.last (d + 1)) z.1, z.2 - q) r)) *
              phi (z.1 (Fin.last (d + 1)) + q) * phi q := by
          rw [integral_mul_const, integral_mul_const]

name: Auto.aux_integral_product_square_nonnegative
statement:
theorem aux_integral_product_square_nonnegative
    {P : Type*} [MeasurableSpace P] (μ : Measure P) [SFinite μ]
    (a : P → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hH : Integrable (fun q : P × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      a q.1 q.2.1 * a q.1 q.2.2) (μ.prod volume)) :
    0 ≤ ∫ q : P × (ℝ × ℝ), a q.1 q.2.1 * a q.1 q.2.2 ∂(μ.prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∫ q : P × (ℝ × ℝ), a q.1 q.2.1 * a q.1 q.2.2 ∂(μ.prod volume)) =
        ∫ p : P, ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, a p q.1 * a p q.2 ∂(volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) ∂μ := by
          simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
            (integral_prod (fun q : P × (ℝ × ℝ) => a q.1 q.2.1 * a q.1 q.2.2) hH)
    _ = ∫ p : P, (∫ r : ℝ, a p r) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards [] with p
          rw [show (∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, a p q.1 * a p q.2 ∂(volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ))) =
              (∫ r : ℝ, a p r) * ∫ r : ℝ, a p r by
            simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using integral_prod_mul (a p) (a p)]
          ring
    _ ≥ 0 := integral_nonneg fun p => sq_nonneg _

name: Auto.aux_baseReorderOne_apply
statement:
theorem aux_baseReorderOne_apply (n : ℕ)
    (p : (RealVector 1 × RealVector 1) × RealVector (n - 1 + 1)) :
    aux_baseReorderOne n p = (p.2, (p.1.1 0, p.1.2 0))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Auto.aux_measurePreserving_baseReorderOne
statement:
theorem aux_measurePreserving_baseReorderOne (n : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving (aux_baseReorderOne n) volume volume
proof:
:= by
  let e1 := MeasurableEquiv.piUnique (fun _ : Fin 1 => ℝ)
  have he1 : MeasurePreserving e1 volume volume := by
    simpa [e1] using volume_preserving_piUnique (fun _ : Fin 1 => ℝ)
  have hpairs : MeasurePreserving (Prod.map e1 e1) volume volume := by
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using he1.prod he1
  have hright : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl (RealVector (n - 1 + 1)))
        (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr e1 e1)) volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (Prod.map (id : RealVector (n - 1 + 1) → RealVector (n - 1 + 1))
      (Prod.map e1 e1)) volume volume
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (RealVector (n - 1 + 1)))).prod hpairs
  have hswap : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm :
        ((RealVector 1 × RealVector 1) × RealVector (n - 1 + 1)) ≃ᵐ
          (RealVector (n - 1 + 1) × (RealVector 1 × RealVector 1))) volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (Prod.swap :
      ((RealVector 1 × RealVector 1) × RealVector (n - 1 + 1)) →
        (RealVector (n - 1 + 1) × (RealVector 1 × RealVector 1))) volume volume
    exact aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap
      (volume : Measure (RealVector 1 × RealVector 1))
      (volume : Measure (RealVector (n - 1 + 1)))
  change MeasurePreserving
    ((MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl (RealVector (n - 1 + 1)))
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr e1 e1)) ∘ MeasurableEquiv.prodComm) volume volume
  exact hright.comp hswap

name: Auto.aux_prism_one_integrand_eq_rankOneRaw
statement:
theorem aux_prism_one_integrand_eq_rankOneRaw
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (c : ℝ) (phi : ℝ → ℝ)
    (F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ)
    (K : KKernel 1)
    (hK : ∀ u : RealVector 1 × ℝ,
      K u = c * phi (u.1 0 + u.2) * phi u.2)
    (p : (RealVector 1 × RealVector 1) × RealVector (n - 1 + 1)) :
    K (p.1.2 - p.1.1, coordinateSum p.1.1 + coordinateSum p.2) *
      ∏ h : Fin 1 → Fin 2, ∏ i : Fin (n - 1 + 1),
        F (prismIndex (n := n) (k := 1) (by omega) hn i)
          (prismPoint (n := n) (k := 1) (by omega) hn p.1 p.2 h i) =
      aux_rankOneRawIntegrand n hn c phi F p
proof:
:= by
  rw [hK]
  have hsum0 : coordinateSum p.1.1 = p.1.1 0 := aux_coordinateSum_finOne p.1.1
  have hcorner0 : cubeCorner p.1 (Fin.snoc (default : Fin 0 → Fin 2) (0 : Fin 2)) =
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => p.1.1 0) := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    simp [Fin.snoc_zero, cubeCorner]
  have hcorner1 : cubeCorner p.1 (Fin.snoc (default : Fin 0 → Fin 2) (1 : Fin 2)) =
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => p.1.2 0) := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    simp [Fin.snoc_zero, cubeCorner]
  have hprod :
      (∏ h : Fin 1 → Fin 2, ∏ i : Fin (n - 1 + 1),
        F (prismIndex (n := n) (k := 1) (by omega) hn i)
          (prismPoint (n := n) (k := 1) (by omega) hn p.1 p.2 h i)) =
      (∏ i : Fin (n - 1 + 1),
        F (prismIndex (n := n) (k := 1) (by omega) hn i)
          (concatVector n 1 hn (fun _ : Fin 1 => p.1.1 0) (eraseVector i p.2))) *
      (∏ i : Fin (n - 1 + 1),
        F (prismIndex (n := n) (k := 1) (by omega) hn i)
          (concatVector n 1 hn (fun _ : Fin 1 => p.1.2 0) (eraseVector i p.2))) := by
    rw [aux_prod_cubeCorners_snoc_two]
    simp only [Fintype.prod_unique]
    congr 1
    · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [prismPoint]
      congr 2
    · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [prismPoint]
      congr 2
  rw [hsum0, hprod]
  simp only [aux_rankOneRawIntegrand, aux_rankOneFactor]
  have hdiff : (p.1.2 - p.1.1 : RealVector 1) 0 = p.1.2 0 - p.1.1 0 := by rfl
  rw [hdiff]
  ring_nf

name: Auto.aux_prism_one_rankOne_nonnegative
statement:
theorem aux_prism_one_rankOne_nonnegative
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (phi : ℝ → ℝ)
    (F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ)
    (K : KKernel 1) (hKmem : MemW0 K)
    (hK : ∀ u : RealVector 1 × ℝ,
      K u = c * phi (u.1 0 + u.2) * phi u.2) :
    0 ≤ prismBrascampLiebForm n 1 (by omega) hn K (fun i x => F i x)
proof:
:= by
  let A : RealVector (n - 1 + 1) → ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun x r => Real.sqrt c * aux_rankOneFactor n hn phi F x r
  let G : RealVector (n - 1 + 1) × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun q => A q.1 q.2.1 * A q.1 q.2.2
  let H : (RealVector 1 × RealVector 1) × RealVector (n - 1 + 1) → ℝ :=
    fun p => K (p.1.2 - p.1.1, coordinateSum p.1.1 + coordinateSum p.2) *
      ∏ h : Fin 1 → Fin 2, ∏ i : Fin (n - 1 + 1),
        F (prismIndex (n := n) (k := 1) (by omega) hn i)
          (prismPoint (n := n) (k := 1) (by omega) hn p.1 p.2 h i)
  have hH : Integrable H := by
    simpa [H] using aux_integrable_prismIntegrand n 1 (by omega) hn K hKmem F
  have hpoint (p : (RealVector 1 × RealVector 1) × RealVector (n - 1 + 1)) :
      H p = G (aux_baseReorderOne n p) := by
    dsimp [H]
    rw [aux_prism_one_integrand_eq_rankOneRaw n hn c phi F K hK p]
    rw [aux_baseReorderOne_apply]
    dsimp [aux_rankOneRawIntegrand, G, A]
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt c ^ 2 = c := Real.sq_sqrt hc
    nth_rewrite 1 [← hsqrt]
    ring
  have hGcomp : Integrable (G ∘ aux_baseReorderOne n) := by
    refine hH.congr ?_
    filter_upwards [] with p
    exact hpoint p
  have hG : Integrable G := by
    let e := aux_baseReorderOne n
    have hinv : MeasurePreserving e.symm volume volume :=
      (aux_measurePreserving_baseReorderOne n).symm e
    have h := hinv.integrable_comp_of_integrable hGcomp
    refine h.congr ?_
    filter_upwards [] with q
    simp [e, Function.comp_def]
  have hGprod : Integrable (fun q : RealVector (n - 1 + 1) × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      A q.1 q.2.1 * A q.1 q.2.2)
      ((volume : Measure (RealVector (n - 1 + 1))).prod volume) := by
    simpa only [G, Measure.volume_eq_prod] using hG
  have hnonneg :
      0 ≤ ∫ q : RealVector (n - 1 + 1) × (ℝ × ℝ),
        A q.1 q.2.1 * A q.1 q.2.2 := by
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      aux_integral_product_square_nonnegative (volume : Measure (RealVector (n - 1 + 1))) A hGprod
  change 0 ≤ ∫ y : RealVector 1 × RealVector 1,
    ∫ x : RealVector (n - 1 + 1), H (y, x)
  calc
    (∫ y : RealVector 1 × RealVector 1,
      ∫ x : RealVector (n - 1 + 1), H (y, x)) =
        ∫ p : (RealVector 1 × RealVector 1) × RealVector (n - 1 + 1), H p := by
          simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
            (integral_prod H hH).symm
    _ = ∫ p : (RealVector 1 × RealVector 1) × RealVector (n - 1 + 1),
        G (aux_baseReorderOne n p) := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards [] with p
          exact hpoint p
    _ = ∫ q : RealVector (n - 1 + 1) × (ℝ × ℝ), G q :=
      (aux_measurePreserving_baseReorderOne n).integral_comp' G
    _ ≥ 0 := by simpa only [G] using hnonneg

name: Auto.aux_integral_realVector_zero
statement:
theorem aux_integral_realVector_zero (f : RealVector 0 → ℝ) :
    (∫ p : RealVector 0, f p) = f default
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_unique]
  have hvolume : (volume : Measure (RealVector 0)).real Set.univ = 1 := by
    rw [Measure.volume_pi_eq_dirac]
    simp
  rw [hvolume, one_smul]
  congr 1

name: Auto.positivityM_nonnegative
statement:
theorem positivityM_nonnegative
    (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (i : Fin k) (tildeM : MKernel (k - 1)) (htildeM : MemW0 tildeM)
    (htildeM_nonneg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ tildeM y) (phi : ℝ → ℝ) (hphi : MemW0 phi)
    (F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ)
    (hF : F ∈ normalizedFunctionTuples n) :
    0 ≤ prismForm n k hk hkn (tensorSquareExtension k hk i tildeM phi) (fun a z => F a z)
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k =>
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      have hi : i = (0 : Fin 1) := Fin.eq_zero i
      subst i
      have hM : MemW0 (tensorSquareExtension 1 hk 0 tildeM phi) :=
        positivityM_memW0 n 1 hk hkn 0 tildeM htildeM htildeM_nonneg phi hphi
      let K : KKernel 1 := mToK 1 hk (tensorSquareExtension 1 hk 0 tildeM phi)
      have hKmem : MemW0 K := by
        exact mToK_memW0 n 1 hk hkn (tensorSquareExtension 1 hk 0 tildeM phi) hM
      have hK : ∀ u : RealVector 1 × ℝ,
          K u = tildeM default * phi (u.1 0 + u.2) * phi u.2 := by
        intro u
        simpa [K] using aux_mToK_tensorSquareExtension_one_eq tildeM phi u
      have hc : 0 ≤ tildeM default := htildeM_nonneg default
      change 0 ≤ prismBrascampLiebForm n 1 hk hkn K (fun a z => F a z)
      exact aux_prism_one_rankOne_nonnegative n (by omega) (tildeM default) hc phi F K hKmem hK
    | succ d =>
      have hrho : MemW0 (mToK (d + 1) (by omega) tildeM) :=
        mToK_memW0 n (d + 1) (by omega) (by omega) tildeM htildeM
      have hrho_nonneg : ∀ u, 0 ≤ mToK (d + 1) (by omega) tildeM u := by
        intro u
        exact aux_mToK_nonnegative (d + 1) (by omega) tildeM htildeM_nonneg u
      by_cases hi : i = Fin.last (d + 1)
      · subst i
        unfold prismForm
        rw [aux_mToK_tensorSquareExtension_eq_positivity_last d tildeM htildeM phi hphi]
        exact positivityKernel_nonnegative n (d + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
          (mToK (d + 1) (by omega) tildeM) hrho hrho_nonneg phi hphi (Fin.last (d + 1)) F hF
      · unfold prismForm
        rw [aux_mToK_tensorSquareExtension_eq_positivity_nonlast d i hi tildeM htildeM phi hphi]
        exact positivityKernel_nonnegative n (d + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
          (mToK (d + 1) (by omega) tildeM) hrho hrho_nonneg phi hphi i F hF

name: Auto.aux_mToKPoint_diagonalShift_nonlast
statement:
theorem aux_mToKPoint_diagonalShift_nonlast (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d)
    (z : RealVector (d + 1) × ℝ) (p : RealVector d) (q : ℝ) :
    aux_diagonalShift
      (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) z (aux_fibreTranslate d j q p))
      j.castSucc q =
    mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - q) p
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := aux_coordinateSum_fibreTranslate d j q p
  apply Prod.ext <;> funext a
  · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun a => ?_) a
    · have hne : (Fin.last d) ≠ j.castSucc :=
        (Fin.ne_last_of_lt j.castSucc_lt_last).symm
      simp [aux_diagonalShift, hne, aux_mToKPoint_fst_last, hsum]; ring
    · by_cases haj : a = j
      · subst a
        simp [aux_diagonalShift, aux_mToKPoint_fst_castSucc, aux_fibreTranslate]; ring
      · have hne : a.castSucc ≠ j.castSucc := by
          intro h
          apply haj
          apply Fin.ext
          simpa using congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [aux_diagonalShift, hne, aux_mToKPoint_fst_castSucc, aux_fibreTranslate, haj]
  · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun a => ?_) a
    · have hne : (Fin.last d) ≠ j.castSucc :=
        (Fin.ne_last_of_lt j.castSucc_lt_last).symm
      simp [aux_diagonalShift, hne, aux_mToKPoint_snd_last, hsum]; ring
    · by_cases haj : a = j
      · subst a
        simp [aux_diagonalShift, aux_mToKPoint_snd_castSucc, aux_fibreTranslate]
      · have hne : a.castSucc ≠ j.castSucc := by
          intro h
          apply haj
          apply Fin.ext
          simpa using congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [aux_diagonalShift, hne, aux_mToKPoint_snd_castSucc, aux_fibreTranslate, haj]

name: Auto.aux_mToKPoint_diagonalShift_last
statement:
theorem aux_mToKPoint_diagonalShift_last (d : ℕ)
    (z : RealVector (d + 1) × ℝ) (p : RealVector d) (q : ℝ) :

name: Auto.aux_integrable_mToKDiagonalRaw
statement:
theorem aux_integrable_mToKDiagonalRaw (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (rho : MKernel k) (hrho : MemW0 rho) (phi : ℝ → ℝ) (hphi : MemW0 phi)
    (i : Fin k) (z : RealVector k × ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun pq : RealVector (k - 1) × ℝ =>
      rho (aux_diagonalShift (mToKPoint k hk z pq.1) i pq.2) * phi pq.2)
proof:
:= by
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector k)) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin k)
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector (k - 1))) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin (k - 1))
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector k × ℝ)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure
      (volume : Measure (RealVector (k - 1) × ℝ)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure
      (volume : Measure ((RealVector k × ℝ) × (RealVector (k - 1) × ℝ))) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure
      (volume : Measure (RealVector k × RealVector k)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure
      (volume : Measure ((RealVector k × RealVector k) × ℝ)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let H : (RealVector k × RealVector k) × ℝ → ℝ := fun yq => rho yq.1 * phi yq.2
  have hH : MemW0 H := by
    simpa [H] using hrho.aux_mul_prod hphi
  have hG : MemW0 (H ∘ aux_mToKDiagonalRawEquiv k hk i) :=
    aux_memW0_comp_continuousLinearEquiv hH (aux_mToKDiagonalRawEquiv k hk i)
  have hs := hG.aux_memW0_slice_of_addHaar z
  change MemW0 (fun pq : RealVector (k - 1) × ℝ =>
    rho ((aux_mToKDiagonalRawEquiv k hk i) (z, pq)).1 *
      phi ((aux_mToKDiagonalRawEquiv k hk i) (z, pq)).2) at hs
  have hs' : MemW0 (fun pq : RealVector (k - 1) × ℝ =>
      rho (aux_diagonalShift (mToKPoint k hk z pq.1) i pq.2) * phi pq.2) := by
    have heq : (fun pq : RealVector (k - 1) × ℝ =>
        rho ((aux_mToKDiagonalRawEquiv k hk i) (z, pq)).1 *
          phi ((aux_mToKDiagonalRawEquiv k hk i) (z, pq)).2) =
        fun pq : RealVector (k - 1) × ℝ =>
          rho (aux_diagonalShift (mToKPoint k hk z pq.1) i pq.2) * phi pq.2 := by
      funext pq
      rcases pq with ⟨p, q⟩
      simp [aux_mToKDiagonalRawEquiv_apply]
    rw [heq] at hs
    exact hs
  exact aux_memW0_integrable_of_addHaar hs'

name: Auto.aux_mToK_diagonalConvolution_last
statement:
theorem aux_mToK_diagonalConvolution_last (d : ℕ)
    (rho : MKernel (d + 1)) (hrho : MemW0 rho)
    (phi : ℝ → ℝ) (hphi : MemW0 phi) :
    mToK (d + 1) (by omega) (diagonalConvolution rho (Fin.last d) phi) =
      fun z => ∫ q : ℝ, mToK (d + 1) (by omega) rho (z.1, z.2 - q) * phi q
proof:
:= by
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin d)
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1))) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin (d + 1))
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector d × ℝ)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (ℝ × RealVector d)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  funext z
  let A : RealVector d × ℝ → ℝ := fun pq =>
    rho (aux_diagonalShift (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) z pq.1)
      (Fin.last d) pq.2) * phi pq.2
  have hA : Integrable A := by
    convert aux_integrable_mToKDiagonalRaw (d + 1) (by omega)
      rho hrho phi hphi (Fin.last d) z using 1 <;> rfl
  let C : ℝ × RealVector d → ℝ := fun qp => A (qp.2, qp.1)
  have hswap : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : ℝ × RealVector d ≃ᵐ RealVector d × ℝ)
      volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : ℝ × RealVector d → RealVector d × ℝ)
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
      ((volume : Measure (RealVector d)).prod (volume : Measure ℝ))
    exact aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap (volume : Measure ℝ) (volume : Measure (RealVector d))
  have hC : Integrable C := by
    have h := hswap.integrable_comp_of_integrable hA
    change Integrable (fun qp : ℝ × RealVector d => A (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm qp)) at h
    exact h
  have hFubini :
      (∫ p : RealVector d, ∫ q : ℝ, A (p, q)) =
        ∫ q : ℝ, ∫ p : RealVector d, A (p, q) := by
    calc
      (∫ p : RealVector d, ∫ q : ℝ, A (p, q)) =
          ∫ pq : RealVector d × ℝ, A pq := by
            simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using (integral_prod A hA).symm
      _ = ∫ qp : ℝ × RealVector d, C qp := by
            exact (hswap.integral_comp' A).symm
      _ = ∫ q : ℝ, ∫ p : RealVector d, A (p, q) := by
            simpa only [C, Measure.volume_eq_prod] using integral_prod C hC
  unfold mToK diagonalConvolution
  change (∫ p : RealVector d, ∫ q : ℝ,
      rho (aux_diagonalShift (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) z p) (Fin.last d) q) *
        phi q) =
      ∫ q : ℝ, (∫ p : RealVector d,
        rho (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - q) p)) * phi q
  rw [show (∫ p : RealVector d, ∫ q : ℝ,
      rho (aux_diagonalShift (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) z p) (Fin.last d) q) *
        phi q) = ∫ p : RealVector d, ∫ q : ℝ, A (p, q) by rfl]
  rw [hFubini]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with q
  calc
    (∫ p : RealVector d, A (p, q)) = ∫ p : RealVector d,
        rho (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - q) p) * phi q := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with p
      rw [show A (p, q) =
        rho (aux_diagonalShift (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) z p) (Fin.last d) q) * phi q by
          rfl, aux_mToKPoint_diagonalShift_last]
    _ = (∫ p : RealVector d,
        rho (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - q) p)) * phi q := by
      rw [integral_mul_const]

name: Auto.aux_mToK_diagonalConvolution_nonlast
statement:
theorem aux_mToK_diagonalConvolution_nonlast (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d)
    (rho : MKernel (d + 1)) (hrho : MemW0 rho)
    (phi : ℝ → ℝ) (hphi : MemW0 phi) :
    mToK (d + 1) (by omega) (diagonalConvolution rho j.castSucc phi) =
      fun z => ∫ q : ℝ, mToK (d + 1) (by omega) rho (z.1, z.2 - q) * phi q
proof:
:= by
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin d)
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector (d + 1))) :=
    isAddHaarMeasure_volume_pi (Fin (d + 1))
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (RealVector d × ℝ)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  let : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (volume : Measure (ℝ × RealVector d)) :=
    Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure _ _
  funext z
  let A : RealVector d × ℝ → ℝ := fun pq =>
    rho (aux_diagonalShift (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) z pq.1)
      j.castSucc pq.2) * phi pq.2
  have hA : Integrable A := by
    convert aux_integrable_mToKDiagonalRaw (d + 1) (by omega)
      rho hrho phi hphi j.castSucc z using 1 <;> rfl
  let C : ℝ × RealVector d → ℝ := fun qp => A (qp.2, qp.1)
  have hswap : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : ℝ × RealVector d ≃ᵐ RealVector d × ℝ)
      volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (Prod.swap : ℝ × RealVector d → RealVector d × ℝ)
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (RealVector d)))
      ((volume : Measure (RealVector d)).prod (volume : Measure ℝ))
    exact aux_volume_preserving_prod_swap (volume : Measure ℝ) (volume : Measure (RealVector d))
  have hC : Integrable C := by
    have h := hswap.integrable_comp_of_integrable hA
    change Integrable (fun qp : ℝ × RealVector d => A (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm qp)) at h
    exact h
  have hFubini :
      (∫ p : RealVector d, ∫ q : ℝ, A (p, q)) =
        ∫ q : ℝ, ∫ p : RealVector d, A (p, q) := by
    calc
      (∫ p : RealVector d, ∫ q : ℝ, A (p, q)) =
          ∫ pq : RealVector d × ℝ, A pq := by
            simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using (integral_prod A hA).symm
      _ = ∫ qp : ℝ × RealVector d, C qp := by
            exact (hswap.integral_comp' A).symm
      _ = ∫ q : ℝ, ∫ p : RealVector d, A (p, q) := by
            simpa only [C, Measure.volume_eq_prod] using integral_prod C hC
  unfold mToK diagonalConvolution
  change (∫ p : RealVector d, ∫ q : ℝ,
      rho (aux_diagonalShift (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) z p) j.castSucc q) *
        phi q) =
      ∫ q : ℝ, (∫ p : RealVector d,
        rho (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - q) p)) * phi q
  rw [show (∫ p : RealVector d, ∫ q : ℝ,
      rho (aux_diagonalShift (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) z p) j.castSucc q) *
        phi q) = ∫ p : RealVector d, ∫ q : ℝ, A (p, q) by rfl]
  rw [hFubini]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with q
  let e : MeasurableEquiv (RealVector d) (RealVector d) :=
    MeasurableEquiv.addRight (q • Pi.single j 1)
  have he : MeasurePreserving e volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (fun p : RealVector d => p + q • Pi.single j 1) volume volume
    exact measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure (RealVector d)) _
  calc
    (∫ p : RealVector d, A (p, q)) = ∫ p : RealVector d, A (e p, q) := by
      exact (he.integral_comp' (fun p : RealVector d => A (p, q))).symm
    _ = ∫ p : RealVector d,
        rho (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - q) p) * phi q := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with p
      change rho (aux_diagonalShift
        (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) z (aux_fibreTranslate d j q p))
        j.castSucc q) * phi q = _
      rw [aux_mToKPoint_diagonalShift_nonlast]
    _ = (∫ p : RealVector d,
        rho (mToKPoint (d + 1) (by omega) (z.1, z.2 - q) p)) * phi q := by
      rw [integral_mul_const]

name: Auto.aux_mToK_diagonalConvolution
statement:
theorem aux_mToK_diagonalConvolution
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (rho : MKernel k) (hrho : MemW0 rho)
